Insight: 当骨干表征已提供可分信息时，测试 episode 内的原型与边界估计可能是主要瓶颈；无需更新骨干也可利用未标注查询改善估计。转导优化假设查询集类别结构可用于适配，摘要未报告类别均衡假设被违反时的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Cross-domain few-shot action recognition (CD-FSAR) aims to recognise unseen action classes in a target domain from a handful of labelled videos. Despite advances in representation learning, CD-FSAR inference still relies on prototypes estimated from extremely limited support examples. To assess this bottleneck, we perform an oracle analysis with the representation fixed. Constructing oracle prototypes and decision boundaries from ground-truth query labels improves 5-way 1-shot accuracy by 7–20 percentage points across five target datasets. This reveals a substantial estimation gap: the representation contains useful discriminative information, but prototypes and boundaries estimated from scarce supports fail to capture each episode’s true class structure. Motivated by this, we propose TRACE, a training-free transductive inference framework that improves episode-level estimation without modifying the backbone. TRACE comprises two complementary stages. Confidence-Thresholded Transductive Prototype Refinement (CTPR) refines support-based prototypes using confidently predicted queries. The refined prototypes initialise a lightweight per-episode classifier, which Transductive Classifier Refinement (TCR) further adapts by encouraging confident, class-balanced predictions over all queries. Together, the two stages improve prototype and boundary estimation, enabling better use of information in the unlabelled queries. Across five target datasets (HMDB51, UCF101, SSv2, Diving48, and RareAct) in both 1-shot and 5-shot settings, TRACE consistently improves a strong CD-FSAR baseline, including gains of more than six percentage points on HMDB51 1-shot, while recovering much of the oracle-estimated gap. These results suggest that improving test-time estimation is a powerful, broadly applicable complement to representation learning for CD-FSAR under extreme support scarcity.

[217] AffectWorld: Benchmarking Emotion-Driven Future World Prediction cs.CV | cs.AIPDF

Changhao Song, Yacong Chen, Hui Gao, Yazhou Zhang, Peng Zhang

TL;DR: AffectWorld 评测世界模型能否生成情绪影响下的人类动作与后续世界状态，覆盖情绪—动作—世界状态一致性及固定场景下的情绪反事实干预。

Details

Motivation: 世界模型基准多关注物理合理性和感知质量，但现实世界也由人类行为构成，情绪会改变行动，进而影响物理和社会状态演化。

Result: 基准包含 1,498 段日常视频样本，标注合理情绪、行动倾向和原子世界状态约束；其中 233 个反事实样本固定场景与事件条件、只改变角色情绪，检查动作和后果是否相应变化。作者定义三类任务及共八项指标，结合自动视觉评估和经人工校准的 VLM/LLM 判断。五个先进世界模型（包括 Cosmos3）的世界状态变化分数仅为 0.100–0.280，反事实情绪敏感度为 0.027–0.070，均在 0–1 标度上，显示生成情绪驱动后果及适应情绪干预方面存在明显不足。

Insight: 基准把情绪影响拆成动作变化和后续状态因果变化，避免只检查文本是否描述了情绪。指标混合自动评估和人工校准模型判断，分数的评审误差与场景覆盖仍需关注；低分主要说明当前被测模型能力不足，不意味着情绪行为有唯一合理答案。

Abstract: The world encompasses both physical environments and human actors. Predicting its evolution requires understanding both physical laws and how emotions shape human actions. However, existing world model benchmarks primarily assess physical plausibility and perceptual quality, leaving emotion-driven world evolution largely untested.We introduce AffectWorld, a benchmark that evaluates the chain Emotion-Action-World State through three tasks: World-State Consistency, Emotion-Action Consistency, and Causal Consistency. It comprises 1,498 everyday video samples annotated with plausible emotions, action tendencies, and atomic world-state constraints. A counterfactual subset of 233 samples tests whether changing an agent’s emotion under fixed scene and event conditions yields corresponding changes in actions and consequences. We define eight metrics across the three tasks and an additional counterfactual metric, combining automatic visual assessment with human-calibrated VLM/LLM judgments. Evaluations of five SoTA world models (e.g., Cosmos3) required world-state change scores of 0.100-0.280 and counterfactual emotion sensitivity scores of 0.027-0.070 on a [0, 1] scale. These results reveal substantial gaps in generating the consequences of emotion-driven actions and adapting future predictions to emotional interventions. AffectWorld provides a testbed for advancing world models that capture how emotions shape future physical and social states.

[218] LongForcing: Scaling Temporal Manifold Matching for Long-Horizon World Rollout cs.CVPDF

Ziyu Zhu, Zhaoxu Sun, Fan Jiang, Mengchao Wang, Junfeng Ni

TL;DR: LongForcing 用扩展时域双向教师监督学生自回归长 rollout，弥补短窗口蒸馏对后期状态缺少直接约束的问题。

Details

Motivation: 视频扩散模型递归使用自身生成帧作为上下文时，超出训练窗口后会逐步产生画质漂移、动作不一致和身份坍塌；短时域分布匹配不一定决定长时行为。

Result: LongForcing 保留短时教师强制和因果 ODE 蒸馏阶段，在最终分布匹配阶段用扩展时域双向教师替代 real-score 教师，监督学生自己的长 rollout；不改变学生架构或推理成本。文生视频评测 VBench Quality 为 85.52；第一人称消融中 WorldRoamBench 60 秒动作分提高 23.9。质性压力测试采样到 24 小时交互 rollout，远超训练时域。

Insight: 长时域 on-policy rollout 可将延迟出现的累积漂移暴露给教师监督，补足短窗口蒸馏盲区。24 小时压力测试是质性展示，不等于长时稳定性已被定量验证；摘要未说明 VBench 及世界模型基准上的基线分数。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a foundation for long-horizon world rollout. However, when extended far beyond their training windows, these models suffer from progressive drift: visual quality deteriorates, motion becomes inconsistent, and object identity gradually collapses as generated frames are recursively reused as context. We study a supervision-horizon gap: short-horizon distillation leaves later rollout states without direct supervision. We show that matching short-window marginals need not determine long-horizon behavior, while longer on-policy trajectories expose delayed failures to training. This motivates temporal manifold matching at scale for long-horizon world models. Building on this insight, we introduce LongForcing, a distillation approach that scales teacher supervision to long student self-rollouts. LongForcing preserves the short-horizon teacher-forcing and causal ODE-distillation stages, while replacing the realscore teacher in the final distribution-matching stage with an extended-horizon bidirectional teacher. The long-horizon teacher supervises extended student self-rollouts using the standard distribution-matching formulation, without modifying the student architecture or increasing inference cost. We evaluate LongForcing on text-to-video generation and interactive action-conditioned world models, achieving a VBench Quality score of 85.52 and improving WorldRoamBench 60s action score by 23.9 points in first-person ablations. Qualitative stress tests further sample interactive rollouts up to 24 hours, far beyond the training horizon. These results suggest that scaling supervision along the temporal axis is a practical step toward long-horizon world models. The project website and code are at https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing.

[219] Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes cs.CV | cs.AIPDF

Yu Wang, Rui Dai, Wei Chen, Yi Wang, Bo Dang

TL;DR: Urbex 将城市级 3D grounding 建模为主动空间搜索，让 VLM 智能体查询地标、缩放局部区域、渲染斜视角并逐步确定边界框，而非对预计算候选排序。

Details

Motivation: 城市级场景候选排序依赖预先生成的实例提案，在大规模户外场景中低效；主动搜索能否在无候选框条件下完成 grounding 尚待验证。

Result: Urbex 将城市 3D 场景表示成交互式多视图环境，并以 CityRefer 上的强化学习优化工具使用策略，奖励平滑定位质量并加入轻量探索效率奖励。作者报告其在 CityRefer 上 Hit@1 和 IoU 均最佳，无需真值框即可候选无关 grounding，速度显著快于最强城市级排序基线；在 STPLS3D-Refer 上的零样本结果也显示更强跨场景鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体分数或速度比。

Insight: 交互式空间搜索可省去大批候选框的预计算和全局排序，让模型按需查看地标和局部视角。性能和速度优势在摘要中未量化，工具调用次数、场景地图构建成本与搜索失败案例仍需评估。

Abstract: City-scale 3D grounding is commonly formulated as candidate ranking, which requires precomputed instance proposals and becomes inefficient in large outdoor scenes. We propose Urbex, an agentic vision-language framework that instead casts grounding as active spatial search. Urbex represents a city-scale 3D scene as an interactive multi-view environment, allowing a VLM agent to query landmarks, zoom into local regions, render oblique views, and commit a grounded bounding box. We optimize this tool-use policy with reinforcement learning on CityRefer, using smooth localization rewards and lightweight shaping rewards for efficient exploration. Experiments show that Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer, supports candidate-free grounding without ground-truth boxes, and is substantially faster than the strongest city-scale ranking baseline. Zero-shot results on STPLS3D-Refer further indicate improved cross-scene robustness.

[220] Omni-RS: Unifying Multi-Task Understanding and Generation in Remote Sensing cs.CVPDF

Pan Yin. Shuai Yang, Yuanhao Liu, Datao Tang, Jialin Li, Hao Wang

TL;DR: Omni-RS 将遥感场景理解和图像生成统一起来，先用场景引导两阶段训练适配 MLLM，再以其隐藏状态指导扩散 Transformer，并构建多任务生成数据集 UniGen。

Details

Motivation: 实际遥感应用既需理解地理场景也需生成内容，但多数方法只处理其中一项；现有统一模型的生成能力通常限于文本到图像。

Result: 框架支持四类理解任务和五类生成任务。训练先让多模态大语言模型适配遥感理解，再用其隐藏状态引导扩散 Transformer 生成。为统一不同遥感生成任务，作者将异构数据整理为 UniGen；Detailed Visual Conditioning 通过 VAE 编码视觉条件，支持需要参考图像的生成任务。作者称模型在理解和多种生成任务上均表现突出。摘要未提供任务名称、数据规模、指标或定量比较。

Insight: 以场景理解状态作为生成条件，试图共享语义表示并覆盖参考图像条件任务，超越单一文本生成。当前摘要的结果仅为定性表述，无法衡量理解与生成之间是否存在权衡，也无法判断 UniGen 和训练策略的单独作用。

Abstract: Practical remote sensing applications often require both understanding and generation capabilities for the same geographic scene. However, most existing methods address either understanding or generation in isolation, while existing unified remote sensing models’ generative ability is limited to text-to-image. To bridge this gap, we propose Omni-RS, a unified framework supporting four remote sensing understanding tasks and five generation tasks. Specifically, we introduce the “Scene-Guided Two-Stage Training” strategy, which first adapts a multimodal large language model to remote sensing understanding and then uses its hidden states to guide a diffusion transformer for image generation. To enable joint learning across diverse generation tasks, we construct UniGen, a unified multi-task generation dataset, by organizing heterogeneous remote sensing data into a unified format. Furthermore, we introduce “Detailed Visual Conditioning”, which uses visual conditions encoded by a VAE to guide the generation process, thereby supporting additional generation tasks that require reference images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Omni-RS performs exceptionally well in understanding tasks and has achieved outstanding results in a variety of generative tasks.

[221] Hallucination-aware Faithful Reasoning in Remote Sensing cs.CVPDF

Yi Liu, Jing Zhang, Xiang Feng, Xiaoyu Tian, Haonan Guo

TL;DR: FaithRS 通过细粒度遥感幻觉标注训练检测器，再以安全门控的纠正 rollout 和复合奖励优化 MLLM 的推理忠实度。

Details

Motivation: 遥感 MLLM 可能生成与视觉证据矛盾的推理；只优化最终答案正确性，缺少对中间推理幻觉类型、原因和可见支持证据的监督。

Result: 作者构建 SFHD-43K，含 43,000 条结构化细粒度幻觉标注，用于检测幻觉类别、根因和视觉证据。FaithRS 将诊断结果用于安全感知纠正 rollout，由门控器选择是否以及如何修订，再以复合奖励联合优化答案正确性、推理忠实度、幻觉减少、格式和修订安全性。在 Qwen3.5 的 0.8B、4B、9B 骨干及四个遥感基准上，作者报告持续改进，最高增益 11.64 分；摘要未说明该分值对应指标或各骨干成绩。

Insight: 幻觉修订不仅需要判断哪里错，还要检查修订是否有证据且不会造成不安全替换；安全门控将是否修改纳入学习。最高提升限于所报告基准，摘要未给出标注一致性、幻觉类别差异和修订导致新错误的比例。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated promising capabilities for remote sensing reasoning, yet they frequently generate visually unsupported reasoning that contradicts the visual evidence. Existing post-training methods optimize primarily for final-answer correctness, providing limited supervision for identifying and correcting hallucinations that arise during the reasoning process. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{FaithRS}, a hallucination-aware self-reflection framework for faithful reasoning in remote sensing. We first construct \textbf{SFHD-43K}, a dataset of 43K structured, fine-grained hallucination annotations, and train a detector to identify hallucination types, underlying causes, and supporting visual evidence. FaithRS then incorporates this diagnostic feedback into a Safe Detector-Guided Corrective Rollout framework, where a safety-aware gate selectively determines whether and how to revise the response. Training is driven by a composite reward that jointly optimizes answer accuracy, reasoning faithfulness, hallucination reduction, format compliance, and revision safety. Experiments with Qwen3.5 backbones (0.8B, 4B, and 9B) show consistent improvements across four remote sensing benchmarks, with gains of up to 11.64 points.

[222] ReDiS: Reasoning-Diagnosis Self-Evolution for Multimodal Reasoning in Remote Sensing cs.CVPDF

Yi Liu, Wentao Jiang, Shuo Ni, Zhiming Luo, Di Wang

TL;DR: ReDiS 将遥感多模态推理拆为生成多样候选的 Reasoner 与评估整组候选可信度的 Diagnoser，并用全错组触发的 FTR 提供最小纠正信号。

Details

Motivation: 遥感细粒度视觉定位和多步推理仍困难；昂贵人工构造推理轨迹成本高，而基于模型自生成一致性的监督可能强化共享错误。

Result: 两个角色共享多模态骨干并共同演化：Reasoner 探索不同视觉证据—答案候选，Diagnoser 联合评估完整候选集并给出可信度感知反馈。若组内候选全错、组相对优势消失，Failure-Triggered Recovery 仅提供最小结果级纠正，不规定中间推理轨迹。在 LHRS-Bench、MME-RS、CHOICE 上，0.8B、2B、4B 的 Qwen3.5 骨干均报告一致改善；0.8B 分类平均准确率提高 6.47 个百分点，ReDiS-4B 在所比较遥感 MLLM 中平均性能最高。

Insight: 分离探索和评估可避免直接把答案一致性当成正确性，并让诊断信号随候选分布变化；FTR 解决全错组没有相对优势的问题。摘要未给其他规模增益和单项任务成绩，所称领先限于三个遥感基准及比较模型。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for remote sensing understanding, yet reliable reasoning remains challenging when tasks require fine-grained visual grounding and multi-step inference. Existing approaches typically rely on either costly pre-constructed reasoning trajectories or self-generated signals such as response consistency, which can reinforce shared errors and provide unreliable supervision. We introduce \textbf{Reasoning–Diagnosis Self-Evolution (ReDiS)}, a framework that separates reasoning exploration from candidate evaluation while allowing the two processes to evolve jointly. ReDiS instantiates two role-specific experts from a shared multimodal backbone: a \textbf{Reasoner} that explores diverse visual evidence–answer candidates and a \textbf{Diagnoser} that jointly evaluates the complete candidate set and provides credibility-aware feedback. As the Reasoner evolves, it exposes new candidate distributions and failure modes; the Diagnoser adapts to these changes and, in turn, reshapes the learning signal for subsequent exploration. To handle groups in which all sampled answers are incorrect and group-relative advantages vanish, we further introduce \textbf{Failure-Triggered Recovery (FTR)}, which provides minimal outcome-level correction without prescribing intermediate reasoning trajectories. Experiments on LHRS-Bench, MME-RS, and CHOICE show consistent improvements over Qwen3.5 backbones at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B scales. ReDiS improves category-averaged accuracy by 6.47 percentage points at 0.8B, while ReDiS-4B achieves the highest average performance among the compared remote sensing MLLMs.

[223] Bifocal: Training-Free Mixed Granularity Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal LLMs cs.CVPDF

Peiran Yin, Hao Wu, Zihao Yang, Fengyu Zhou, Yijuan Liang

TL;DR: Bifocal 将视觉 token 预算分给问题相关证据、图像固有信息和全图粗表征，并在 LLM 中继续按密度调整注意力剪枝，以保护 OCR 和定位等细粒度能力。

Details

Motivation: 既有视觉 token 剪枝在常见 VQA 上保留少量 token 仍能维持总体性能，却可能严重损害 OCR 和视觉 grounding；单一重要性排序会忽略不同任务需要的互补证据，稀疏选 patch 也会破坏空间完整性。

Result: Bifocal 是训练免除两阶段方法：LLM 前将问题词与视觉区域软匹配，并平衡去范数偏差的图像显著性，同时选择覆盖度高的图像固有信息，再保留全图池化粗表示；LLM 内按密度修正文本到图像注意力并剪枝。在三个 MLLM 家族、五种能力组评估中，约保留四分之一原始 token 时，Bifocal 是唯一在全部能力组和三种模型上都保留超过 90% 未剪枝性能的方法；九种模型—预算设置的平均排名均第一。

Insight: 同时保留查询驱动、图像固有和全局粗粒度信息，避免通用排名只偏向一个任务目标；能力分组评测也揭示总体 VQA 分数掩盖的细粒度退化。摘要的“约四分之一 token”结果依赖所评模型和能力组，未提供各任务的绝对分数或不同预算下成本。

Abstract: Visual token pruning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) appears highly effective, with existing methods retaining over 95% of unpruned performance on common VQA benchmarks using a quarter of the visual tokens or fewer. However, our extensive evaluation of ten methods across three MLLM families and five ability groups reveals a critical gap: strong general performance often comes at the cost of severe degradation on fine-grained tasks such as OCR and visual grounding. We trace these failures to two limitations of the prevailing paradigm of retaining the highest-ranked native patches. A single importance ranking overlooks the complementary evidence required by different tasks, while sparse patch selection disrupts both image content and spatial integrity. To address these limitations, we propose Bifocal, a training-free, two-stage pruning method built on a mixed-granularity framework. It allocates separate budgets to query-focused and image-intrinsic evidence, complemented by a pooled coarse representation of the entire image. Before the LLM, Bifocal matches question words to visual regions through a soft conjunction balanced against norm-debiased image saliency, while selecting image-intrinsic evidence to maximize representational coverage. Inside the LLM, it further prunes tokens using density-adjusted text-to-image attention. With roughly a quarter of the original visual tokens, Bifocal is the only evaluated method to retain over 90% of unpruned performance in every ability group across all three models, and ranks first on average in all nine model-budget settings. The code is available at: https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Bifocal

[224] CoTL: Compact Token Learning for 3D Scene Representation cs.CVPDF

Han Liang, Sibo Wu, Anpei Chen, Rüdiger Westermann

TL;DR: CoTL 将无姿态多视角图像压缩为随视图数量小幅扩展的紧凑潜 token 集，并通过可查询高斯解码器和新视角渲染监督保留场景几何与外观。

Details

Motivation: 3D 场景表示需要同时容纳多视角观测并保持一致几何和外观；希望用紧凑且不依赖预定义结构的 token 表征支持重建及后续生成。

Result: 编码器将各视图压缩为小组潜 token，并跨视图聚合为一致场景表示；每增加一视图仅增加少量、与分辨率无关的 token。场景无关的查询通过潜 token 恢复显式可渲染 3D Gaussian primitives，并用高斯场景的新视角渲染监督端到端训练。在摘要所列两个数据集（其中一个名称显示为未展开占位符“retenk”，另一个为 ACID）上，作者报告新视角合成具有竞争力，且 token 空间可作为 3D 高斯场景生成模型的潜变量。摘要未提供具体分数。

Insight: 将 3D 高斯重建作为训练目标，可迫使紧凑 token 保存可渲染几何和外观；表示容量随观察数量增长但不随图像分辨率膨胀。一个数据集名称在摘要中为模板占位符，且没有量化结果，具体基准及性能需查正文确认。

Abstract: We present CoTL, a framework that learns a compact set of tokens that preserves scene geometry and appearance from unposed multi-view images. Our encoder compresses the input images into small per-view sets of latent tokens that aggregate information across views to form a view-consistent scene representation. Each additional view expands the representation with only a small, resolution-independent set of tokens, allowing its capacity to grow with the available observations. To force this compact bottleneck to retain sufficient scene information, a query-based Gaussian decoder uses scene-independent queries to attend to the learned tokens and recover an explicit, renderable set of 3D Gaussian primitives. Novel-view rendering supervision trains the compact representation end to end through the reconstructed Gaussian scene. Experiments on \retenk{} and ACID show that the resulting compact, unstructured token set supports competitive novel-view synthesis and can serve as the latent space of a generative model for 3D Gaussian scene generation. Together, these results show that 3D Gaussian reconstruction is an effective objective for compact scene representation learning and the learned token space provides a basis for broader downstream tasks in 3D vision.

[225] EmoGenie: Benchmarking and Evaluating Expressed and Evoked Emotion in T2I Generation with MLLMs cs.CVPDF

Zixuan Xing, Lancheng Gao, Shengyan Li, Huiyu Duan, Zhaolin Cai

TL;DR: EmoGenie 统一评测文生图生成内容表达的情绪和观看者被唤起的情绪，并评估 MLLM 对 AI 生成图像情感的粗粒度问答与连续维度预测。

Details

Motivation: 生成图像可带有特定情感意图，但画面传递或引发的情绪常与目标不符；既有情感基准多使用自然图像，生成图像研究又常局限于人像表达，缺少统一基准。

Result: EmoGenie 含 8 个文生图模型根据 800 个情绪提示生成的 6,400 张图像。EmoGenie-QA 有 90,000 个单图/图像对闭集问题和 1,057 个开放式情绪描述问题；EmoGenie-Assess 收录 13,175 个由人工评分聚合的 MOS，覆盖效价、唤醒度、支配感和审美质量。作者开发 EmoProbe，将情绪问答与响应对齐的分维度回归头结合。实验报告其情绪 QA 表现更好，对情感及审美人工评分的相关性也更高。

Insight: 表达情绪与观看者感受并非同一目标，单一图像情绪标签无法涵盖二者；基准将问答和连续心理维度分开评测。摘要未给具体相关系数、人工评分者规模和不同文化背景分析，跨文化情绪标签的适用性尚不明确。

Abstract: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) have significantly promoted using text-to-image (T2I) models to generate images with specific affective intentions. However, the emotional effects conveyed by generated images frequently deviate from target expectations, and it remains unclear whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reliably interpret the emotion of AI-generated visual content. Existing affective benchmarks are predominantly built on natural images, while affective studies of generated images have largely focused on emotions expressed in portraits, lacking a unified benchmark for studying the emotions expressed and evoked by generated images. We therefore introduce EmoGenie, a benchmark of emotion for AI-generated images that evaluates capabilities in T2I generation and MLLM understanding across expressed and evoked emotions. It comprises 6,400 images generated by eight T2I models using 800 emotion-targeted prompts, annotated with question-answer (QA) pairs, termed EmoGenie-QA, and continuous human ratings, termed EmoGenie-Assess. EmoGenie-QA contains 90,000 closed-set questions in single-image and image-pair settings, as well as 1,057 open-ended questions for emotion description. EmoGenie-Assess benchmarks continuous affective and aesthetic prediction using 13,175 mean opinion scores (MOSs) aggregated from human ratings in terms of valence, arousal, dominance, and aesthetic quality. We further develop EmoProbe, which combines emotion question answering with response-aligned, dimension-specific regression heads for continuous score prediction. Experimental results show that EmoProbe achieves superior results on emotion-related QA tasks, while its affective and aesthetic predictions correlate better with human ratings, demonstrating its state-of-the-art capabilities of unified coarse-to-fine affective understanding for AI-generated images.

[226] Simplifying and Improving On-Policy Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion cs.CV | cs.LG | eess.IVPDF

Jiawei Zhang, Ziyu Wan, Nanye Ma, Long Zhao, Dong Chen

TL;DR: SMD 用简单的 on-policy 速度回归作为少步扩散蒸馏基础，以训练期残差代理 Pivot 表示粗时间段内部教师速度变化，并排斥较弱教师预测。

Details

Motivation: 少步蒸馏可降低扩散和 flow 生成采样成本，但不少方法需要额外 score 模型或专用架构；目标是在保持通用架构的同时获得强 4-NFE 生成。

Result: Pivot 将局部修正与学生对粗区间平均速度的预测分离，并在训练中使用；额外排斥较弱教师预测以减少不理想模式。SMD 完全基于回归，无在线 score 估计和对抗训练，部署生成器结构不变。评估覆盖图像生成/编辑、3D 生成、视频及联合音视频生成，模型规模最高 330 亿参数。在 4-NFE 下，作者报告 SMD 超过强少步基线，且在若干基准超过多步教师；还支持跨模型、多教师和因果视频蒸馏。摘要未列出具体基准与数值。

Insight: 以学生自身 rollout 做速度回归，并显式建模粗步长内局部速度变化，提供了较简洁的少步蒸馏路径。作者称在多任务和大规模上有效，但摘要未报告各任务指标、训练稳定性和不同 NFE 下的质量曲线。

Abstract: Few-step distillation reduces the sampling cost of diffusion and flow models, but existing approaches often require auxiliary score models or specialized architectures. We show that simple on-policy velocity regression already provides a strong foundation for 4-NFE generation. To represent teacher velocity variation within each coarse transition, we introduce Pivot, a training-only residual proxy that separates local corrections from the student’s interval-mean prediction. We further repel the student from weaker teacher predictions, providing a lightweight mechanism for avoiding undesirable modes. The resulting framework, Simplified Matching Distillation (SMD), remains entirely regression-based, requires neither online score estimation nor adversarial training, and leaves the deployed generator unchanged. We evaluate SMD on image generation and editing, 3D generation, video synthesis, and joint audio–video generation, scaling to 33 billion parameters. At 4-NFE, SMD outperforms strong few-step baselines and surpasses multi-step teachers on several benchmarks. It also supports cross-model, multi-teacher, and causal-video distillation.

[227] MFVSR: A Multi-Style and Fine-Grained Benchmark for Video Subtitle Removal cs.CVPDF

Xiyan Huang, Qingdong He, Peng Tang, Bo Yin, Chaoyi Wang

TL;DR: MFVSR 建立 3,000 对多风格视频基准及细粒度可靠性评估协议，分别测量字幕移除的局部复原、外部区域保留、时间稳定性、覆盖率和失败。

Details

Motivation: 现有视频字幕移除评测受低分辨率数据、测试集碎片化和通用视频修复协议限制，难以刻画局部修复错误、意外改动、时间不稳定及未完成输出。

Result: MFVSR 含 3,000 对 Real-HQ、Real-LQ 和 AI 生成视频，并附加 953 段真实野外视频用于覆盖分析；字幕变化覆盖 16 种语言及空间布局、时间行为、视觉风格、语言模式四个因素。信息条件化、空间解耦的协议区分盲移除与掩码引导移除，评估复原忠实度、保留忠实度、时间忠实度、覆盖及失败。六种代表方法的实验显示，局部修复、编辑区外保留、时间一致性和整套数据可靠性之间差异显著，传统全帧指标会掩盖这些差异。

Insight: 将编辑区域内外和时间维度拆开量化，能避免单一全图指标掩盖删字幕之外的破坏；盲移除与掩码引导任务也需分别评测。摘要未提供六种方法的具体分数，953 段野外视频用于覆盖分析，并非同规模配对真值测试集。

Abstract: Video subtitle removal (VSR) is an important video restoration task, yet existing evaluation remains limited by low-resolution datasets, fragmented test sets, and generic video-inpainting protocols that fail to adequately capture localized restoration errors, unintended modifications, temporal instability, and incomplete outputs. In this paper, we introduce MFVSR, a large-scale multi-style benchmark for fine-grained and reliability-aware video subtitle removal evaluation. MFVSR distinguishes itself through three key features: (1) Large-scale and diverse data, comprising 3,000 paired videos from Real-HQ, Real-LQ, and AI-Generated sources, with an auxiliary set of 953 in-the-wild real videos for real-world coverage analysis; (2) Controlled subtitle diversity, spanning 16 languages and four factors covering spatial layout, temporal behavior, visual style, and language mode; (3) Fine-grained evaluation, introducing an information-conditioned, spatially decoupled protocol that separates blind from mask-guided removal and measures Restoration Fidelity, Preservation Fidelity, Temporal Fidelity, coverage, and failures. Experiments on six representative methods reveal substantial discrepancies between local restoration, outside-region preservation, temporal consistency, and full-set reliability that are obscured by conventional full-frame metrics. MFVSR therefore provides a more comprehensive and diagnostic foundation for evaluating and advancing video subtitle removal methods.

[228] Physics-Aware Deepfake Detection via Distance-Speech Consistency cs.CVPDF

Kyeongrae Kim, Kim Sung-Bin, Oh Hyun-Bin, Tae-Hyun Oh

TL;DR: 该物理先验深伪检测器利用真实录音中语音能量随说话者—相机距离变化的规律，与视频距离估计进行一致性检测，以补充动态场景下易失效的唇音同步线索。

Details

Motivation: 多数音视频深伪检测依赖唇动—语音同步，常为静态正面视频设计；真实动态拍摄中说话者移动、唇部线索退化或缺失，可靠性可能下降。

Result: 方法融合视频估计的说话者距离与语音中依赖距离的声学测量，利用真实录制中的物理耦合关系识别可能被合成破坏的关联。在野外基准上，作者报告该物理线索对动态场景有效，并与唇同步检测互补；简单集成在多个数据集上均带来稳定增益。摘要未给数据集名称、准确率或融合增益。

Insight: 使用声学传播与拍摄距离的物理一致性，提供不同于视觉唇动对齐的判据，可能覆盖唇部不可见情况。实际效果依赖距离估计和录制环境；摘要未量化设备、混响、说话音量变化等因素的影响。

Abstract: Recent progress in generative models has made talking-head deepfakes highly realistic and easy to create, jeopardizing public trust. However, most audio-visual deepfake detectors rely on lip-speech synchronization and are designed for static, frontal videos, limiting their reliability in dynamic, in-the-wild recordings where the speaker moves and lip cues are degraded or missing. As an alternative, we propose a physics-aware detector for dynamic speaking videos that leverages an acoustic constraint: in real recordings, speech energy varies predictably with speaker-to-camera distance, whereas deepfake generation can break this coupling. Our method combines distance estimates from video with distance-dependent acoustic measures from speech to detect deepfakes. Experiments on in-the-wild benchmarks show that the proposed physical cue is effective in dynamic scenarios, and that it complements lip-sync-based detectors, with a simple ensemble achieving consistent gains across datasets. Codes are available at https://byulharang.github.io/PADD/.

[229] EgoOmniWorld: Unifying Egocentric Understanding via Ego-Action-World Interactions cs.CV | cs.AIPDF

Songruo Chen, Yuqian Fu, Yu Li, Mingkang Dong, Sifan Zhou

TL;DR: EgoOmniWorld 用“自我—行动—世界”交互环统一组织第一人称视频理解，按节点、关系、依赖链和反馈闭环构建证据锚定问答基准。

Details

Motivation: 第一人称视频能力涉及多种模态和评测形式，但常被拆开研究；真实互动中，佩戴者感知环境、形成目标、行动改变世界并依据反馈继续决策，这些环节相互耦合。

Result: 基准将交互结构分为 Node（自我/行动/世界状态）、Edge（有向关系）、Chain（依赖链）和 Loop（闭环反馈）。数据流程从第一人称视频提取结构化互动、用视听证据落地，并按交互结构生成问题，所需模态及单/多轮格式由证据和依赖决定。数据含 24,166 组问答，其中训练 20,284、测试 3,882。对开源和闭源 MLLM 的实验显示各交互结构能力存在明显且不均衡的短板；使用该数据训练可改善域内互动理解，并迁移到既有第一人称基准。

Insight: 按互动结构而非单一问答类型组织评测，可以显式覆盖状态、因果依赖和行动反馈。摘要未列各结构分项结果、模态缺失鲁棒性或迁移增益数值，需避免把总体改进理解为所有交互能力均衡提升。

Abstract: Egocentric video understanding spans diverse capabilities, modalities, and evaluation formats, yet these are often studied in isolation despite their tight coupling in real-world interaction. We propose the Ego-Action-World interaction loop as a unifying principle: the wearer perceives the world, forms goals, acts, changes the world, and uses feedback to guide subsequent behavior. Based on this view, we introduce EgoOmniWorld, a benchmark organized around four complementary interaction structures: Node captures ego, action, and world states; Edge captures directed relations among them; Chain captures linked dependencies; and Loop captures feedback-closed interactions. We develop an interaction-first, evidence-grounded data pipeline that extracts structured interactions from egocentric videos, grounds them in visual and auditory evidence, and generates questions according to their interaction structure. Required modalities and single- or multi-turn formats follow naturally from the supporting evidence and dependencies. EgoOmniWorld contains 24,166 QA groups, including 20,284 training and 3,882 test samples. Experiments on representative open- and closed-source multimodal large language models reveal substantial and uneven limitations across interaction structures. Models trained on EgoOmniWorld improve in-domain interaction understanding and generalize to existing egocentric benchmarks. EgoOmniWorld provides a unified foundation for evaluating and advancing egocentric video understanding. Data, code, and models will be released.

[230] Meta-Video: Efficient Standardized Evaluation for Video Understanding cs.CVPDF

Soumya Shamarao Jahagirdar, Anna Kukleva, Vishaal Udandarao, Samuel Thomas, Brian Kingsbury

TL;DR: Meta-Video 揭示帧采样、预处理和输入格式等评测配置会大幅改变视频理解分数，并提供轻量基准和标准化协议以提高结果可复现性。

Details

Motivation: 视频基准分数常由黑盒评测框架的预设配置产生，默认帧采样和预处理选择很少被检查；同一模型因配置不同也可能出现明显波动，且一些题目不看视频也能回答，完整基准评测昂贵。

Result: 作者发现同一模型检查点仅因评测配置变化，准确率可相差最高 19.5 个百分点。Meta-Video 从既有套件筛选出 1,000 道平衡题、覆盖 791 段视频和多样任务/时长，在 4–128 帧完整帧数扫描实验中大体保留模型排名，评测速度提高 5 倍。作者系统扫描配置空间，整理影响结果的最佳实践与报告标准，并发布 5 个模型、7 个基准的可复现参考分数。

Insight: 配置差异可能与方法改进同量级，因此标准化帧采样、预处理和输入格式是可信比较的前提；轻量基准可降低全套评测成本。19.5 点波动来自所测配置，Meta-Video “大体保留排名”不保证所有模型排序完全一致。

Abstract: Video understanding benchmarks are the primary yardstick for measuring progress in video-language modeling, and a growing body of work relies on them to claim improvements. The reported benchmark scores in these works, however, are almost always produced by frameworks (e.g., lmms eval) used as black boxes: certain evaluation choices like frame sampling, preprocessing, and input formatting are inherited from preset defaults and seldom inspected carefully. We show these unexamined choices are a major source of variance. Even for the same model checkpoint, evaluation configuration alone can shift accuracy by up to 19.5pp. Hence, it is unclear whether reported gains reflect genuine improvements in capability or differences in evaluation setup. Moreover, many benchmark samples offer little evidence of visual capability, since they can be answered without the video, and the full suites are expensive to evaluate. We address these issues in two parts. First, we curate existing suites for discriminability and efficiency, producing Meta-Video, a balanced 1,000-question benchmark over 791 videos spanning diverse tasks and durations, which largely preserves model rankings, at 5 times inference speedup for a full-frame count sweep experiment (4-128 frames). Second, we establish a standardized evaluation protocol by sweeping the configuration space to isolate choices that measurably affect results, distill them into best practices and reporting standards, and release reproducible reference scores across five models and seven benchmarks. We hope that the proposed evaluation framework and the Meta-Video benchmark will support video understanding research by providing a reproducible and efficient foundation to measure progress in a reliable way.

[231] Beyond the Encoder: Object-Centric Representations Emerging from Segmentation Foundation Models cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Michalis Pistos, Bartłomiej W. Papież

TL;DR: 该研究将 SAM2 分割路径中生成的对象指针作为可迁移对象级表示，发现仅用分割监督学习的指针也包含肿瘤判别信息，并能用于多种下游预测。

Details

Motivation: 基础模型下游迁移通常使用编码器表示，但分割模型在执行任务时还生成紧凑对象级表示，其可迁移性尚未充分研究。

Result: 作者在两个 PET/CT 肿瘤预测任务中研究 SAM2 object pointers。仅用分割监督训练的指针，在未接触下游标签时已编码肿瘤判别信息；任务引导指针通过辅助目标联合塑造分割与下游预测表示，在癌种分类上超过传统编码器迁移和 radiomics。更具挑战的复发预测任务中，分割监督指针反而最好。表征分析发现指针与可解释 radiomics 特征相关、表示空间具有类别组织，并对肿瘤分割区域形成明确空间 grounding。摘要未给具体分数。

Insight: 基础模型执行其原始分割任务时产生的对象级表示可能比通用编码器特征更贴近下游病灶分析；任务引导适配也并非在所有任务都更好。结论来自两个 PET/CT 任务，摘要未报告队列规模、外部验证或临床变量比较。

Abstract: Foundation models are increasingly used as feature extractors for downstream tasks with limited data, typically through representations obtained from their encoders. However, foundation models trained for structured tasks such as segmentation also form object-specific representations during task execution, whose transferability remains largely unexplored. We investigate Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) object pointers, compact object-level representations produced through the segmentation pathway, as transferable representations for downstream tumour prediction. Through experiments on two PET/CT tumour prediction tasks, we find that object pointers learned using segmentation supervision alone already encode tumour-discriminative information, despite never being optimised for the downstream labels. We further introduce task-guided object pointers, where an auxiliary objective jointly shapes the object pointer space for the downstream prediction together with segmentation. Task-guided pointers improve cancer-type classification, outperforming conventional encoder-based transfer and radiomics, while segmentation-only pointers perform best on the more challenging recurrence prediction task. Representation analyses reveal associations between object pointers and interpretable radiomics features, class-dependent organisation of the learned representation space, and explicit spatial grounding around the segmented tumour. Together, these findings suggest that useful transferable representations can emerge through the execution of a foundation model’s primary task, providing an alternative to conventional encoder-based transfer.

[232] Parameter-Efficient Multimodal Brain Tumor Segmentation With Stage-Wise Shared Adapters cs.CVPDF

Milad Rostamian, Mohammadreza Mohammadi, Ender Konukoglu, Mohsen Soryani

TL;DR: BWSA 在多模态 MRI 脑肿瘤分割网络的各阶段通过共享适配路径压缩并交换模态特征，提升 Dice 且仅增加少量参数。

Details

Motivation: 不同 MRI 模态提供肿瘤互补信息；常见方法为每个模态配置独立编码器，多阶段特征交换虽有帮助却会增加模型复杂度。

Result: Block-Wise Shared Adapter 将各模态编码特征压缩到共享路径融合，再把适配后的特征送回各模态流。固定混合版本把适配特征加回原特征；TG-BWSA 在每个模态与编码器阶段学习独立门控权重。两种变体在 BraTS 2020、BraTS 2023 上使用四种分割骨干评测。BraTS 2023 官方在线验证中，BWSA 相较对应未修改骨干使平均区域 Dice 提高 1.3–7.6 个百分点；TG-BWSA 提高 2.8–7.7 个百分点。两者参数增量约 0.85%–3.73%，平均 HD95 均降低。

Insight: 共享适配器在多个模态间复用融合计算，减少为每模态单设交互模块带来的参数增长；可学习门控的增益区间整体更高。不同骨干和任务的提升幅度仍有差异，摘要未给各肿瘤区域单项分数及推理开销。

Abstract: Different MRI modalities reveal different parts of a brain tumor. Segmentation models combine information from these modalities to outline tumor regions. Many models use a separate encoder for each modality. However, exchanging features among these encoders at several stages can increase model complexity. We introduce the Block-Wise Shared Adapter (BWSA), which combines compressed features from the modality encoders in a shared path and returns adapted features to each stream. In its fixed-blending form, BWSA adds the adapted features to the original features. Its trainable-gated variant (TG-BWSA) instead learns separate weights for the original and adapted features at each modality and encoder stage. We evaluate both variants on BraTS 2020 and BraTS 2023 with four segmentation backbones. On the official BraTS 2023 online validation set, BWSA increases average region-wise Dice by 1.3–7.6 percentage points relative to the corresponding unmodified backbones. TG-BWSA increases it by 2.8–7.7 points. Both variants add approximately 0.85–3.73% parameters and reduce average HD95 relative to the unmodified backbones.

[233] LLM2R: From Large Language Models to 3D Reassemblers cs.CV | cs.AI | cs.ROPDF

Zhouhan Zhong, Qiuhong Shen, Xingyi Yang, Jinyi Xu, Xinchao Wang

TL;DR: LLM2R 将多部件 3D 装配建模为单次非自回归序列预测，用 Point-BERT/Q-Former 编码各部件，再用汇总 token 汇集完整部件集合信息并预测每件 SE(3) 位姿。

Details

Motivation: 部件摆放通常不能仅由自身几何决定，需要综合整个部件集合；成对关系方法或逐步生成—验证在部件多时扩展较差。因果注意力还使序列中较早部件无法看到后续部件。

Result: 模型把各部件压为几何 token 块并拼接，经 LoRA 适配的 decoder-only LLM 处理；追加位于所有部件之后的可学习 summary tokens 汇集全局装配信息，再由部件感知位姿头融合部件状态与摘要 token，统一预测旋转和平移。在三个 PartNet 类别上，LLM2R 的部件准确率和成功率均最高；PartNeXt 上旋转误差、平移误差和部件准确率最佳；Breaking Bad 上平移误差最低、推理最快，但精度仅低于专用骨折方法。100 部件时，它在 Breaking Bad 部件准确率比 GARF 高 33.5 点、PartNet 比 Assembler 高 29.1 点；对未见类别零样本迁移比三个基线中最强者高 16 点以上。

Insight: 将所有部件同时编码并通过末尾汇总 token补足因果注意力方向性，可在多部件场景中实现一次性全局推理。结果覆盖不同数据集，Breaking Bad 上专用方法仍更准确，说明通用装配性能并非所有类别最优。

Abstract: 3D part assembly aims to reconstruct a complete shape from a set of unassembled parts by predicting a rigid SE(3) transformation for each part. Because the placement of a part is rarely determined by its own geometry, the task demands reasoning over the entire part set, and existing methods, which rely on pairwise relations or iterative generation and verification, scale poorly to objects with many parts. We present LLM2R, which casts part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only large language model (LLM): a Point-BERT encoder and a Q-Former compress each part into a block of geometric tokens, the blocks of all parts are concatenated, and a causal LLM adapted with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) processes the sequence in one forward pass. Causal attention, however, lets the hidden states of a part observe only the parts that precede it. LLM2R therefore appends a block of learnable summary tokens after the last part: these tokens follow every part, so their states aggregate the whole assembly at a constant token cost, and a part-aware pose head fuses each part’s states with them before predicting its rotation and translation. One architecture thus handles semantic and geometric assembly and predicts all poses in a single non-autoregressive pass. LLM2R achieves the highest part accuracy and success rate on all three PartNet categories, the best rotation error, translation error, and part accuracy on PartNeXt, and the lowest translation error and fastest inference on Breaking Bad, where only a fracture-specialized method is more accurate. Its advantage grows with the number of parts: at 100 parts it exceeds GARF by 33.5 points in part accuracy on Breaking Bad and Assembler by 29.1 points on PartNet, and it transfers zero-shot to unseen categories with more than 16 points higher part accuracy than the strongest of three baselines.

[234] Rethinking Projector Training in Multimodal LLMs cs.CV | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Fabian Gröger, Naël Ouerghemi, Shuo Wen, Maria Brbić

TL;DR: PORTAL 以视觉和语言特征的模态级统计量构造最优传输投影初始化，使 MLLM 可在无配对图文数据、无梯度优化条件下跳过传统 projector 训练。

Details

Motivation: 多模态 LLM 通常先用大规模图像—描述对训练投影器，再联合训练全模型，但 projector 阶段的作用尚不明确且需配对数据。

Result: 作者发现使用仅 10%–20% 数据训练 projector 已可恢复大部分下游增益，不同数据集训练的 projector 也可线性插值并大体保留性能，说明该阶段可能主要完成粗略对齐。PORTAL 仅需各模态汇总统计，在共享主成分子空间上为视觉、语言特征的高斯近似计算最优传输映射以初始化 projector。无任何配对数据时，该初始化在 6 个 LLM 骨干、2 个视觉编码器和 16 个基准上匹配用 55.8 万图文对训练的标准流程；7 组视觉编码器—LLM 设置中的 3 组胜过标准流程，其余 4 组平均达到其 98% 分数。

Insight: 若 projector 主要做模态级粗对齐，分布统计和线性映射或可取代大规模成对训练；跨多个模型和基准的结果支持这一简化。PORTAL 在三组配置中超过基线而整体其余平均接近，并非所有组合都完全匹配；摘要未提供数据细分和后续联合训练成本。

Abstract: Multimodal LLMs are typically trained by first aligning a vision encoder with a language model via projector training on large image-caption datasets, followed by joint training of the full multimodal model. Despite its widespread use, the role of the projector training stage remains poorly understood. We find that (i) using only $10$ to $20%$ of the data for training the projector already recovers most downstream performance gains, and (ii) projectors trained on different datasets can be linearly interpolated while largely preserving performance. These results suggest that projector training mainly performs a coarse alignment, which many different projectors achieve equally well. Motivated by these findings, we propose PORTAL, a training-free projector initialization that requires neither paired image-caption data nor gradient-based optimization, but only per-modality summary statistics. PORTAL computes an optimal-transport-based map between Gaussian approximations of the vision and language feature distributions on a shared principal subspace, so that the projector training stage can be skipped entirely. Without any paired data, PORTAL matches the standard pipeline trained on 558k image-caption pairs across six LLM backbones, two vision encoders, and 16 benchmarks. It outperforms that pipeline in $3$ of $7$ (vision encoder, LLM) settings and reaches an average $98%$ of its score across the other four.

[235] MajorTOM:Elliot Pretrain, A Multi-Sensor, Multi-Temporal Pretraining Dataset for Earth Observation cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Carmen Oliver Huidobro, Mikolaj Czerkawski, Kevin Monsalvez-Pozo, Cesar Aybar, Gustau Camps-Valls

TL;DR: MajorTOM:Elliot Pretrain 提供 27.9 万块多传感器、多时间尺度地球观测数据，并通过短程预训练研究各传感器和辅助目标的价值。

Details

Motivation: 通用地球观测基础模型需要统一多传感器、不同时间采样及文本的数据，但公开数据集很少能以一致、易访问的形式同时提供这些信息。

Result: 数据集含 279,166 个 10 公里瓦片，统一到 1056×1056、10 米网格，包含 Sentinel-2 L1C、Landsat-8/9、Sentinel-1 RTC、Copernicus DEM、ESA WorldCover，以及云掩码、OSM 实体和 ERA5 天气。分为单时相 250,000 瓦片、月度 12,500 瓦片（年内 12 次）和短期 burst 16,666 瓦片（30 天内 6 次），以 6.3TB 云优化 GeoTIFF 和 TACO v3 Parquet 提供。OlmoEarth-Base 短程预训练显示：基于 AlphaEarth 嵌入挑选的 Core-S2L2A 25% 子集在 9 项基准中 8 项达到或超过全量；加入 Landsat-8/9 所有基准均不降；把 DEM/WorldCover 作为预测目标改善 8/9，而作为编码器输入使 5/9 退化；Sentinel-1 在 9 项中提升 7 项，尤其雷达任务；规则 captions 与小语言模型效果相当但无需成本。

Insight: 不仅数据量重要，传感器如何进入预训练目标也影响迁移：DEM/地表覆盖作为预测目标有益，直接输入反而可能干扰。数据发布采用云端流式和像素读取前过滤；实验为短程预训练，不能替代全规模训练的最终模型比较。

Abstract: Pretraining generalist Earth observation foundation models requires data that combine several sensors, varied temporal sampling and, increasingly, text, yet open datasets rarely provide all three in one consistent, easily accessible form. We introduce MajorTOM:Elliot Pretrain, a collection of 279,166 tiles of 10 km drawn from the Major-TOM grid by clustering AlphaEarth embeddings. Each tile stacks Sentinel-2 L1C, Landsat-8/9, Sentinel-1 RTC, Copernicus DEM and ESA WorldCover on a shared 1056x1056-pixel, 10 m grid, complemented by cloud masks, OpenStreetMap entities and ERA5 weather. The tiles are partitioned into three temporal regimes, Monotemporal (250,000 tiles, one acquisition), Monthly (12,500 tiles, twelve acquisitions spread over the annual cycle) and Burst (16,666 tiles, six acquisitions within 30 days), and are released as 6.3 TB of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs indexed by TACO v3 Parquet metadata, a standard that allows cloud streaming, efficient data access, and filtering before any pixel is read. A companion library derives sensor-tagged fact sheets, captions and 16 families of vision-language tasks from these layers at load time. We test our design choices in short pretraining runs of OlmoEarth-Base. First, a 25% subset of Major-TOM Core-S2L2A curated with AlphaEarth embeddings matches or exceeds the full corpus on 8 of 9 benchmarks. Second, on Elliot-Pretrain, adding Landsat-8/9 improves or matches Sentinel-2 only pretraining on every benchmark. Third, using DEM and WorldCover as prediction targets during pretraining further improves 8 of 9 benchmarks, while giving the same maps to the encoder as inputs degrades 5 of 9. Fourth, Sentinel-1 helps on 7 of 9 benchmarks, particularly on benchmarks with radar inputs. Fifth, rule-based captions match a small language model at no cost. The dataset is openly available at https://source.coop/major-tom/elliot-pretrain.

[236] VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction cs.CVPDF

Yuhan Zhu, Xiangyu Zeng, Qingyi Si, Chenxu Yang, Yifei Li

TL;DR: VideoJev 将视频 grounding 和多选 QA 统一为对时间区间与文本选项打分的结构化决策接口，并通过缓存或联合推理复用重复查询的视觉计算。

Details

Motivation: 视觉智能体需要根据视频及时作决定并追踪进展；传统自回归生成答案计算较重，而实际互动会围绕同一视觉历史提出新目标和中间问题，重复编码视频造成浪费。

Result: VideoJev 在预训练 MLLM 上将自回归答案解码替换为共享评分头，直接对时间片段和文本选项与视频证据的匹配打分。新问题到达时可缓存复用视觉表示，也可将多问题合并一次前向。在三个时间定位基准上，4B 和 35B-A3B 版本的平均 mIoU 比各自骨干提高 6.7、10.8 分，测得推理速度提高 2.8–3.1 倍。四个视频 QA 基准上，两者在 Thinking 模式保持与骨干相当的表现，实测速度提升超过 100 倍。

Insight: 把开放式生成转为区间/选项评分，适合需将多个结构化判断组合成工作流的场景；视觉计算复用尤其能放大多查询效率收益。超过 100 倍速度针对视频 QA 推理比较，摘要未给首 token、长答案或不同视频长度下的延迟分解。

Abstract: Visual agents must turn video observations into timely decisions to track progress and choose what to do next. Building on the emerging System One paradigm, we introduce VideoJev, a family of models that cast video understanding and interaction as structured decision tasks. We adapt pretrained multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by replacing autoregressive answer decoding with a shared head that scores temporal intervals and textual options against video evidence. These scores yield event spans or answer choices, unifying temporal grounding and multiple-choice video question answering. This combines the semantic flexibility of MLLMs with efficient decisions that agents can use directly. As an interaction unfolds, new goals and intermediate results prompt further queries about the same visual history. VideoJev therefore reuses visual computation through Cached inference for queries as they arrive and Joint inference for multiple queries in a single forward pass. Across three temporal grounding benchmarks, VideoJev-4B and VideoJev-35B-A3B improve mean mIoU over their backbones by 6.7 and 10.8 points, respectively, with measured inference speedups of $2.8$-$3.1\times$. On four video QA benchmarks, both achieve performance comparable to their backbones in Thinking mode, with measured inference speedups exceeding $100\times$. These results offer a unified, reusable decision interface for composing structured visual judgments into complex, open-ended workflows.

[237] ST-GRU PredRNN-V2: A GRU-Based Reformulation of PredRNN-V2 for Video Prediction cs.CV | cs.AIPDF

Augusta van Haren, Hanna Hoogen, Luca Pattavina, Quincy Rommen

TL;DR: ST-GRU 将 PredRNN-V2 的时空 LSTM 替换为更简单的 GRU 门控单元，在 Moving MNIST 上减少约 5% 参数，但多项指标未超过原 PredRNN-V2。

Details

Motivation: PredRNN 系列用两种记忆状态的 ST-LSTM 捕获长程时空依赖，但循环单元较复杂；研究检验 GRU 的简化门控是否可用于时空预测。

Result: ST-GRU 将每个记忆状态的三门设计替换为更新门、重置门，并将时间记忆并入隐藏状态，使参数量减少约 5%。在 Moving MNIST 原协议、平均预测 10 帧下，ST-GRU PredRNN-V2 的 MSE 为 55.1、SSIM 0.883、LPIPS 0.065、PSNR 19.53 dB。它在 MSE、SSIM、PSNR 上未超过原 ST-LSTM PredRNN-V2，但 LPIPS 更低，并与早期 ST-LSTM PredRNN 相当。

Insight: 更简单的时空单元可在保持部分感知指标的情况下减少参数，但本实验未证明其全面优于复杂单元。结果仅限 Moving MNIST 与单一协议；作者把它视为有前景的构件，而非已取代 ST-LSTM 的结论。

Abstract: Video prediction requires models to capture complex spatiotemporal dependencies and to retain relevant information over long sequences. PredRNN and its successor PredRNN-V2 address this challenge with spatiotemporal Long Short-Term Memory (ST-LSTM) units that maintain two separate memory states, at the cost of a relatively complex recurrent building block. In this work, we investigate whether the simpler gating of Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) can be transferred to spatiotemporal predictive learning. To this end, we develop a spatiotemporal GRU (ST-GRU) unit as a GRU-based alternative to the ST-LSTM. The ST-GRU replaces the ST-LSTM’s three gates per memory state with two GRU-style gates (update and reset), and merges the temporal memory state into the hidden state, which reduces the number of parameters by about 5%. We incorporate the ST-GRU into PredRNN-V2 and evaluate the resulting model on the Moving MNIST video prediction benchmark, following the original experimental protocol. Averaged over ten predicted frames, the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 achieves an MSE of 55.1, an SSIM of 0.883, an LPIPS of 0.065 and a PSNR of 19.53dB. It does not surpass the original ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2 on MSE, SSIM or PSNR, but it achieves a lower LPIPS and performs on par with the earlier ST-LSTM-based PredRNN, while using a simpler recurrent cell. These results suggest that ST-GRUs are a promising building block for spatiotemporal predictive learning and motivate further work on their design and integration.

[238] RSIgen: Reciprocal Self-Improvement for Agentic Visual Generation cs.CVPDF

Yidi Liu, Haozhe Wang, Jie Xiao, Kai Zhu, Xueyang Fu

TL;DR: RSIgen 让视觉生成智能体和生成器围绕任务共同自我改进，通过干预路由学习分配、刷新智能体动作监督并构造递归课程。

Details

Motivation: 统一多模态骨干承担理解智能体和生成器两种角色，但任务成功本身不能说明应更新哪个角色；生成器更新还可能使智能体原有动作监督过时。

Result: 动态责任路由用匹配干预比较证据、输入和可执行动作，决定学习对象并生成兼容监督。生成器更新后，在固定分支输入下重新评估已测试动作的相对效用以刷新智能体监督，再由保留角色构造下一轮课程。在 BAGEL、Qwen-Image、Wan-Image-7B 上，三轮适配后 AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 比带动作成本的 SearchGen 高 3.2–3.3 分。Wan 控制实验在匹配角色训练量下验证责任分配、在匹配适配预算下验证监督刷新，并显示更新课程来源有益。200 条真实用户请求的盲评中，相对同一基线，平局调整后的偏好分任务完成为 70.0%、视觉质量为 64.9%。

Insight: 生成器和智能体需要共同更新，但生成器能力变化会使智能体监督失配；按干预结果分配角色和周期性刷新动作标签，显式处理这一动态。提升来自三个骨干/三轮特定设置，盲评 200 个请求的结果仍需结合评审协议解读。

Abstract: Agentic visual generation produces experience that can improve the native understanding (agent) and generation roles of a unified multimodal backbone, but task success alone does not determine which role should learn. Generator updates can also make the agent’s action supervision stale. We introduce RSIgen, a task-centric reciprocal self-improvement framework linking learning allocation, supervision refresh, and recursive curriculum construction. Dynamic Responsibility Routing (DRR) uses matched interventions on evidence, inputs, and supported actions to select learning recipients and construct compatible training targets. After generator learning, RSIgen re-evaluates the relative utility of tested actions with branch inputs held fixed to refresh agent supervision; the retained roles then construct the next curriculum. Across BAGEL, Qwen-Image, and Wan-Image-7B, RSIgen improves AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 by 3.2–3.3 points over a three-cycle SearchGen adaptation with action costs. Wan controls support allocation gains at matched role-level training exposure, refresh gains at a matched adaptation budget, and benefits from updated curriculum sources while recipients continue learning. In blind evaluation on 200 real-user requests, pooled tie-adjusted preference scores against the same baseline reach 70.0% for task completion and 64.9% for visual quality.

[239] PlanPath: Exploration-Guided Orchestration for Patient-Level Pathology Reasoning cs.CV | cs.MAPDF

Jiusong Ge, Mingzhao He, Qidong Liu, Chunbao Wang, Chunze Yang

TL;DR: PlanPath 依据患者级病理问题规划跨切片证据采集，并从组织结构逐层细化到细胞，聚合多个标本的计数、比例和范围后生成可追溯答案。

Details

Motivation: 一位患者可能有数十张来自不同标本和解剖部位的切片，每张包含互补证据；既有病理智能体多逐张分析并描述形态，较少研究跨标本取证和患者级定量。

Result: PlanPath 将问题转成探索计划，路由到可能包含所需证据的切片，并以组织级、细胞级工具逐步采集数量、比例和范围，跨切片汇总到答案。作者构建肾癌和胃癌两个患者级 VQA 数据集，平均每位患者 15 张全切片图像，问答由病理医师依据诊断报告核验。PlanPath 在两套数据集总体准确率比最强基线分别高 9.4%、12.1%，接入该框架也进一步改善既有切片级智能体。

Insight: 患者级回答不仅需检索相关切片，也需将局部量化证据整合并保留来源轨迹；粗到细工具链支持这种证据聚合。摘要未提供病例数、病种分布、各类问题准确率或外部医院验证结果。

Abstract: A patient’s pathology case spans tens of slides from distinct specimens and anatomical sites, each carrying non-redundant, site-specific evidence. Forming a patient-level conclusion therefore requires locating the slides relevant to a given question and integrating complementary findings across them. However, existing pathology agents analyze one slide at a time and describe morphology rather than measure it, leaving evidence acquisition across a patient’s specimens and patient-level quantification underexplored. To address this gap, we propose PlanPath, an agentic framework for patient-level pathology visual question answering (VQA). PlanPath turns the question into an exploration plan that specifies the evidence required, routes to the slides likely to carry it, and drives coarse-to-fine acquisition from tissue architecture down to individual cells. Tissue- and cell-level tools supply the counts, proportions, and extents, which PlanPath aggregates across slides into a traceable answer. To enable evaluation, we build two patient-level VQA datasets for renal and gastric cancer, averaging 15 WSIs per patient, with pathologist-verified question-answer pairs derived from diagnostic reports. Experimental results show that PlanPath outperforms the strongest baseline by 9.4% and 12.1% in overall accuracy on the two datasets and further improves existing slide-level agents when plugged into our framework. The dataset and code are available at: https://github.com/JSGe-AI/PlanPath_1.

[240] GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models cs.CV | cs.AI | cs.LG | cs.MMPDF

Rong Li, Shijie Li, Jiangyong Huang, Lingdong Kong, Jiaming Zhou

TL;DR: GeoReader 训练轻量几何读取器，将几何信息编码成目标 VLM 可直接利用的连续 token，再在问题条件下注入空间问答，而非只追求能从潜表示重建几何。

Details

Motivation: VLM 难从 RGB 隐式关系推断公制和多视角几何。已有方法把几何特征融合后只用 QA 学习使用，或对齐 VLM 潜状态与几何特征；然而表示中“含有几何”不等于接收模型真正使用它。

Result: GeoReader 先用冻结 VLM 解码的几何描述监督轻量读取器生成连续输入 token，使其表达形式贴合目标模型已有能力；随后冻结读取器并微调 VLM 做空间 QA，按问题条件注入几何。几何描述只作为训练目标，推理时直接从连续 token 作答，无需生成几何 CoT。基于 RGB 预测几何，Qwen3-VL-4B 在 MindCube-Tiny 得分 94.3；Qwen3.5-9B 加多源 QA 混合后，在另六个空间基准平均 72.5。

Insight: 几何表示的价值取决于接收模型能否使用，而不仅是表示本身是否可解码；冻结读取器再训练 VLM，显式建立可读接口。两项成绩使用不同骨干和评测集，摘要未给基线增益数值或几何预测误差与 QA 的关系。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with metric and multi-view relationships that remain implicit in RGB observations. Geometry foundation models recover this structure from RGB, but existing methods either fuse the estimated features with visual tokens and learn to use them from question answering alone, or align VLM latents with geometry features. Capturing geometry, however, does not ensure its use: zeroing the aligned latents of a released feature-alignment model leaves its accuracy unchanged. We introduce GeoReader, a framework that learns geometric representations for the VLM that reads them. First, we train lightweight Geometric Readers to produce continuous input tokens, supervising them with geometry descriptions decoded by a frozen VLM, so that the Readers express geometry in a form the target model can already read. We then freeze the Readers to preserve this interface while fine-tuning the VLM on spatial QA, with geometry injection conditioned on the question. Geometry descriptions serve only as training targets: at inference, the VLM answers directly from the continuous geometric tokens without generating a geometry chain of thought. With geometry predicted from RGB images, our approach reaches 94.3 on MindCube-Tiny with Qwen3-VL-4B and, with a multi-source QA mixture, an average of 72.5 across six additional spatial benchmarks with Qwen3.5-9B. These results suggest that a useful geometric representation is one the receiving model can use, not merely one from which geometry can be reconstructed.

[241] Segment Where You Look: Attention as the Interface Between Language Models and Segmenters cs.CVPDF

Eslam Abdelrahman, Hamza Omar Alkaf, Yuheng Li, Siddharth Srinivasan Iyer, Nanxuan Zhao

TL;DR: AttnSeg 用 [SEG] token 对图像 patch 的注意力图直接作为分割解码器的空间提示，替代缺乏空间索引的单一隐藏向量。

Details

Motivation: 语言引导分割通常把目标位置压缩为一个 [SEG] 隐状态向量，再交给并未看到表达的像素解码器重建目标范围；但 VLM 本身已计算定义在 patch 网格上的 [SEG] 图像注意力。

Result: 冻结分割 VLM 的探针实验发现，同一探针读取 [SEG] 注意力，比读取 [SEG] 隐状态高 18–22 gIoU；注意力从隐状态获益的图像中未进一步受益，且主要集中在后层。AttnSeg 用学习到的有符号注意力头组合形成稠密提示，并直接监督该提示。两阶段训练先让 VLM 不带解码器学习定位，再训练解码器细化。在 Sa2VA 上，4B 模型 ReasonSeg 提高 6.4 gIoU、GS-Eval 提高 10.2；相较同数据微调模型分别高 4.2、9.6。14B 上分别提高 8.8、11.3。物体部件、多目标和单物体任务增益为 13–18 gIoU；stuff 区域几乎无增益，因为解码器本可恢复。

Insight: 空间注意力比无空间索引的语义向量更适合作为分割接口，并可揭示目标在 patch 网格上的定位证据。收益集中于需要精确指称和区分目标的类别，stuff 区域基本不变；需注意报告的 18–22 是相同探针下的预实验差异，与最终模型基准增益不同。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) that segment from language must pass the location of the referent to a pixel decoder. The dominant interface compresses it into the hidden state of a single [SEG] token, a d-dimensional vector with no spatial index, and leaves the decoder, which never sees the expression, to recover the referent’s extent. We show that the VLM already computes a better signal: the [SEG] token’s attention over the image tokens, which is defined on the patch grid by construction. Probing a frozen segmentation VLM, we find that this attention yields 18 to 22 more gIoU than the [SEG] hidden state when read by the same probe, that it gains nothing from the image where the hidden state does, and that it is concentrated in the late layers. Building on these findings, we introduce AttnSeg, which replaces the [SEG] embedding with this attention as the decoder’s prompt. A learned, signed combination of the attention heads forms a dense spatial prompt, and an attention-guidance objective supervises it directly. A two-stage recipe first trains the VLM to localize without the decoder, then trains the decoder to refine, within the budget of standard fine-tuning. Applied to Sa2VA, AttnSeg improves ReasonSeg by 6.4 gIoU and GS-Eval by 10.2 at 4B (4.2 and 9.6 over the same model fine-tuned on the same data), and by 8.8 and 11.3 at 14B. The gains reach 13 to 18 gIoU on object parts, multiple objects, and single objects, where the referent must be singled out, and are negligible on stuff regions, which the decoder already recovers unaided. Code and models are available at https://eslambakr.github.io/attseg_project_page/

[242] Concealed Handgun Detection using WiFi Signals cs.CVPDF

Erik Persson, David Gustafsson, Tomas Wilkinson

TL;DR: WiFire 使用 WiFi 信道状态信息检测遮挡或隐藏手枪，并提供与 RGB 图像对齐的数据集及视觉监督模型 WiFireNet。

Details

Motivation: 摄像监控难以识别遮挡目标，金属探测器通常需要人员逐个通过狭窄入口；在拥挤场景中二者都可能受限，WiFi 信号可作为补充感知模态。

Result: 作者收集对齐的 WiFi 信号和 RGB 图像构成 WiFire 数据集，并提出以视觉监督训练的 WiFireNet，从 WiFi CSI 检测隐藏手枪。实验显示仅凭 WiFi 信号可以检测隐藏手枪，作者认为其有望补充摄像头和金属探测器。摘要没有报告数据规模、检测准确率、误报率或不同遮挡场景结果。

Insight: 该工作探索不依赖可见光的隐藏目标检测，但目前摘要只支持“可行性”结论；安全部署还需重点考察误报、不同环境与设备差异，以及隐私和实际安检流程影响。

Abstract: While conventional camera-based surveillance systems and metal detectors can provide a sufficient level of security when used appropriately, they have fundamental limitations that reduce their applicability. Camera-based systems are unable to detect occluded or concealed threats and metal detectors require each person to enter through a narrow opening one at a time, leading to congestion issues and limited use in large crowds. A WiFi-based security system has the potential to be a complementary modality that is able to handle occlusions or concealment and is not hindered by strict spatial configurations. In this paper, we propose use Channel State Information estimated from WiFi-signals to detect concealed handguns. To this end we collect a dataset of aligned WiFi signals and RGB images that we call the WiFire dataset. We also propose a deep learning model called WiFireNet tailored to detect concealed handguns in WiFi signals using vision-based supervision signals. Our results show that concealed handgun detection is possible in WiFi and has promise as a complementary modality to surveillance cameras and metal detectors. We release the dataset, model and code to facilitate the further research into WiFi-based handgun detection.

[243] Context-aware Bayesian Fusion for Multimodal Object Detection cs.CVPDF

Arunachalam Venkatachalam, Mhafuzul Islam, Marwan Yusuf, David Van Hamme, Ben Stoffelen

TL;DR: 该方法用环境上下文门控网络动态校准预训练相机与 LiDAR 检测器输出，无需为不同雾天条件重新训练基础检测器。

Details

Motivation: 恶劣天气和低照度会降低行人及道路参与者检测可靠性；按运行环境重训检测器需要大量标注、算力和时间。

Result: 上下文感知晚期融合将轻量门控网络接入概率校准框架，估计环境条件并动态调制预训练检测器输出。在不同雾浓度增强的 KITTI 修改版上，作者报告相较非自适应晚期融合基线，相对提升约 14%，不同雾级下平均精度维持在 56%。摘要未给各天气子集精度及参与融合的检测器名称。

Insight: 把环境变化适配放在检测器输出融合层，可以避免重训各模态主干；概率校准与上下文门控共同调节传感器可信度。结果来自雾级增强 KITTI，不能直接推断到真实雾、雨、雪或低照度条件。

Abstract: Reliable detection of pedestrians and road users is essential for the safe operation of autonomous vehicles. However, this task becomes increasingly challenging under adverse environmental conditions, such as poor weather and low lighting, where the performance of state-of-the-art pre-trained object detectors and on-board sensors tends to degrade, which limits their effectiveness and reliability. Moreover, retraining models for each operating context imposes significant constraints due to high data requirements, computational resources, and time. Considering this, we propose a novel context-aware multimodal late fusion approach that integrates a lightweight gating network within our probabilistic calibration framework. The gating network extracts environmental context and dynamically modulates the detection outputs of pre-trained object detectors based on the inferred context, without retraining of the detectors. Our methodology is evaluated on a modified KITTI dataset, in which the camera images and lidar pointclouds are augmented for varying fog levels. Experimental results show that our approach yields an approximately 14% relative improvement over non-adaptive late fusion baselines, achieving a consistent average precision of 56% across different fog levels.

[244] GAD: Geometry Attention Distillation for Consistent Video Generation cs.CVPDF

Junfeng Ni, Ziyu Zhu, Fan Jiang, Yu Liu, Chiyu Wang

TL;DR: GAD 将冻结几何模型在干净视频中的跨帧对应注意力蒸馏到视频扩散模型，并按噪声步选择蒸馏层，以提升长程场景和动态对象一致性。

Details

Motivation: 视频扩散模型短时生成画面质量较好，但长时间生成时常无法保持场景几何和对象结构；现有注意力对跨帧对应的响应分散，难以稳定传递结构信息。

Result: 几何模型抽取同一静态表面或运动对象跨帧对应关系，并监督视频注意力；考虑高噪声时结构先在深层形成、低噪声时在浅层形成，蒸馏层随噪声时间步变化。三个视频骨干实验均报告长程场景及动态时间一致性改善，且不同生成长度下有几何收益。Wan2.2 5B 上两个长程基准的跨帧匹配准确率至少比 Wan 基线高 30%；无需额外推理模块。

Insight: 固定层蒸馏可能与不同去噪阶段的结构形成位置不匹配，按噪声调节层级有助于将几何对应注入适当阶段。至少 30% 是跨帧匹配指标的提升，摘要未提供各基准绝对值或感知质量取舍。

Abstract: Video diffusion models generate visually compelling short-term sequences but often struggle to preserve scene geometry and object structure over time. In this paper, we first demonstrate that current video attention cannot identify reliable correspondences across frames, with responses dispersed across multiple regions even after recognizable scene structure has emerged. We argue that reliable cross-frame associations are essential for information exchange as scene structure forms in video generation. Thus, we introduce Geometry Attention Distillation (GAD), which transfers correspondences from a frozen geometry model’s attention to video attention. Extracted from clean videos, these correspondences link the same static surface or moving object across frames. Since structure formation begins in deeper layers at higher noise and shallower layers at lower noise, we apply attention distillation at a student layer selected according to the noise timestep. After training, video attention focuses more consistently on corresponding locations. Experiments across all three video backbones demonstrate improved long-range scene consistency and dynamic temporal consistency, with geometric gains across generation lengths. On Wan2.2 5B, GAD improves cross-frame matching accuracy by at least 30% over the Wan baseline on both long-range benchmarks. Notably, GAD achieves these gains without additional inference modules, offering a promising approach to efficient and consistent video-based world simulation. Project page: https://fantasy-amap.github.io/GAD/.

[245] DuplexBridge: Coordinating Understanding and Generation for Unified Image Editing cs.CVPDF

Yidi Liu, Jie Xiao, Chaojie Mao, Jingfeng Zhang, Xueyang Fu

TL;DR: DuplexBridge 用统一模型的理解能力为其图像编辑生成角色构造源图锚定条件，并通过不同的局部监督和互信门控平衡请求理解、编辑执行与内容保留。

Details

Motivation: 复杂图像编辑要求准确理解任务并忠实执行，但失败结果无法表明是任务解释还是生成环节出了问题；统一系统还需确保未要求修改的内容保留。

Result: 桥接表示明确目标、最终变化和保留约束。理解模块只按原请求忠实度监督、不观察生成图像；生成模块按其实际接收条件监督执行。互信检查门控选择性接纳全局任务反馈，同时保留各模块独立有效的局部监督。作者构建 CE-Bench，含 1,200 个同时测量变化与保留要求的任务。三种配置中，完整系统比直接编辑器的完全合规率高 21.75–25.75 个百分点，并在 KRIS-Bench、RISEBench、ImgEdit、GEdit-Bench 上改善。统一 Wan-Image 监督初始化下，门控联合训练完全合规率为 77.08%，无门控为 70.92%；保留两门但让生成局部监督检查原始任务则为 75.00%。

Insight: 把理解和生成的责任分开监督，并选择性共享全局反馈，可减少错误归因及过度改动；CE-Bench 同时要求满足编辑和保留约束，避免只看目标是否出现。完全合规提升是在作者协议下，摘要未报告人评规模和不同编辑难度分项。

Abstract: Complex image editing requires faithful task interpretation and accurate execution, but a failed edit does not reveal which responsibility failed. We present DuplexBridge, which uses a unified model’s own understanding capability to enhance prompts for its own generation capability, without an external understanding module. A source-grounded bridge specifies targets, final-state changes, and preservation constraints. Understanding is supervised on fidelity to the original request without observing the generated image; generation is supervised on execution of the condition it actually receives. Reciprocal trust checks selectively admit global task feedback to each role while retaining independently valid local supervision. We introduce CE-Bench, a 1,200-task benchmark measuring joint satisfaction of task-derived change and preservation requirements. Across three model configurations, the full system improves complete compliance over direct editors by 21.75-25.75 percentage points, with gains also observed on KRIS-Bench, RISEBench, ImgEdit, and GEdit-Bench. From a common supervised Wan-Image initialization, gated joint training reaches 77.08% complete compliance, compared with 70.92% without gates and 75.00% when generation-local supervision instead checks the original task with both gates retained. These results support distinct local responsibilities and selective shared feedback for joint understanding-generation adaptation.

[246] OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding cs.CV | cs.CL | cs.MMPDF

Xuyang Liu, Shihao Wang, Xinyu Wei, Minghan Li, Zeqing Wang

TL;DR: OmniCompass 将全模态视频评测拆为视频语言与音视频两条轨道，每条覆盖时间定位、空间定位和问答，并用文本与文本+图像配对目标检查模型指称一致性。

Details

Motivation: 现有视频基准通常只覆盖部分能力，难以系统诊断全模态视频理解；也较少同时评测何时出现、位于何处及发生什么。

Result: OmniCompass-VL 含 820 个视频、2,460 个实例，覆盖不同领域和短/中/长时长；OmniCompass-AV 子集含叙事和音频丰富的 240 个视频、720 个实例。VL 问答涵盖 5 类感知和 3 类推理，AV 问答涵盖 3 类感知和 2 类推理。每个样例在文本-only 与文本+图像两种配对设置下评测，同一目标由文字或视觉语言指引指定；所有实例经人工多轮质检。对 50 个 MLLM 的评估发现开源模型落后于专有模型，尤其音视频理解；即便领先模型在时空定位上仍有困难，且对配对目标指称会给出不一致预测。

Insight: 配对目标指称可诊断模型是否真正理解目标，而不是只依赖某一输入形式；时空 grounding 与问答并列也利于分解能力。摘要未列各模型具体分数或人工标注者数量，AV 子集规模也小于 VL 主轨。

Abstract: With the rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), evaluating their video understanding capabilities has become increasingly important. Existing video understanding benchmarks cover only part of the evaluation dimensions, limiting systematic diagnosis of omni-modal video understanding. We introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding. OmniCompass defines two evaluation tracks: OmniCompass-VL assesses vision-language models on tasks requiring visual evidence, while OmniCompass-AV assesses omni-modal models on tasks requiring joint audio-visual evidence. Each track includes three complementary tasks: temporal grounding (TG), spatial grounding (SG), and question answering (QA), assessing when a referenced target appears, where it is, and what happens. QA covers five perception and three reasoning categories in OmniCompass-VL, and three perception and two reasoning categories in OmniCompass-AV. OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos and 2,460 instances across domains and three duration types: short, medium, and long. A narrative- and audio-rich subset forms OmniCompass-AV with 240 videos and 720 instances. Each instance is evaluated under two paired settings: text-only and text+image, specifying the same target through text and visual-language guidance. All instances are manually annotated with multi-round quality verification. Evaluations of 50 MLLMs show that open-source models still lag behind proprietary counterparts, particularly in audio-visual understanding. Precise temporal and spatial grounding remains challenging even for leading models, and their predictions still exhibit inconsistencies across the paired target specifications.

[247] Game2Real-Bench: Do Toy Games Reveal and Transfer to Real-World Visual Reasoning? cs.CVPDF

Qingan Liu, Juntong Feng, Yue Zhu, Yujie Cheng, Xinzhe Han

TL;DR: Game2Real-Bench 比较程序化玩具游戏与现实视觉推理能力及迁移，发现模型在两类任务上的能力排序高度相关，但游戏示例对不同能力产生相反迁移。

Details

Motivation: 真实图像保留自然复杂度，程序化游戏可生成可控任务和可验证答案；尚不清楚玩具游戏测出的能力是否对应现实推理，游戏示范是否能迁移。

Result: 基准覆盖细粒度感知、空间推理、约束推理、顺序规划四类能力，含 1,000 个可执行验证游戏样本和 400 个按共享推理需求而非视觉相似度配对的现实样本。25 个 VLM 的游戏—现实能力一致性较高，Pearson 和 Spearman 相关分别为 0.935。对四个模型的一次性游戏到现实迁移实验显示，约束推理对部分模型改善，而细粒度感知在提供游戏示范后下降。另构建近 24,000 个验证游戏样本，覆盖 18 项任务、65 类问答。

Insight: 玩具任务能力与现实视觉推理的模型间排序高度相关，但高相关不意味着演示迁移对所有能力都有益；约束推理和细粒度视觉感知的迁移方向不同。仅四个模型参加迁移实验，样本量和提示格式对结论的影响需进一步验证。

Abstract: Visual reasoning is an important capability for vision-language models (VLMs) to understand visual evidence, spatial structure, constraints, and state changes. Existing evaluations mainly rely on real-world data or procedurally generated tasks. Real-world data preserve natural complexity, while procedural games provide controllable generation and verifiable solutions. However, it remains unclear whether abilities measured in toy games correspond to real-world visual reasoning and whether game examples can support transfer. We introduce Game2Real-Bench, a benchmark that studies these connections across four capability groups, including fine-grained perception, spatial reasoning, constraint reasoning, and sequential planning. We construct 1,000 procedurally generated game samples with executable verification and curate 400 real-world samples aligned by shared reasoning requirements rather than visual similarity. We evaluate 25 representative VLMs and observe strong game-to-real consistency, with Pearson and Spearman correlations of 0.935. We further study one-shot game-to-real transfer on four models. Constraint reasoning improves for several models, while fine-grained perception declines with game demonstrations. We also construct Game2Real-Dataset with nearly 24K verified game samples across 18 tasks and 65 QA families. Our benchmark, dataset, and code are available at https://github.com/QingAnLiu/Game2Real-Bench.

[248] Plan-Bench: Can Existing VLMs Go Well Beyond Perception to Reason and Plan in Embodied Worlds? cs.CVPDF

Juntong Feng, Qingan Liu, Jingru Dong, Yue Zhu, Weiming Zheng

TL;DR: Plan-Bench 将 VLM 具身规划评测与动作执行隔离，考察其在物理任务中的空间整合、时间状态推理和约束下多步计划能力。

Details

Motivation: VLM 在视觉和空间理解上表现较强，但物理任务还需整合空间信息、推理状态变化并制定多步计划；需要区分规划能力本身与执行器成功率。

Result: 基准覆盖三个维度、16 个子类和 699 个精选样本，并尽量隔离动作执行因素。对 28 个 VLM 的评测显示仍有明显改进空间；即使最强模型准确率也只有 75.0%。作者还发现模型规模扩大通常有助于这些能力，消融表明大模型作为高层规划器的潜力更大。摘要未提供各维度具体成绩。

Insight: 即使不考虑低层动作执行，现有模型在具身世界高层推理与计划上仍未达到可靠水平。699 样本的轻量探针有利于比较，但具体任务分布和准确率不能直接代表真实机器人执行能力。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in visual perception and spatial reasoning, leading to growing interest in using them as high-level planners for embodied AI. However, physical tasks require models to integrate spatial information, reason over temporal states, and generate multi-step plans under various constraints, raising the question of whether current VLMs can reliably support such reasoning and planning independently of execution. We introduce Plan-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating the high-level reasoning and multi-step planning capabilities of VLMs relevant to embodied worlds, while isolating the influence of action execution. It covers three complementary dimensions, spanning 16 subclasses and 699 curated samples. Extensive evaluation of 28 VLMs reveals room for improvement, with even the strongest model achieving only 75.0% accuracy. We further find that model scaling generally improves these capabilities. Ablation studies also indicate larger models show increasing potential as high-level planners. Overall, Plan-Bench provides a lightweight probe for evaluating VLMs’ reasoning and planning capabilities relevant to embodied environments and assessing their potential as decision makers for physical tasks. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/MinneFeng/Plan-Bench.

[249] RepProbe: Can Video Language Models Count Repeated Actions? A Diagnostic Benchmark cs.CVPDF

Mahsa Khoshnoodi, Sarah Adel Bargal

TL;DR: RepProbe 用含 1–20 次完整重复动作的真实与合成视频诊断 VLM 计数能力，发现模型内部仍编码次数信息，但最终输出常坍缩到少数偏好的数字。

Details

Motivation: 视频语言模型能流畅描述动作，却不一定能准确识别并计数时间上重复出现的动作循环。

Result: 基准含 42,000 段视频，控制重复次数、片段位置、时间覆盖和持续时长。各模型在较高重复次数上的计数准确率明显下降，控制实验显示单靠帧采样不足以解释。对比最终层表示线性探针与模型答案发现，即使模型报错，重复次数信息仍可线性解码；错误主要发生在输出阶段，模型答案集中到少量偏好数字，而非输出表示中已有的信息。该表示—输出分离在真实和合成视频上均成立，且不能由时长、位置或场景内容解释。摘要未列各模型具体准确率。

Insight: 计数失败可能不是视频表征缺乏周期信息，而是模型无法将内部信息可靠映射为数值答案；因此只提升视觉编码未必能解决计数。结论来自特定重复动作基准，线性可解码不等于模型可实际利用信息。

Abstract: Repetition counting requires identifying and enumerating action cycles over time. While state-of-the-art video language models describe actions fluently, they fail to reliably count how many times an action repeats. To investigate this limitation, we introduce RepProbe, a benchmark of 42K real and synthetic video clips containing exactly k in [1, 20] complete repetitions, with controls for clip position, temporal coverage, and duration. These controls allow us to study the counting failure directly and locate where in the model it arises. Counting accuracy collapses at high counts across the video language models we evaluate, and controlled experiments show this collapse is not explained by frame sampling alone. We compare model outputs with linear probes trained on the final-layer representations used to generate those outputs. We find a consistent representation-to-output dissociation: substantial count information remains linearly decodable even when models fail to report the correct count. Further analysis shows this failure arises primarily at the output stage, where answers concentrate on a small set of preferred numbers rather than the available count information. The dissociation holds on both real and synthetic videos and is not explained by clip duration, position, or scene content. These results indicate that models encode repetition structure but do not reliably report it in their outputs. Project page: https://arenaa.github.io/RepProbe-webpage/

[250] Visual Tokens on Demand: Visual Budgeting for Scalable and Efficient Multi-Image Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs cs.CVPDF

Aimon Rahman, Joymallya Chakraborty, Vidit Bansal, Abhishek Dan

TL;DR: mmVB 为多图推理按图像分配查询条件化 token 预算，利用跨图上下文决定压缩比例，无需重训基础 MLLM 或在推理时读取注意力矩阵。

Details

Motivation: 多图输入中每张图增加大量视觉 token，编码和注意力成本高；单图压缩方法未充分处理跨图冗余、稀疏证据及比较、计数、时间推理所需的局部细节，部分方法还依赖难以访问的注意力矩阵或重训基础模型。

Result: mmVB 是轻量可插拔模块，结合跨图上下文为每张图分配与查询相关的 token 预算，新增 160 万可训练参数，将视觉输入 token 降低 9 倍。作者报告首 token 时延降低 5 倍、预填充 FLOPs 减少 7 倍，同时在八个多图推理基准上保持完整分辨率准确率的 94.4%。摘要未列模型、基准名称及不同压缩率成绩。

Insight: 跨图信息可帮助识别冗余并为各图像动态分配视觉预算，避免每图固定压缩率误删比较所需证据。94.4% 是八基准总体保留表现；摘要未说明多轮生成速度、预算分配失效情形或新增模块训练数据。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models have advanced rapidly, but most remain optimized for single-image inputs. Multi-image reasoning is costly because each image adds many visual tokens, increasing encoding and attention demands. Existing techniques that address the above issue, including visual token pruning, token merging, visual token compression, learned resampling, hierarchical compression, retrieval-augmented visual reasoning, and memory-based architectures, have largely been designed for single-image scenarios, where redundancy is primarily spatial and local. Multi-image reasoning introduces additional challenges: redundancy may occur across images, task-relevant evidence may be sparse or distributed, and aggressive per-image compression can remove details needed for comparison, counting, temporal reasoning, retrieval, or evidence grounding. Moreover, existing token-reduction methods are often either (i) training-free but inference-inefficient, typically relying on accessing attention matrices to get token-importance that may be impractical to access with memory-efficient attention implementations such as FlashAttention, or (ii) training-dependent, requiring the base MLLM to be retrained or adapted to a new compressed-token paradigm. In this work, we study scalable multi-image reasoning and understanding without retraining the base model and without accessing attention matrices at inference time. To this end, we propose mmVB, a lightweight plug-and-play module that assigns query-conditioned per-image token budgets via cross-image context, adding only 1.6M trainable parameters while reducing visual input tokens by 9x. This reduction yields 5x faster time-to-first-token and 7x fewer prefill FLOPs, while maintaining 94.4% of full-resolution accuracy across eight multi-image reasoning benchmarks.

[251] PLAYGROUND: Progressive Layout Generation with Render-Grounded Planning cs.CVPDF

Jaeho Lee, Junhwan Heo, Junghyun Park, WonJun Moon, Eunju Yang

TL;DR: PlayGround 将可编辑图形布局生成为渐进反馈循环：检索器找结构相似参考，规划器根据当前渲染画布组织下一功能组，生成器预测可编辑属性，验证器评估并反馈修订。

Details

Motivation: 迭代生成和视觉细化更接近真实设计流程，但许多方法在执行前就固定高层计划，无法适应画布和剩余元素随生成逐步变化。

Result: 输入为无序设计元素。Structure-Aware Retriever 先推断粗布局结构并检索相似设计；每轮 Progressive Planner 查看渲染画布和剩余元素，规划下一功能组构图，Layout Generator 生成可编辑布局属性，Visual Verifier 评估渲染候选并在必要时提出反馈。作者构建两阶段数据生成流程，从完成设计中提取功能组和逐轮计划轨迹，用于步骤级训练。在 Crello 和 LICA 上，实验报告优于既有方法。摘要未给具体指标或增益数值。

Insight: 根据实际渲染结果动态规划，能把生成计划与当前画布闭环连接，而不是一次性执行固定蓝图；检索、规划、布局预测和验证分工也服务可编辑性。结果目前定性，摘要未量化推理轮次、设计质量或与非渐进流程的成本差异。

Abstract: Generating editable graphic designs requires arranging visual and textual elements into a coherent composition while preserving their content and editability. Although recent MLLM-based approaches employ iterative generation and visual refinement to reflect the real-world design workflows, their high-level plans are predetermined prior to execution, limiting their adaptability as the design evolves. To address this limitation, we propose PlayGround, a progressive layout generation framework that dynamically adapts to the current rendered canvas. PlayGround establishes a progressive design loop comprising a Progressive Planner, a Layout Generator, and a Visual Verifier, guided by a Structure-Aware Retriever. Given an initial set of unordered elements, the Structure-Aware Retriever initially infers a coarse layout structure to retrieve structurally similar reference designs. Subsequently, at each turn, the Progressive Planner examines the current rendered canvas alongside the remaining elements, forms the next functional group, and plans its composition. The Layout Generator then predicts editable layout attributes, while the Visual Verifier evaluates rendered candidates and provides feedback when refinement is necessary. To train the Progressive Planner with step-wise supervision, we construct a two-stage data generation pipeline that extracts functional groups and turn-level planning trajectories from completed designs. Experiments on Crello and LICA demonstrate the effectiveness of PlayGround over existing methods. Our code and weights will be publicly released.

[252] Cepheid: Decoupling Scale from Structure for Cross-Family Motion Completion cs.CV | cs.GR | cs.LGPDF

Chih-Hai Su, Tsung-Wei Ke, Yu-Lun Liu

TL;DR: Cepheid 将运动残差的结构与幅度解耦，学习无量纲运动先验，并从可观测量估计未知物理尺度，以改善跨几何家族的稀疏到稠密网格运动补全。

Details

Motivation: 从稀疏顶点位移恢复稠密网格运动时，单一几何家族训练的残差先验常在新家族上不如无参数调和扩展；残差幅度还会随几何家族变化一个数量级以上，并在观测更密时塌缩，测试时目标运动尺度未知。

Result: 方法学习无量纲残差结构，从可观测量估计物理幅度，并只用训练源拟合轻量修正。统一模型在所有评估几何家族上超过调和扩展，包括未见布料和腿足身体；无需骨架、配准或跨网格对应。相同先验无需重训即可用于点跟踪动物视频和机器人抓取软物体。摘要未提供基准数值或误差改善幅度。

Insight: 跨家族失败不仅是结构先验迁移问题，也源于残差尺度随目标和观测密度变化；分开学习结构与尺度可更稳健地复用。摘要未给不同家族的定量结果，真实视频/机器人迁移也未说明测试样本规模。

Abstract: Sparse-to-dense motion completion recovers dense mesh motion from sparse vertex displacements. Residual priors trained on one geometry family frequently fail to beat parameter-free harmonic extension off-family. Moreover, cross-family training meets a scaling barrier: residual amplitude varies by more than an order of magnitude across geometry families and collapses as observations become denser. Since this scale depends on unknown target motion, it cannot be measured directly at test time. We decouple residual structure from physical scale by learning a dimensionless prior, estimating amplitude from observables and a lightweight correction fitted only on training sources. Our unified model surpasses harmonic extension across all evaluated families, including unseen cloth and legged bodies, without skeletons, registration, or cross-mesh correspondence. The same prior applies without retraining to point-tracked animal video and a robot grasping a soft body. Project page: https://su-terry.github.io/cepheid-website/
