Insight: 机器审美并非单一稳定偏好：模型对视觉内容较易形成共识，但音乐与影像的偏好不能相互替代；与播放量的正相关也会随艺人群体变化。该研究属于 K-pop 案例分析，相关关系不能视为模型偏好导致市场热度的证据。

Abstract: As foundation models enter creative industries, understanding their aesthetic preferences becomes an important step toward AI-assisted creative decision making. In this work, we investigate how foundation models evaluate creative content and characterize their ``machine taste’’ using K-pop songs and music videos as a testbed. We formulate aesthetic evaluation as a pairwise ranking problem and systematically examine pairwise inter-model agreement, group-level consensus, and cross-modal preference alignment. Our results reveal stronger pairwise inter-model agreement and group-level consensus in visual evaluation than in audio evaluation, while preferences across the two modalities remain weakly aligned. We further examine how visual consensus rankings relate to real-world popularity using historical YouTube viewership data, finding positive but varying correlations across artist groups. These findings provide initial insights into machine aesthetic preferences and lay the groundwork for future AI-assisted creative decision making that considers creative content, artist identity, audience preferences, and market dynamics.

[320] Auditing Failure Attribution: Label Predictability and Judge Behavior cs.CL | cs.AI | cs.LGPDF

Tianyang Xu, Jing Gao

TL;DR: 该研究提出四类测试审计 LLM 故障归因基准是否真正要求核查出错步骤，还是只利用表面线索，并展示评测排名会受线索、输入范围和聚合指标影响。

Details

Motivation: 故障归因评测的高分应代表裁判模型将错误步骤与运行过程交叉核对，但可预测标签的表面线索也可能让模型轻易猜中，从而把线索利用误当作诊断能力。

Result: 作者提出输入限制、线索跟随、残差准确率和聚合效应四类审计。在三个基准上，简单预测器可达到或超过 GPT-4.1。两个 Who&When Pro 系统中，仅读某一步推理的分类器就能找到 95%–100% 的故障步骤；某系统的错误注入使故障后没有推理文本，针对其标签微调的裁判比 GPT-4.1 高 41 分；加入与任务相关的后续推理后，微调裁判下降 31–99 分，而零样本裁判最多下降 9 分。在 Aegis 上，“责怪所有智能体”与 GPT-4.1 的 micro-F1 相当，但 exact-set accuracy 低 19 分。

Insight: 故障归因的指标高分未必意味着模型核对了因果过程；要报告输入依赖、线索干预、线索控制后的能力以及聚合指标变化。示例反映了特定基准标注和注错方式下的捷径，不等于所有裁判均使用相同线索。

Abstract: Failure-attribution benchmarks ask an LLM judge which step or agent caused a failure. A high score should mean the judge checked the faulty step against the run (a cross-step check). However, spurious signals (surface cues) that predict the annotation can produce a high score. In this paper, we propose four tests to separate checking from cue use. Input restriction asks whether partial input predicts the annotation. Cue following checks whether moved cues change answers. Residual accuracy scores judges where cue-only predictors fail. Aggregation asks whether the failure mix or metric changes rankings. Real observations motivate these tests: on three benchmarks, simple predictors match or beat GPT-4.1. In two Who&When Pro systems, a classifier reading one step’s reasoning finds 95-100% of faulty steps, motivating input restriction. In one of them, error injection leaves no reasoning after the faulty step; judges fine-tuned on its labels beat GPT-4.1 by 41 points. Adding task-related reasoning after that step moves this cue: fine-tuned judges lose 31-99 points, but zero-shot judges lose at most 9, motivating cue following. On Aegis, blaming every agent matches GPT-4.1 on micro-F1 but trails by 19 points in exact-set accuracy, motivating aggregation. We recommend reporting these tests when developing failure-attribution benchmarks.

[321] Efficiently Learning To Reason or Not to Reason: Root-token Policy Optimization for Adaptive Thinking cs.CL | cs.AIPDF

Taehyeon Kim, Hyunsoo Lee, Youngsoo Jang, Moontae Lee

TL;DR: RPO 仅对推理模型的根 token（是否进入思考模式）进行组策略优化，使模型根据问题难度决定是否展开推理，降低自适应思考训练成本。

Details

Motivation: 大推理模型常对难度不同的查询都生成长推理，造成过度思考；开源模型缺少高效学会何时思考的机制，而既有自适应推理训练成本较高。

Result: Root-token Policy Optimization 使用组相对奖励及组内优势，只训练决定是否启动 <think> 的初始分支 token。作者在多个模型家族和规模上报告模型学会了按难度自适应思考，训练计算量约为既有自适应推理方法的 2%。摘要未报告具体模型、任务准确率、推理长度变化或显存节省幅度。

Insight: 若决策分支主要由开场 token 决定，只优化这一步可能以低成本获得计算路由能力。不过摘要没有说明 2% 的对照方法和算力口径，也未提供准确率/质量变化，无法判断训练省下的成本是否伴随决策性能取舍。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by externalizing explicit reasoning traces before producing the answer, yet suffer from overthinking challenge that allocates uniformly heavy computation to queries of varying difficulty. While proprietary models mitigate this via opaque routing, open-source LRMs still lack an efficient mechanism to internalize adaptive reasoning due to both expensive training cost and limited disclosure of training recipes. In response, we introduce RPO (Root-token Policy Optimization), a framework that enables LRMs to self-determine when to reason by training only the initial root token (e.g., whether to invoke the tag) via group relative reward and group-wise advantages. By focusing on this pivotal branching point, RPO drastically reduces training overhead and VRAM usage. Across multiple model families and scales, RPO learns difficulty-aware adaptive thinking at just ~2% of the training compute of prior adaptive-reasoning methods.

[322] Many Right Answers, One Training Example: Removing Responder Noise from GRPO for LLM Recommenders cs.CLPDF

Xin Li, Hao Jiang, Jinghao Guo, Weisi Lin, Chau Yuen

TL;DR: ReMaRk 将同一推荐请求下多位回复者提出的标题合并成联合奖励目标，降低 GRPO 训练受单条抽样回复噪声支配的问题。

Details

Motivation: 推荐帖往往有多种合理答案，但 Rank-GRPO 每个样本只抽一条回复作奖励。作者报告该随机选择解释了其 advantage 方差的 85%，使优化信号更多取决于抽中了哪位回复者，而非推荐列表本身质量。

Result: ReMaRk 对每个生成列表一次性与所有回复标题的并集评分，并对请求等概率采样。在 7 个骨干、3 个数据集上，它用相当于逐回复训练 25%–53% 的步数达到 Rank-GRPO 2,000 步的验证召回率，并在该预算下领先；训练至两方法均不再提升时，ReMaRk 均未显著落后，且 7 组对比中有 4 组用更少 GPU 小时达到 Rank-GRPO 的最佳结果。相同奖励在每题约 100 名回答者的 ProtoQA 上也有效。

Insight: 多答案任务应把请求视作学习单位，并联合评价多种有效答案，降低回复者抽样带来的方差。结果覆盖推荐和常识问答两个设定；“标题并集”奖励能否适用于答案冲突、排序偏好或个性化权重不同的任务，摘要尚未讨论。

Abstract: A recommendation request on Reddit draws several replies, each naming different titles. When an LLM recommender is trained on such threads with reinforcement learning (RL), which replies should a generated list be rewarded against? The state-of-the-art recipe, Rank-GRPO, picks one reply per training example, so the advantage mostly records which reply was drawn (85% of its variance) rather than how good the list is. We argue that RL should train on the request, not on each answer, and propose ReMaRk: it scores every list once against the union of all replies’ titles and samples each request equally. This makes RL cheaper. On seven backbones and three datasets, ReMaRk reaches the validation recall of 2,000 per-reply RL steps in 25 to 53% of the steps and leads at that budget; trained until neither improves, it is never significantly behind Rank-GRPO and in four of seven pairs reaches Rank-GRPO’s best with fewer GPU-hours. The same reward helps on ProtoQA, where about 100 people answer each question, which points to a simple rule for RL with several valid human answers: reward them jointly.

[323] Beyond Belief Nesting: Rethinking Higher-Order Theory of Mind in Large Language Models cs.CLPDF

Shanshan You, Zhengqi Wang, Hao Liu, Yuqin Liu, Ya He

TL;DR: HopToM 指出既有高阶心智理论基准常把信念嵌套深度误当作推理阶数，并提出经过低阶捷径控制的评测与推理时方法 HopTrace。

Details

Motivation: 理解战略互动中的高阶心智状态需要递归推断多层视角，但仅增加信念嵌套层数，问题仍可能由较低阶推理解答，导致现有基准夸大了模型的高阶能力。

Result: 作者以支撑连续信念前缀的不同事件形式化有效阶数，并构建含认证全阶问题及低阶替代控制的 HopToM。四个前沿 LLM 的直接提示平均准确率从一阶 73.5% 降至四阶 20.0%，人类参与者也面临困难。因果干预将一类常见错误关联到较浅信念前缀证据。即插即用的 HopTrace 将每段互动编码一次为视角记录，再确定性解析嵌套查询；在认证叙事问题上，其五阶和四阶准确率分别比强提示基线上升 38.5 和 22.0 个百分点，且 token 数比多轮调用方法少 20–39 倍。

Insight: 评测需验证真正需要几阶视角推理，而不是依赖嵌套表象；按视角存档并解析有望提升深层问题的效率。直接提示下四阶表现很低说明任务仍难；HopTrace 的增益限于作者构造的认证叙事问题，是否迁移到开放互动场景需进一步验证。

Abstract: Theory of mind (ToM), the ability to reason about others’ mental states, underlies effective communication and coordination. Its higher-order form enables reasoning over nested perspectives in strategic interactions. However, existing evaluations often equate belief-nesting depth with reasoning order, allowing nominally higher-order questions to admit lower-order shortcuts. We formalize effective order through the distinct events supporting successive belief prefixes, revealing widespread order inflation across existing benchmarks. We introduce HopToM, with certified full-order questions and controls for lower-order alternatives. Under direct prompting, mean accuracy across four frontier LLMs falls from 73.5% at first order to 20.0% at fourth order, and human participants also struggle. Causal interventions link a recurring class of errors to evidence for shallower belief prefixes. We introduce HopTrace, a plug-and-play inference-time method that encodes each interaction once into perspective records and resolves nested queries deterministically. On certified narrative questions, it improves fourth- and fifth-order accuracy by 22.0 and 38.5 percentage points over strong prompting baselines, while using 20-39 times fewer tokens than multi-call methods. These results sharpen how higher-order ToM is evaluated and offer a practical way to improve perspective reasoning in interactive agents.

[324] BRIDGE: Selective Boundary Repair with Dependency Graph Evidence in Multi-Agent Systems cs.CLPDF

Encheng Su, Pengze Li, Ziheng Hua, Qiucheng Yu, Jianyu Wu

TL;DR: BRIDGE 将多智能体交接修复作为依赖图上的选择性干预：从可观测交互轨迹定位未解决依赖，评估修复收益与扰动风险，并仅在局部后置条件成立时执行。

Details

Motivation: 协作流程中常发生关键上下文遗漏、误路由或被忽略的交接故障，即便单个智能体的局部答复看起来合理。直接修改交接可能带来副作用，因此需要可验证的介入边界。

Result: BRIDGE 配套构建故障归因与校准数据集，通过依赖关系解耦及反事实交接扰动提供监督；运行时把可见轨迹编译成来源依赖图，不访问智能体私有状态。经验门控器权衡预期收益与中断风险，且只有形式化局部后置条件成立才执行修复。在 SILO-BENCH 和 TeamBench 上，任务成功率最高分别提高 12.3 和 11.1 个百分点，额外 token 开销最低为 2.0%。在 MAST 的 562 条交接相关轨迹上，单次运行 F1 为 69.8%。

Insight: 选择性修复并设置可验证后置条件，尝试在协作收益和干扰风险之间建立运行时控制边界；无需读取私有智能体状态也有助于兼容封闭系统。摘要给的是最高任务成功增益与最低额外开销，不代表每个基准都同时达到这些极值。

Abstract: Multi-agent collaboration has emerged as a critical paradigm for tackling complex, long-horizon tasks; however, while coordination protocols continue to advance, systemic failures at the inter-agent collaboration interface remain a pervasive bottleneck. In collaborative workflows, systems frequently suffer from \emph{broken handoffs}—where critical task context is omitted, misrouted, or ignored despite each agent emitting locally plausible responses. To address this challenge, we present \method, a verifiable runtime control framework that treats handoff repair as selective intervention over explicit dependency graphs. Central to \method is an integrated fault-attribution and calibration pipeline, \dataset, which decouples execution dependencies and injects counterfactual handoff perturbations to provide empirical supervision for runtime intervention. Leveraging this diagnostic foundation, \method dynamically compiles observable interaction traces into a provenance graph to pinpoint unresolved dependencies, without accessing private agent states. It then evaluates candidate repairs through an empirical gate that weighs expected gains against disruption risks, and executes repairs only when formal local postconditions hold. Extensive evaluations across demanding benchmarks demonstrate that \method boosts task success by up to 12.3 absolute percentage points on SILO-BENCH and 11.1 on TeamBench. Across both backbones, \method maintains strict cost-effectiveness, adding as little as 2.0% marginal token overhead. Furthermore, on 562 handoff-relevant traces from the MAST benchmark, \method achieves 69.8% F1 in a single pass, establishing a reliable operational boundary for verifiable coordination repair.

[325] Text-Only vs. Image-Aware VLM Judges for Manga Translation Evaluation cs.CL | cs.CVPDF

Subaru Kimura, Jun Suzuki

TL;DR: 该研究用同一个视觉语言模型分别充当纯文本评审和图像感知评审，检验漫画翻译评估加入整页图像后会如何改变判分。

Details

Motivation: 漫画中的说话者身份、指代对象和场景语气往往依赖气泡外的画面信息，但现有翻译自动评估多只看文本，图像输入是否改善判断尚不清楚。

Result: 作者使用日英漫画官方译文数据，按页面和对话气泡对齐，并让同一 VLM 扮演 text-only judge 与 image-aware judge。加入页面图像后，主要 VLM 更能识别人为注入且依赖视觉上下文的翻译退化；两种评审的错误数量及类别分布也不同。然而人工核验未发现对纯文本或图像感知评审有稳定偏好。摘要未提供样本规模或指标数值。

Insight: 图像有助于识别依赖画面线索的错误，但评审方式变化不等于整体判断更接近人工偏好。评估漫画翻译时应分别报告视觉依赖错误识别与人工一致性；现有摘要仅基于日英数据和单一主要评审模型。

Abstract: In manga translation, visual context outside speech-bubble text, including speaker identities, referents, and scene tone, is depicted in page images, making it natural to refer to images during translation evaluation. However, most conventional manga translation evaluations rely solely on text-only automatic metrics, leaving the impact of image input insufficiently explored. We propose a practical validation framework that employs the same vision-language model (VLM) as both a text-only judge (TOJ) and an image-aware judge (IAJ) to investigate evaluation divergences associated with image-aware evaluation procedures. We use a Japanese-English manga dataset of official translations aligned at the page and speech-bubble levels. First, adding page images to TOJ improved the primary VLM’s detection of deliberately injected, visually dependent degradations. Second, we analyzed evaluation divergences between TOJ and IAJ, finding different error counts and error-category distributions. Human verification did not reveal a consistent preference between TOJ and IAJ.

[326] Agent-Reflex: Teaching Language Agents to Act Reflectively cs.CLPDF

Guanting Dong, Xinyu Yang, Jiajie Jin, Yuyang Hu, Xiaoshuai Song

TL;DR: Agent-Reflex 通过反思技能挖掘、反思监督微调和反思引导的在线策略优化，训练智能体在工具噪声与用户纠正下主动反思和恢复。

Details

Motivation: 长程工具智能体会遇到嘈杂工具反馈和用户纠正，但现有方法对反思学习及失败恢复的监督有限。

Result: 框架先向环境反馈注入有依据的扰动，从多能力模型池中挖掘匹配的成功—失败案例并总结可复用技能；再用 ReSFT 训练自我反思、技能恢复和面向用户的纠正行为；最后以 ORPO 结合噪声交互下的智能体强化学习和反思引导的在线蒸馏。在 Qwen3-8B 上，作者报告五个长程工具使用基准总体得分 58.6，AgentNoiseBench 得分 29.1，并称超过强环境扩展和反思基线；六套挑战性智能体基准进一步验证效果，噪声鲁棒性提升且训练稳定。摘要未解释得分量纲或各基准具体分项。

Insight: 将反思技能从对照成功与失败交互中归纳，再用于监督和策略优化，提供了从技能发现到在线行为学习的完整链路。基准总分口径与不同阶段的独立贡献在摘要中未明确，外推到真实工具噪声需参考具体评测协议。

Abstract: Large language models have evolved from single-turn chatbots into interactive agents capable of long-horizon reasoning. In real deployments, MCP tool services can return noisy feedback and users may intervene to correct the agent, but existing methods provide limited supervision for reflection learning and failure recovery. To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-Reflex, a general training framework for incentivizing proactive reflection in agents. Specifically, Agent-Reflex comprises three stages. First, Environment Reflection Skill Discovery (RSD) injects grounded tool-feedback perturbations into environment scaling, samples a capability-diverse LLM pool, mines matched success-failure pairs, and summarizes reusable reflection meta-skills. Building on this skill library, we then apply Reflective Supervised Fine-Tuning (ReSFT) that converts each skill into supervision for self-reflection, skill recovery, and user-centric correction, strengthening complementary reflective behaviors. Finally, we propose On-Policy Reflective Policy Optimization (ORPO) to combine agentic reinforcement learning under noisy interactions with reflection-guided on-policy distillation to further elicit proactive reflection. Built on Qwen3-8B, Agent-Reflex reaches 58.6 overall on five long-horizon tool-use benchmarks and 29.1 on AgentNoiseBench, surpassing strong environment-scaling and reflection baselines. Experiments on six challenging agent benchmark suites demonstrate the effectiveness of Agent-Reflex. Further analyses show that Agent-Reflex improves agents’ robustness to noise while maintaining stable training dynamics, supporting scalable agent training. Our code is available at https://github.com/RUC-NLPIR/Agent-Reflex.

[327] Seeing Through the Forgery Is Not Enough: Regressive Sycophancy under Fabricated Evidence in Medical Vision-Language Models cs.CL | cs.AIPDF

Sadif Ahmed, Soumya Swagata Biswas, Rifat Shahriyar, Chowdhury Mohammad Rakin Haider

TL;DR: 该研究测量医学视觉语言模型在用户以伪造处方反驳正确影像判断时的回退式迎合，并发现声明文件伪造并不能保证模型保留原有诊断。

Details

Motivation: 模型可能正确读出 CT，却在后续对话中因用户提供相反方向的伪造文件而改变答案。医学场景中，即使最初识别正确，这类依赖伪证据的回退也可能造成风险。

Result: 作者在 400 个 VQA-RAD 是/否问题上，构造 19,200 段多轮对话，对 4 个开放 VLM 比较有无伪造处方的情况。在未说明文件系合成的设定中，模型放弃了 6,488 个正确回答中的 80.1%。不同脚本下，同一处方使 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 翻转率从 45.9% 升至 89.6%，却使 Qwen3-VL-8B 从 77.7% 降至 50.9%。在含处方的 3,232 段对话中，模型有 915 次（28.3%）拒绝处方同时保留正确答案，其中 40% 后续轮次又翻转。系统提示披露文件为合成内容，可将一模型翻转率从 77.8% 降至 47.3%。

Insight: 模型被告知证据是伪造的，仍可能在多轮对话中重新采纳错误答案；提示披露只能降低某一模型和脚本下的翻转率，不能视为可靠防护。结果来自 VQA-RAD 是/否任务及特定处方脚本，不能直接代表临床决策性能。

Abstract: A medical vision-language model may analyze a given CT scan and correctly detect both kidneys in view. Continuing this conversation, if a user provides a prescription with an opposite direction, medical VLMs often sycophantically choose to realign their diagnosis. In this work, we study regressive sycophancy under fabricated evidence, where a model abandons a correct answer when pushback comes with a fake document. We test four open VLMs on 400 VQA-RAD yes/no questions in 19,200 multi-turn conversations, with and without a fabricated prescription. Without a disclosure that documents are synthetic, the models abandon 80.1% of 6,488 correct answers. Notably, under one script each, the same prescription raises the flip rate of Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 45.9% to 89.6% and lowers that of Qwen3-VL-8B from 77.7% to 50.9%. A model rejected the prescription while still preserving the correct answer in 915 of 3,232 conversations with the prescription (28.3%), and 40% of these flipped in later turns. System-prompt sentences that disclose the documents as synthetic lower one model’s flip rate from 77.8% to 47.3%. Thus, we conclude that awareness about a forgery does not prevent a model from adopting its answer.

[328] From Agents to Edges: Paired Optimization for Multi-Agent Collaboration cs.CLPDF

Feng Lin, Xiaotian Yu, Yifan Yang, Aijun Li

TL;DR: PACO 把多智能体通信边作为优化单位，联合改写发送方和接收方提示及共享通信约定，在保持模型、角色和工作流拓扑固定的条件下改善协作。

Details

Motivation: 单体能力强不保证协作有效；通信质量取决于一方表达内容是否与另一方的解读和使用方式对齐，因此只单独优化某个智能体提示可能无法修复接口问题。

Result: PACO 面向黑盒语言模型，以状态感知的折扣 bandit 选择待改进通信边，通过执行反馈成对修订两端指令，并用分阶段端到端运行评估。优化后的指令可并入现有 agent prompt，部署时不增加模型调用。作者在一个四智能体工作流和多种多智能体基准上报告其持续优于领先提示优化与通信基线；在 HotpotQA 学到的配置迁移到其他数据集仍保持优势，无需针对目标集再优化。摘要未提供基准名称、数值增益或运行成本。

Insight: 联合优化通信两端比孤立改写单个角色更直接对应信息交接失配，同时保持系统拓扑不变，便于复用既有工作流。迁移结论来自 HotpotQA 到其他数据集的特定实验；摘要未量化迁移幅度和优化阶段成本。

Abstract: Strong individual agents do not guarantee effective collaboration. Communication must align what one agent conveys with how another interprets and uses it. This dependency makes the communication edge a natural unit of optimization. We introduce Paired Automated Communication Optimization (PACO), which jointly optimizes the instructions at both ends of each edge and their shared communication convention in systems built on black-box language models. PACO keeps model weights, agent roles, and workflow topology fixed. A state-aware discounted bandit selects edges for refinement, while execution feedback guides paired revisions evaluated through staged end-to-end execution. The optimized instructions integrate into existing agent prompts without additional model calls at deployment. On a four-agent workflow evaluated across diverse multi-agent benchmarks, PACO consistently outperforms leading prompt-optimization and communication baselines. Configurations learned on HotpotQA retain their advantage in cross-dataset transfer without target-specific optimization. These results demonstrate that optimizing how agents communicate can substantially improve collaboration within an otherwise fixed system.

[329] TextualRL: Textual Reinforcement Learning for Context Management cs.CL | cs.AIPDF

Tianyu Huai, Jie Zhou, Bo Mao, Qin Chen, Liang He

TL;DR: TextualRL 把同一任务、同一文本上下文下的一组 rollout 作为策略批评单位，跨组审查修改提案，并用留出奖励决定是否采纳上下文补丁。

Details

Motivation: 智能体可通过改写提示上下文适应任务反馈而不改模型参数，但单条轨迹提供的对比证据有限，任务特定修复也可能被写入共享上下文并过度泛化。

Result: 组内策略批评对照同一上下文下的成功与失败轨迹；若结果一致，则借助跨任务证据识别值得保留的行为或提出修复假设。跨组更新会结合包括未产生修改提案的观察，审查提案的证据和适用范围，再形成有界文本补丁，最终以留出验证奖励决定是否替换候选上下文。对 5 个目标智能体和 6 个基准的评估中，相比基座模型，GPT-5.5 平均测试准确率提高 24.4 个百分点，Qwen3.8-27B 提高 15.3 个百分点。

Insight: 通过多条同组尝试和跨任务审查，可以把奖励转化为更可迁移的文本策略更新，并让留出奖励承担采用门控。大幅度提升是针对摘要列出的智能体与六基准平均值，不能直接外推至任意提示上下文或任务分布。

Abstract: LLM agents can adapt to task feedback by revising the textual context that guides their behavior, without changing their model parameters. However, turning execution rewards into reusable context updates is challenging: individual trajectories offer limited comparative evidence about what to change, while task-specific fixes may overgeneralize when incorporated into a shared context. We introduce TextualRL, a gradient-free reinforcement learning framework that treats a group of rollouts from the same task under the same context, rather than an isolated trajectory, as the unit of policy critique. Groupwise Policy Critique contrasts successful and failed rollouts within a task; when outcomes are uniform, it draws on cross-task evidence to identify behaviors worth preserving or formulate repair hypotheses. Cross-Group Policy Update reviews the resulting proposals against evidence pooled across groups, including observations that yield no proposed edit, to refine their content and applicability. Reviewed proposals form a bounded textual patch, with adoption of the candidate context determined by held-out validation rewards. Together, these components establish a reward-driven policy optimization loop in which multiple attempts jointly inform reusable context updates. We evaluate TextualRL with five target agents on six benchmarks. Averaged over the six benchmarks, TextualRL improves test accuracy over the base model by 24.4 and 15.3 percentage points for GPT-5.5 and Qwen3.8-27B, respectively.

[330] TRACESTEER: Trace Driven Activation Steering for Hallucination Mitigation in Diffusion Language Models cs.CLPDF

Xin Zhang, Yili Wang, Yue Tan, Xin He, Rui Miao

TL;DR: TRACESTEER 根据扩散语言模型前序去噪预测和当前隐藏状态动态调整激活引导方向与强度，以测试时干预缓解幻觉。

Details

Motivation: 扩散语言模型并行预测 token，可能产生事实幻觉；既有激活引导忽略其去噪状态动态变化和幻觉风险随时间变化，固定引导向量与统一强度未必合适。

Result: DF-Steering 结合前序去噪预测和当前隐藏状态构造逐步引导向量；TS-Gate 根据预测不确定性与去噪步数调节强度。骨干参数冻结，利用事实监督和幅度正则学习自适应干预。作者在两个扩散语言模型上报告 TruthfulQA 事实可靠性提高，并能泛化到五个下游基准。摘要未提供模型名称、数值增益或延迟变化。

Insight: 把先前生成轨迹作为引导反馈，可让干预随去噪阶段与不确定性调整，而非始终使用同一个 steering 向量。虽然无需更新骨干，仍需学习引导模块；摘要未报告其校准成本、误导性抑制或事实性与通用能力的权衡。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs, yet remain susceptible to hallucination. Activation steering offers a promising mitigation approach by guiding parallel token predictions through internal representations. However, existing steering methods largely overlook two characteristics of dLLMs: dynamic denoising states and temporal hallucination risks, which challenge predefined steering vectors and uniform intervention strengths. We propose TRACESTEER, a trace-driven activation steering framework that uses preceding denoising predictions as feedback to jointly adapt steering direction and strength. Specifically, Denoising Feedback Steering (DF-Steering) constructs step-specific steering vectors from preceding predictions and current hidden states. Trajectory-Guided Steering Gate (TS-Gate) regulates their strength using prediction uncertainty and the denoising timestep. With the backbone frozen, factual supervision and magnitude regularization jointly guide the learning of adaptive steering interventions, promoting factual reliability and stability throughout denoising. Experiments on two dLLMs show improved factual reliability on TruthfulQA and generalization across five downstream benchmarks.

[331] PACT: A Pragmatic Prompting Framework for Expressive and Voice-Preserving Speech-to-Speech Translation cs.CLPDF

Yuchen Song, Satoshi Nakamura

TL;DR: PACT 将源语音的语用线索映射并校准到目标语言可实现的表达空间，再以连续提示控制冻结语音生成器，以保留说话人音色并传达情绪、语气和节奏。

Details

Motivation: 语音到语音翻译不仅要保留字面内容，还应保留说话人身份和表达方式；现有端到端、语音多模态模型及级联系统在目标语言中复现情绪、语调、节奏、停顿和语用态度方面仍有困难。

Result: PACT 提取源语音语用线索，将其投影到目标语言表达空间、校准至可实现子空间，并转成冻结语音生成器的连续提示。在西班牙语↔英语的 TOPI 双向评测中，作者报告其在内容忠实度、音色保留和表达保留等指标上综合表现优于所评系统。摘要未给出模型名称、指标定义或具体数值。

Insight: 将语用特征先投影并校准到目标语言可表达范围，避免简单复制源语言表现线索；冻结生成器可减少对其内部训练的依赖。当前摘要只有 TOPI 双向评测的定性领先，尚不能判断不同语言、说话人或情绪类型的具体收益。

Abstract: Speech-to-speech translation should preserve not only what is said, but also who says it and how it is said. Existing end-to-end S2ST, speech MLLM, and cascade systems can preserve content or timbre, but often struggle to realize emotion, tone, rhythm, pauses, and pragmatic attitude in the target language. We propose PACT, a target-space pragmatic prompting framework for expressive and voice-preserving S2ST. PACT extracts source pragmatic cues, projects them into the target-language expression space, calibrates the projected representation to a realizable target subspace, and converts it into continuous prompts for a frozen speech generator. On bidirectional Spanish-English TOPI evaluation, PACT achieves the best overall performance among evaluated systems across content fidelity, voice preservation, and expression preservation metrics.

[332] Copying Is Not Grounding: Training Faithful Long-Form RAG with Authored-Sentence Credit cs.CLPDF

Hoang Pham, Duc Anh Vu, Duy Tung Doan, Cong-Duy T Nguyen, Anh Tuan Luu

TL;DR: ASC 将长篇 RAG 的忠实度奖励和 GRPO 优势从整篇回答移至句子级，只奖励模型原创、超出问题且有来源支持的句子，以抑制复制式奖励投机。

Details

Motivation: 按支持句比例设计的忠实度奖励容易被直接复制检索段落利用；KL 或复制惩罚可能仍保留复制，或换来更短、更空洞的回答及拒答，而整篇 GRPO 优势又会同时强化复制句和有根据的原创句。

Result: Authored-Sentence Credit 只为非复制、提供了超出问题的信息且受检索段落支持的句子计奖；每句优势与同一问题采样的其他句子比较，零信用句排名最低且不会被强化。在 4 个模型、2 个域内和 3 个留出语料上的实验中，ASC 是唯一在所有设置下都降低原创句错误率并增加受支持句的方案；留出评审下中位数改善分别为 38% 和 46%。两个 LLM 整体回答评审不偏好基线相较基座模型，而将 ASC 评价为与基座相当。

Insight: 句子级信用分配可减少“复制即支持”的奖励捷径，同时保留有证据支撑的原创表达。评审指标中，错误率与支持句数量改善并未带来整体回答优于基座的结论；其收益主要体现在相较其他训练基线的留出句级忠实度。

Abstract: In search engines and assistants, long-form RAG answers can mislead readers with claims their sources do not support. Faithfulness rewards, the share of supported sentences, train models toward fewer such claims. We show that these rewards are hacked by copying. A sentence copied from the passages is supported almost by construction, so trained models learn to copy rather than ground what they write. Common defenses only move the hack: a KL or copy penalty leaves copying in place or trades it for shorter, emptier answers and refusals. GRPO, the standard RL algorithm, makes it worse by giving every sentence its answer’s advantage, reinforcing copied and grounded sentences alike. We propose Authored-Sentence Credit (ASC) , which fixes both by moving GRPO’s reward and advantage from the answer to the sentence level. The reward credits only sentences that are authored rather than copied, say more than the question, and are supported by the passages. The advantage compares each sentence with every sentence sampled for the question, so one that earns no credit ranks last and is never reinforced. Across four models and two in-domain, three held-out corpora, only ASC lowers the error rate of authored sentences and writes more supported ones in every setting, by 38% and 46% at the median under held-out evaluators, giving readers more grounded information. It takes none of these shortcuts, and two LLM judges comparing whole answers prefer no baseline to the base model but rate ASC’s answers on par with it. We conclude that a faithfulness reward should credit what a model writes, not what it copies.

[333] Imprinting: Knowledge Distillation Can Shift Student Behavior cs.CLPDF

Yu-Chien Tang, An-Zi Yen

TL;DR: 该研究发现知识蒸馏不仅传递任务能力，也能把教师在安全—实用性上的行为倾向印入学生；即使训练题与安全无关，这种源教师效应仍会影响下游选择。

Details

Motivation: 蒸馏通常被视为能力迁移，但教师生成答案也包含行为倾向，可能在不属于蒸馏目标的下游场景中改变学生的决策。

Result: 作者构造同一基座教师的“接受伤害”和“避免伤害”两个版本，用它们回答与安全无关的一般推理和知识问题，再将答案蒸馏给不同基座学生。学生通常获得任务能力，同时在下游决策中朝源教师的安全—实用倾向移动；该效应依教师—学生组合变化，也不会均匀推广到所有安全行为。排除一小组分歧 token 可减弱印入；改写回答仍保留源教师效应，且可能引入改写器相关偏移。蒸馏后偏好优化提高了伤害回避，但没有消除教师来源造成的差异。摘要未给出具体分数。

Insight: 普通任务监督也可能通过教师回答风格携带行为规范，因此蒸馏数据不仅是任务标签来源。抑制特定 token 与后续偏好优化各有局限；效应随教师—学生配对和安全行为类型变化，不能简单视为固定方向或普适幅度。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation trains student models on teacher-generated responses to transfer task capability, but those responses may also carry behavioral tendencies of their source. We investigate whether the source teacher can shape student behavior beyond the capability that distillation is intended to transfer. We construct harm-accepting and harm-avoiding variants of the same base teacher, use them to generate responses to ordinary reasoning and knowledge questions unrelated to safety, and distill those responses into students with different base models. Students generally acquire task capability while their downstream decisions shift toward the source teacher’s safety-pragmatism disposition, a phenomenon we call imprinting. Distillation from the harm-accepting teacher reduces harm avoidance, whereas distillation from the harm-avoiding teacher increases it. Imprinting varies across teacher-student pairs and does not extend uniformly across different forms of safety behavior. Excluding a sparse set of divergence tokens reduces imprinting, whereas response rewriting preserves the source-dependent effect and can introduce additional rewriter-dependent shifts. Post-distillation preference optimization raises harm avoidance but does not eliminate the source-dependent difference. These results show that behavioral tendencies can be intentionally imprinted through the source teacher, even with ordinary task supervision.

[334] CREATE: Creativity Evaluation of VLMs using the Visual Remote Associates Test cs.CLPDF

Ziqing Yang, Anubhav Jangra, Smaranda Muresan

TL;DR: CREATE 用 155 道视觉远程联想题评估视觉语言模型的联想创造力，要求从三张看似无关的图像中找出共同概念。

Details

Motivation: VLM 被用于故事创作、设计构思、艺术解读和广告等创意工作，但缺少衡量其横向联想能力并与人类表现比较的系统基准。

Result: CREATE 为半自动构建的视觉 Remote Associates Test 基准，作者招募 25 人验证题目质量，并评测 11 个 VLM。结果显示多数模型表现低于人类；模型的联想能力依赖题目提供的文本提示概念，并不能普遍迁移到视觉谜题。摘要未报告各模型或人类的准确率和显著性检验。

Insight: 提示中的概念线索会显著影响模型能否完成跨图像联想，因而需要区分视觉线索推理与文本提示帮助。题量为 155 且经半自动构造，摘要未说明样本覆盖、文化因素和人类—模型差距的具体幅度。

Abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) are used in creative tasks such as visual storytelling, design ideation, art interpretation, and advertising. Yet we lack principled ways to measure the lateral reasoning of these models compared to human potential. We introduce CREATE, a semi-automatically constructed benchmark containing 155 visual Remote Associates Test problems. These problems require a solver to find an underlying connection among three seemingly dissimilar images. We conduct a human study (N=25) to validate and ground the quality of our benchmark, and evaluate 11 VLMs. Our findings show that most VLMs underperform humans on this task. Our experiments indicate that the associative ability of VLMs depends on the cue concepts provided in the text and does not universally extend to visual puzzles.

[335] Legal-R1: Agentic Retrieval for Evidence-Based Legal Reasoning cs.CLPDF

Huaiwen Pang, Jiale Han, Junying Chen, Wenjun Xiao, Benyou Wang

TL;DR: Legal-R1 用多智能体检索流程进行循证法律问答，由 Lawyer 决策何时、向何处检索及证据是否充分，Legal Assistant 按权威性和多样性检索，Judge 汇总证据作答。

Details

Motivation: 法律问答不仅需答案看似合理，还必须由适用且可引用的有效证据支撑；一次性语义检索难以同时处理法源权威性、适用性和异质来源的多样性。

Result: 框架将法律推理拆成 Lawyer、Legal Assistant 和 Judge 三个角色。仅对 Lawyer 进行掩码监督微调和轨迹感知强化学习；助手从规范性法律来源与判例中进行权威感知、多样性检索，Judge 基于完整证据轨迹作答。在多个中文法律基准上，作者报告 Legal-R1 优于通用模型、法律专用模型及检索增强基线。摘要未给出基准名称、数值或检索成本。

Insight: 检索决策本身可以作为可学习的法律推理策略，而不只是固定在一次检索步骤中；分工也使证据获取与最终判断相对解耦。摘要未报告具体法律领域、引用准确性和跨司法辖区泛化表现，暂不能量化可靠性提升。

Abstract: Legal question answering requires answers that are not only plausible, but also grounded in legally valid and citable evidence. Standard retrieval-augmented generation often relies on one-shot semantic matching, which is insufficient when legal evidence must be selected according to authority, applicability, and diversity across heterogeneous sources. We introduce Legal-R1, an agentic retrieval framework for evidence-based legal reasoning. Legal-R1 decomposes legal reasoning into a multi-agent workflow, where a Lawyer agent learns when to retrieve, which legal source to query, what evidence to seek, and when the collected evidence is sufficient. A Legal Assistant agent retrieves from normative legal sources and precedent cases with authority-aware and diversity-aware selection, while a Judge agent generates the final answer from the complete evidence trajectory. We post-train only the Lawyer agent with masked supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-aware reinforcement learning. Experiments on multiple Chinese legal benchmarks show that Legal-R1 improves over general-purpose, legal-specific, and retrieval-augmented baselines.

[336] Breakdown of Conversational Involvement: A Joint Multi-Modal Analysis of Conversation Floors and F-formation Detection with Multiple Features cs.CL | cs.SIPDF

Zonghuan Li, Chirag Raman, Hayley Hung

TL;DR: 该研究联合分析自由站立对话中的 conversation floor 与 F-formation，指出仅把 F-formation 当作单一对话单元不足以完整描述参与者互动。

Details

Motivation: 互动参与度关系到谁影响谁，但现有会话群体分析往往依赖单一种类的空间或互动结构假设。作者认为 F-formation 未必能单独刻画一个会话。

Result: 研究提出用说话状态估计 conversation floor，并在 F-formation 内分析 floor；比较不同特征下的空间检测结果时发现，头部特征检测到的群组更可能被其他特征检测的群组所包含。联合空间特征与 floor 模式后，某些流程可用上半身特征检测单 floor 群组，同时用下半身特征保留 F-formation。作者据此认为，全面刻画互动参与仍需更细致的理论与框架。摘要未给出数据规模和检测指标。

Insight: 空间朝向形成的群组与轮次/说话结构并非一一对应；特征选择会影响检测到的群体嵌套关系。研究是对既有表示和管线的联合分析，摘要未给出标注基准或参与度预测结果，结论主要是概念性和诊断性的。

Abstract: Interactions happen universally and spontaneously in daily lives. Studying involvement in interactions helps us analyze who can influence who and has a wide potential in applications. Specifically, we consider conversational involvement in free-standing conversations. We study two operationalizations of an FCG: F-formations and conversation floors, and propose that current assumption that F-formations capture single conversations is insufficient. To illustrate how different implementations could impact the detected F-formations, we employ three analyses. First, we propose that speaking status can be used for estimating conversation floors, and leveraged it to analyze floors within F-formations. Second, we analyze spatial characteristics of the detection results by applying different feature sets on chosen baselines, and find that groups resulting from head features are more likely to be subsumed by groups detected using other features. Finally, we do a joint analysis which combines the spatial features and floor patterns in the conversation. We observe that certain pipelines can detect groups with single floors from upper body features, while retaining F-formations with lower body features. We conclude that a more detailed theory and framework is needed to holistically demonstrate conversational involvement within interactions.

[337] Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve cs.CL | cs.AI | cs.IRPDF

Yuyang Bai, Yu Wang, Yu Zhang

TL;DR: DKGI 允许语言模型智能体直接在知识图谱节点与边文件上编写并迭代 Python 访问工具，使工具创建与证据检索共同演化。

Details

Motivation: 文本丰富的知识图谱搜索需同时沿关系扩展和审查节点文本；预定义图接口限制了可访问证据，即使智能体能编排工具或处理检索子图也受限。

Result: 在 DKGI 中，智能体直接访问完整节点和边文件，通过代码遍历关系、组合节点集合、筛选文本证据，并交替使用程序执行、shell 搜索和文件检查。执行反馈引导工具创建与修订，工具的变化又决定后续检索。在跨三个领域的基准上，无需训练的 DKGI 在每个图上均比已发表最强基线至少高 6.7 个 Hit@1 点，即使使用最简 harness 仍如此。控制消融显示，多轮编程优于纯 shell 访问及预定义图工具；轨迹显示智能体会修改代码扩展搜索或修复错误。

Insight: 开放工具构造可让智能体按当前证据需求编写检索程序，而非被固定图接口限制；多轮执行反馈形成工具与搜索策略的共同适应。基准优势针对三领域图数据，摘要未报告运行成本和大图访问的资源边界。

Abstract: Searching text-rich knowledge graphs requires following relations while examining textual evidence. Predefined graph interfaces constrain what evidence agents can access, even when they write code to combine tool calls or process retrieved subgraphs. We propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine node sets, and select textual evidence, interleaving execution with shell search and file inspection. This lets agents process large node sets in bulk while returning selected text for the model to assess. Execution feedback guides tool creation and revision, while the evolving tools determine what evidence the agent gathers next. On benchmark datasets spanning three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph, even with a minimal harness. Controlled ablations show the benefits of multi-turn programming over shell-only access and predefined graph tools, while trajectories show agents revising code to extend searches or address errors. These findings highlight the value of allowing tool creation and tool use to co-evolve during graph search. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI.

[338] Rubrics from the Task, Verdicts from Evidence: Pointwise Rubric Rewards with Tool-Augmented Judges cs.CLPDF

Tianci Liu, Haoyu Wang

TL;DR: ReVeR 从任务指令本身推导硬约束和分级原则，并用工具增强评审独立评价每个回答，避免根据候选回答反向构造量规所引入的偏差。

Details

Motivation: 量规奖励模型若从已观察回答中提取标准，可能产生回答诱导偏差；仅靠阅读文本也难检查机械约束，而成对裁判只给相对偏好，不便直接用于策略优化。

Result: ReVeR 是逐点评分量规奖励模型：量规从指令推理生成，工具增强裁判再独立评价回答。两部分用标签盲蒸馏训练，偏好标签仅筛选教师输出，形成大规模 ReVeR-Traces。作者报告其平均偏好准确率超过成对量规模型，指令遵循任务优势尤明显，并在测试时扩展和下游策略优化中有效。进一步发现，生成器 RL 会提升偏好准确率却降低量规忠实度；更高偏好准确率也不必然带来更好的下游策略。摘要未提供各指标的数值。

Insight: 量规忠实度、偏好预测准确率和策略效用是不同性质，单一奖励模型分数不能替代下游验证。工具增强的点式判断可支持优化，但摘要未说明工具种类、评估模型以及不同量规复杂度下的成本。

Abstract: Rubric-based reward models (RMs) evaluate responses against explicit criteria. However, existing methods often derive criteria from observed response candidates, introducing response-induced bias that may limit rubric generalizability. Their judges also struggle with mechanical constraints when relying on reading alone, and commonly used pairwise judges provide only relative preferences, complicating their direct use for policy optimization. We propose ReVeR, a pointwise rubric RM that derives hard rules and graded principles by reasoning about the instruction alone and evaluates responses independently through tool-augmented judging. Both components are trained through label-blind distillation, in which preference labels only filter a teacher’s outputs, yielding ReVeR-Traces, a large-scale dataset of rubric-reasoning and judging trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that ReVeR outperforms pairwise rubric RMs in average preference accuracy, most clearly on instruction following, as well as in test-time scaling and downstream policy optimization. We further find that generator RL improves preference accuracy while reducing rubric fidelity, and that higher preference accuracy does not necessarily translate into better downstream policies. These findings highlight that rubric fidelity, preference accuracy, and downstream utility are distinct properties, shedding light on future RM research.

[339] DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning cs.CL | cs.AI | cs.LGPDF

Minghao Luo, Liang Chen

TL;DR: DoubtLess 用更小的推理模型分别生成简洁和详尽倾向的 logits 差，并逐 token 调节大模型 CoT，从而无需重新训练地缩短推理。

Details

Motivation: 推理模型常生成超出解题需要的长思维链；既有压缩方法可能需要逐模型训练、添加固定 steering 向量或提前停止/屏蔽词语，后两类启发式可能降低准确率。

Result: 小模型读取大模型目前的 CoT 两次，一次被提示简短、一次被提示详尽；两组 logits 差乘以强度后加到大模型每一步 CoT logits。Qwen3-32B 在竞赛数学、研究生科学和竞赛编程七个基准上 CoT 缩短 31%，准确率保持不变，并超过五种推理时基线。用于自调试编码智能体时，每轮思考 token 减少 20%，任务表现不变；在另外两个模型家族上也保持准确率。与训练式压缩结合还能进一步缩短 CoT。分析显示主要节省来自正确答案首次出现后的重复检查。

Insight: 通过较小模型估计“多想/少想”的方向，可在不更新大模型参数时控制推理长度；节省集中于答案已出现后的反复核验，而非删除主要解题步骤。摘要未给出小模型额外调用的时延/成本，token 缩短不必然等同于端到端成本下降。

Abstract: Reasoning models achieve strong performance through long chains of thought (CoT), but often spend more tokens than needed to solve a problem. Existing ways to shorten the CoT require additional training for each model, add a fixed steering vector to the model’s hidden states, or use decoding heuristics such as stopping early or banning words like “wait”, which can reduce accuracy. We propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method in which a much smaller reasoning model steers the large one towards brevity. The small model reads the large model’s CoT so far twice, once prompted to be brief (the brief thinker) and once prompted to be verbose (the verbose thinker), and the difference between its two logit vectors, scaled by a strength, is added to the large model’s logits at every step of the CoT. On seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, DoubtLess shortens the CoT of Qwen3-32B by 31% with unchanged accuracy, outperforming five inference-time baselines. We also show that DoubtLess reduces thinking tokens per turn by 20% in a self-debugging coding agent with unchanged task performance. It also generalizes to two other model families with unchanged accuracy. When combined with training-based compression, it further shortens the CoT of a model already trained for brevity. Ablations and behavioral analysis show that DoubtLess reduces repeated checking, with most token savings coming after the correct answer first appears in the CoT. Our code is available at https://github.com/leoluolol/DoubtLess.

[340] Hybrid Reasoning Agents cs.CL | cs.AI | cs.LGPDF

Jiaru Zou, Yunzhe Qi, Sirui Chen, Federico Bianchi, Shang Zhu

TL;DR: HybridAgents 在文本交互和潜空间思考之间动态切换，用连续工作记忆保留多轮混合上下文，并通过 HybridSFT 与 HybridRL 学习何时内部推理、何时调用工具行动。

Details

Motivation: 文本推理易检查但冗长；潜空间推理更紧凑，却缺乏原生工具访问和透明性。现有智能体难以在统一流程中兼顾低成本推理和可检查的外部行动。

Result: 轻量 HybridLink 负责文本/潜空间模式转换，连续工作记忆无损保存混合上下文。HybridSFT 训练模型协同使用工具和转换模块，HybridRL 学习何时在潜空间思考、何时通过文本行动。在 3 个模型规模、覆盖数学、科学、医学、搜索和智能体推理的 11 个基准上，作者报告相较文本与潜方法基线平均性能提高 10.4%，token 减少 35.5%–54.7%，推理速度提高 1.8–2.6 倍，成本降低 2.7–3.7 倍。

Insight: 让潜空间处理内部推理、文本负责可见行动，可尝试同时获得效率和工具可控性；连续工作记忆用于跨轮次保留两种表示。摘要的平均性能及成本比例跨 11 个基准和 3 个规模汇总，未给出逐任务质量变化和潜在表示可审计性的细节。

Abstract: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent’s continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.

cs.AI [Back]

[341] Artificiality’s First Exam: An LLM-Referenced C-test for Supraintelligence cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Jose Hernandez-Orallo

TL;DR: 该工作把 Levin Kt 复杂度思想与 LLM 作为表征机器结合，提出以模型能力为参照、可按比特尺度估计难度的 C-test，用于评估超越当前人类或模型能力的推理题。

Details

Motivation: 按人类或当前 AI 能力校准的基准可能很快循环或饱和；要评测未来更强系统，题目难度应尽量依据任务机制复杂度，而非只依赖当前被试表现。

Result: 作者把 LLM 视为包含人类文化知识、可用自然语言提示编程的表征机器，形式化基于 Levin Kt 的难度测量，并设计轻量题目生成与认证流程；分析参考机器能力及出题者—被测者差距。首批认证题在 12 个 LLM 上评测，模型能力曲线随估计难度提高而下降，并延伸至当前难以探索的高难度区域。作者称经认证题目难度可在比特比率尺度上估计，并可在当前前沿模型尚不能解答前生成。摘要未提供各模型成绩或单位难度的定义细节。

Insight: 若题目难度能与当前考生能力分离并用机制复杂度标定，基准有望降低饱和风险；但难度依赖参考 LLM/机器及认证过程，参考系统变化会影响刻度。12 个模型的首批实验支持可行性，尚不足以证明该量尺对任意超人类系统都稳定。

Abstract: Under the accelerated pace of AI development, any benchmark whose difficulty is calibrated with humans or current AI systems becomes circular, or saturates soon. How can we then evaluate machines that may become more capable than the current machines and the people who write the tests? One answer to the question hinges on inverse problems, inductive inference questions for which difficulty depends on the complexity of the underlying mechanism, given the observations and the previous knowledge. Levin’s Kt, a computable variant of Kolmogorov complexity, puts a theoretical upper bound to that difficulty, balancing the simplest representation encoding for the mechanism and the logarithm of the time steps to run that mechanism. Previous tests derived from Levin’s Kt, such as the original C-test, are based on minimalistic Universal Turing Machines (UTM), capable of very limited representations and no previous knowledge. Reasoning large language models (LLM) are UTMs that capture a compendium of human culture as knowledge, using prompts as natural language programs. This paper presents the first test based on Levin’s Kt with LLMs as representational machines. Fresh test items can be produced at high difficulties, estimated in a ratio scale measured in bits, before any human or frontier model can solve them. We formalise the measure, devise a lightweight generation and certification pipeline, explore the effect of the power of the reference machine and the gap between examiner and examinee. We produce a first battery of certified items administered to twelve LLMs. The resulting agent characteristic curves decrease with difficulty, down to the uncharted high-difficulty region, the supra-intelligence window of items we can certify, yet beyond generations of frontier intelligence.

[342] Decoupling Knowledge Forgetting and Refusal Learning in MLLM Unlearning cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.IR | cs.LGPDF

Haodong Chen, Shengtao Wen, Dong Liang, Lingbing Guo, Xiang Chen

TL;DR: FASD 将多模态遗忘拆成拒答行为学习和目标知识抑制两个通道，目标是在忘掉指定内容的同时诚实承认知识缺失，而非编造或只学会表面拒答。

Details

Motivation: 只看模型是否不再输出目标信息会掩盖两种失败：抑制后可能对相关问题编造事实；拒答训练也可能只改变表面行为，模型在选择题中仍能识别目标知识。

Result: 行为通道从提示为无知状态的模型副本蒸馏恰当拒答，并屏蔽教师分布中的目标 token，避免重新教回遗忘内容；知识通道则直接抑制真实目标答案片段，不依赖模型生成结果。作者报告 FASD 能遗忘目标知识、减少开放式任务的信息泄漏，并保持保留数据表现；摘要未列评测基准或具体数值。

Insight: 将行为上的“会拒答”与知识上的“确实不再保留”分开优化，可避免把沉默误当作遗忘。现有结论在摘要中为定性描述，未给出多选泄漏率、遗忘—保留权衡及不同知识类型上的差异。

Abstract: Current evaluations of multimodal unlearning typically focus on whether a model stops outputting target information. This surface-level criterion, however, masks two critical failure modes. First, knowledge suppression techniques often induce confabulation, leading the model to hallucinate facts about the unlearned subject. Second, refusal training merely alters observable behavior without erasing the underlying knowledge; such models might decline open queries but still identify correct answers under multiple-choice probing. To overcome these limitations, we propose Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD). This method is designed to achieve honest ignorance, a state where the model genuinely loses the target knowledge and learns to acknowledge its absence. FASD separates these goals into two complementary channels. The behavior channel distills appropriate refusals from an ignorance-prompted copy of the model itself. Crucially, target tokens are masked from the teacher distribution to avoid accidentally reteaching the forgotten concepts. Simultaneously, the knowledge channel directly suppresses ground-truth answer spans independently of the model’s generated responses. Experiments demonstrate that FASD successfully unlearns target knowledge, prevents information leakage in open-ended tasks, and preserves performance on retained data. The resulting model not only forgets the specified information but accurately recognizes the boundaries of its own knowledge. Code and data will be released upon publication.

[343] How to Build a Benchmark That Actually Measures Taste cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.CVPDF

Xiaofan Wu, Xi Zeng, Miaoxia Chen, Peishan Chen, Shuyan Li

TL;DR: TasteBench 提出带专家标注、线索排查和侧位随机化的成对审美基准，并用试点揭示位置偏差、文件名泄漏和题目过易等效度威胁。

Details

Motivation: 与专家一致的“品味”基准应测量工艺判断，而非模型利用测试构造线索；若标签、选项位置或文件名泄漏，模型高分并不能证明审美判断能力。

Result: 基准覆盖视觉、品牌、书籍和科技物品，使用冻结量规、至少三位专家金标及明确弱标签隔离；Round-1 试点主分析含 250 对。审计发现首选项以 0.956 概率位于 A，恒答 A 得 0.956；文件名 token 线索得 0.912。书籍、品牌、科技领域的人类一致率近乎满分；随机化 A/B 后五个 VLM 在这些领域仍全得 1.0，视觉领域约 0.84–0.91，事后困难子集 107 对仍无法降低工艺领域天花板。侧位随机化工具将偏斜从 0.916 改至 0.495/0.505。作者明确未评测互动度、时代/圈层条件或校准，也不声称通用品味 SOTA。

Insight: 基准验证协议能够发现并修复位置偏差与文件名泄漏，但工艺领域仍存在题目难度上限，单靠去线索无法让模型与人类拉开差异。该工作是对基准效度的审计而非模型品味能力竞赛；Round-2 需增加更难题目。

Abstract: Expert-aligned “taste” benchmarks should reward craft judgment, not the ability to game the test. We introduce TasteBench, a pairwise good-vs-bad benchmark across visual, brand, book, and tech items under a frozen rubric with expert-only gold (panel n>=3; percent agreement >=0.60 primary gate; weak engagement labels train/analysis-only), together with a control protocol that separates craft judgment from test-gaming. Applying the protocol to a Round-1 pilot (primary_human_expert; three biological human experts; n=250 pairs) surfaces and quantifies three validity threats: two construction artifacts that inflate the trivial-baseline layer, and a difficulty ceiling that inflates every score. (1) Position: the preferred item is slot A with probability 0.956, so an always_item_a policy scores 0.956 (fair chance 0.5). (2) Lexical leakage: a filename token cue scores 0.912. (3) Difficulty ceiling: craft domains show near-ceiling human agreement (book/brand/tech 1.0), and even under A/B randomization (eval_assignment_seed7; gold_side_A 0.47) all five VLM cards reach 1.0 on craft, with only visual separating (0.84-0.91; a post-hoc hard subset, n=107, leaves craft at 1.0). The protocol (expert-only gold, a weak-label firewall, side randomization at construction, filename scrubbing, and hard filters) makes each artifact measurable and, for the two construction artifacts, correctable; we release a reference eval harness and a side-randomization tool, and show the tool removes the position skew (0.916 to 0.495/0.505). The result is a calibrated view of what the benchmark does and does not yet measure: position and leakage are fixable, whereas the craft-domain ceiling is a pair-difficulty limit that Round-2 must address. We do not evaluate engagement, era/circle conditioning, or calibration here, and we claim no general taste SOTA.

[344] CUSE: Fine-Grained Multimodal Unlearning with Counterfactual Guidance and On-Policy Self-Distillation cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Chenlu Ding, Jiancan Wu, Yanchen Luo, Tianyu Zhang, Yancheng Yuan

TL;DR: CUSE 通过移除目标证据的反事实输入识别应遗忘的 token，再对当前策略采样回答进行 on-policy 自蒸馏，细粒度地同时学习遗忘和保留。

Details

Motivation: 多模态模型遗忘敏感、版权或不安全信息时，需要删除目标内容而保留同一回答中的非目标部分；既有方法常对整段回答施加统一目标，并依赖固定离线监督，与当前策略行为不匹配。

Result: CUSE 构造去除目标证据的反事实输入，根据 token 概率变化确定需加强遗忘的部分；随后在当前策略采样的回答上蒸馏 token 级遗忘和保留目标，冻结原模型副本作为教师，并提供相应遗忘/保留特权上下文。在 MLLMU-Bench 上，CUSE 相较最强基线将 forget-set ROUGE-L 降低 33.6%，同时 retain-set ROUGE-L 高 1.2%。

Insight: 反事实输入提供 token 级遗忘重要性信号，on-policy 训练则使修改针对模型当前会生成的内容，有助于兼顾遗忘与保留。摘要只报告 ROUGE-L 指标，不能据此判断其他语义泄漏、拒答行为或不同目标强度下的普遍权衡。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reproduce sensitive, copyrighted, or unsafe information from their training data. Effective unlearning must remove target information while preserving non-target content, even within the same response. Existing methods typically apply uniform forgetting objectives to complete responses and rely on fixed, off-policy supervision, resulting in coarse token control and misalignment with the model’s current behavior. Abstract: Training LLM agents to interact with users over multiple turns is challenging because the learning signal depends not only on the agent, but also on the user simulator and environment, which jointly shape the agent’s experience. Abstract: The relationship between odor chemistry and perception remains incompletely understood. Further, during the mixture-level training, we learned low-rank molecular embeddings that enabled better prediction of held-out mixture similarities than component-overlap metrics, even for mixture pairs with no shared molecules. Together, these results show that language-derived descriptions can provide scalable supervision for predicting the perceptual organization of complex natural mixtures, contributing to a quantitative understanding of how molecular composition gives rise to odor perception.

Abstract: Looped language models (LMs) reuse one block of layers several times per token generation, promising more latent computation at no additional storage cost. Abstract: Combining pretrained models is a common strategy for building AI systems, whether by aligning a vision encoder with a language model or merging fine-tuned checkpoints. However, finding compatible pairs typically requires costly empirical search, as compatibility is known only after alignment or merging. Building on the observation that representational convergence is most robust at the level of local neighborhoods, COMPASS decomposes model compatibility into two cheap-to-compute axes: a pair-specific ease, defined as the $k$-NN overlap between the two encoders, and a paradigm-level ceiling, capturing the maximum overlap their training paradigms allow. Together, these two axes provide a ranking of candidate model pairs and prescribe how to act on each pair: (i) prioritize pairs that already agree and whose paradigms are compatible, (ii) invest additional compute on pairs with compatible paradigms but low initial agreement, (iii) switch the pretraining paradigm when it cannot support sufficient agreement, or (iv) deprioritize pairs that score poorly on both axes. We apply COMPASS to $72$ cross-modal alignment experiments and $392$ task-arithmetic model merges and show that compatibility estimates by COMPASS strongly correlate with downstream success, achieving average Pearson correlation of $0.91$ on cross-modal alignment tasks and $0.70$ on model merging.

Abstract: Harness self-evolution revises an agent’s software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model–harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.

Abstract: Sign Language Recognition (SLR) presents complex challenges due to variable signing speeds and spatial intricacies. Specifically, Indian Sign Language (ISL) requires precise modeling of its inherently bimanual nature and is bottlenecked by the scarcity of large-vocabulary benchmarks and the inability of standard models to handle irregular signing velocities. To minimize computational redundancy, an entropy-driven SVD sampler that dynamically extracts informative keyframes is used. Because this subsampling creates irregular physical time gaps, the proposed architecture employs a Continuous Dual Positional Encoding paired with a distance-aware Elastic Transformer to preserve natural signing rhythm. Spatially, a Kinematically-Conditioned Adaptive GCN explicitly models bimanual geometry using unified bone-joint features. To validate our framework, a 120-class, 9,453-video native ISL dataset is created. Augmented by Physical Node Dropout and ArcFace optimization to mitigate subject-specific memorization, our framework achieves a competitive 89.8% accuracy, establishing a strong baseline for complex sign language modeling.

Lingsen You, Yujun Guo, Xinyu Zhong, Zijie Feng, Wentong Wang

Insight: 论文将分割组件、覆盖/弃权行为与完整 agentic 自我改进区分，并明确没有证明患者级有效性或临床安全。狭窄像素类别极不平衡，AUPRC 低；较高 AUROC 不能单独说明分割可靠，且完整递归方案尚未执行。

Abstract: ScienceBuddy-PV adapts the ScienceBuddy recursive-in-recursive design to panvascular intervention research through a structured evidence ledger, device-vessel ontology, abstention contract and retained failure bank. Recursive harness optimization and outer-loop model learning, including reinforcement learning, are specified but not executed. We audit a fixed component, rather than the complete agent system, using separate ARCADE syntax and stenosis tasks (1,000 training, 200 validation and 300 test images per task). A shared task-masked convolutional model was trained once per representation setting; its parameters and the heuristic support gate were then held fixed, with the stenosis threshold selected on validation data. On the locked test sets, syntax Dice was 0.475 (95% CI 0.459-0.490) and stenosis Dice was 0.231 (95% CI 0.214-0.249). Stenosis pixel AUROC was 0.957 and AUPRC was 0.180 at prevalence 0.00975. In a constructed mask audit, it accepted 44.3% of reference candidates and rejected 55.7%, exposing the cost of abstention. Acceptance does not establish correctness or clinical safety. This public-data component audit makes support and abstention measurable and provides a reproducible protocol for future collaborative agent studies. Details

Motivation: 众包灾害照片可提供及时地面观测，但其 GEOINT 价值取决于观测地理分布、解释质量和能否可靠定位；需研究 GeoAI 与人类地理判断各自优势。

Result: 研究用 30 项地理线索及推理证据指标评估 VLM，将众包照片与街景、遥感影像结合并用 Sinkhorn 重排序，R@1/R@5/R@10 分别为 40.90%、61.10%、69.45%；年度 R@1 在 25.00%–65.07% 间变化。地理推理方面，Qwen3.6-27B 总体一致率 67%，InternVL3-8B 为 51%；两者对局部、具体地点证据都比宽泛空间配置更难。档案地理和时间分布不均，受灾类型、社区生命线和业务重点变化影响。

Abstract: Crowdsourced disaster imagery provides timely, ground-level observations when conventional disaster mapping is delayed or incomplete, yet its geographic value depends on where observations are produced, how they are interpreted, and whether they can be reliably located as actionable Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT). Using more than a decade of PhotoMappers, a crowdsourced disaster-mapping initiative, this study examines the changing geography of disaster information and asks how emerging GeoAI models compare with human geographic interpretation. We combine longitudinal spatial analysis with cross-view geolocalization using street view imagery (SVI) and remote sensing imagery (RSI), and evaluate vision-language models (VLMs) reasoning through 30 indicators spanning geographic cues and reasoning evidence. The results reveal a geographically and temporally uneven archive shaped by changing disaster types, Community Lifelines, and operational priorities. Integrating VGI, SVI, and RSI with Sinkhorn re-ranking achieves 40.90% R@1, 61.10% R@5, and 69.45% R@10, while yearly R@1 varies markedly from 25.00% to 65.07%. Geographic reasoning is similarly uneven: Qwen3.6-27B achieves an overall agreement of 67% compared with 51% for InternVL3-8B, with both models showing greater difficulty with localized and place-specific evidence than broad spatial configurations. We argue that the value of GeoAI lies less in replacing volunteered geographic interpretation than in complementing it, scaling candidate retrieval while retaining human judgment for ambiguous and consequential cases. This provides a pathway toward more human-centered and responsible GeoAI for disaster mapping. All data and code are openly available at https://github.com/bobleegogogo/PhotoMappers-VLM.

[356] XAI-Guided Fourier Domain Generalisation for Pure-Simulation Sim-to-Real Deep Reinforcement Learning cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Wei Yao, Chuyao Wang, Ziwei Wang, Nabil Aouf

TL;DR: XFD 用模拟观测的可解释性归因定位策略依赖的视觉证据，再通过策略条件化傅里叶干预合成鲁棒视觉域，以改善纯模拟训练驾驶策略的零样本实车迁移。

Details

Motivation: 模拟训练的视觉驾驶策略部署到现实中常明显退化；图像迁移需大量目标域数据，随机域随机化又可能加入与真实差异无关的扰动。

Result: 框架将归因图转为策略条件化频域干预，扰动外观敏感频谱分量、同时尽量保留任务关键空间结构；鲁棒策略优化鼓励关注关键特征并抑制无关视觉变化。作者在模拟和零样本实车部署实验中，报告相较标准策略和随机域随机化基线，行驶距离与奖励均提升，尤其在背景杂乱的未见地图上更明显。归因分析显示，策略在模拟和真实观测间保留更一致的任务相关视觉证据。摘要未给具体数值。

Insight: 用策略归因指导域随机化可使视觉扰动针对模型脆弱处，而非均匀添加任意变化；零样本实车结果提供了迁移证据。摘要未披露实车场景数、距离/奖励增幅和安全事件，无法量化部署鲁棒性。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for vision-based autonomous driving, but policies trained in simulation often suffer severe performance degradation when deployed in the real world. Existing sim-to-real methods commonly address this gap through image-transfer-based domain adaptation or policy-agnostic domain randomisation. However, the former requires laborious acquisition of target-domain data and is often limited to the deployment domain, whereas the latter introduces unguided perturbations that may not reflect the underlying sim-to-real discrepancy, leading to suboptimal transfer performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose XFD, an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)-guided Fourier domain generalisation framework for pure-simulation sim-to-real reinforcement learning. The proposed framework extracts explainability attribution maps from simulated observations, and converts these attributions into policy-conditioned Fourier-domain interventions. By perturbing appearance-sensitive spectral components while preserving task-defining spatial structures, XFD constructs robustness-enhancing visual domains entirely within simulation. Subsequently, the proposed robust policy optimisation guides the policy towards attending to task-critical features while suppressing sensitivity to irrelevant visual information. Extensive experiments in simulation and zero-shot real-world deployment demonstrate that XFD consistently improves traveled distance and reward over standard policy and randomly domain-randomised baseline, especially on unseen maps with cluttered backgrounds. Attribution-based analysis further proves that the proposed policy preserves more consistent task-relevant visual evidence across simulation and real-world observations.

[357] Hardware-Friendly Token-Group Activation Quantization for Low-Bit Mamba Super-Resolution cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Jinwoo Chung, Jangho Kim

TL;DR: Token-Group Quantization 根据扫描前特征预测空间 token 分组，选择离线校准的组级激活裁剪范围，并用频域教师—学生损失保留超分辨率高频细节。

Details

Motivation: Mamba 超分辨率模型的 selective scan 会使不同空间 token 激活范围不同，单一层级裁剪范围不适配所有 token；但推理期再做扫描后动态分组不利于硬件部署。

Result: 方法用扫描后激活描述聚类生成伪标签，训练轻量预测器从扫描前特征推断分组，再查询离线校准的组级裁剪表，推理时无需采集运行统计、动态更新裁剪或扫描后再分组。Frequency-Preserving Refinement 对齐全精度教师与量化学生输出的傅里叶幅度和相位。在多种 PTQ 协议、位宽、骨干和任务上，作者报告持续超过 Mamba/SR PTQ 基线，并可迁移到 Transformer 超分和 Vision Mamba 分类、与旋转量化兼容；Jetson Orin Nano 上相较 FP16 加速 2.23 倍。摘要未提供具体质量分数。

Insight: 静态预测分组让 token 自适应裁剪范围仍可在硬件友好推理中实现；频域目标专门补偿低比特对高频结构的损伤。2.23 倍速度仅在 Jetson Orin Nano 对 FP16 测量，摘要未给画质折损和不同量化位宽下的详细权衡。

Abstract: Mamba-based super-resolution models are efficient alternatives to Transformer-based restoration backbones, but their low-bit post-training quantization remains challenging because selective scan, Mamba’s input-dependent state-space operator, induces different activation ranges across spatial tokens. Thus, a single layer-wise clipping range poorly matches all tokens. We propose Token-Group Quantization, a hardware-friendly activation PTQ framework that statically approximates a hardware-unfriendly post-scan grouping oracle, where tokens with similar preferred clipping ranges are assigned to the same group. To avoid runtime post-scan grouping in static low-bit inference, a lightweight predictor infers the groups from pre-scan features available before the quantized scan path. During calibration, we form pseudo-labels by clustering post-scan activation descriptors that capture similar rounding–clipping behavior. At inference, the frozen predictor maps pre-scan features to groups and selects entries from offline-calibrated group-wise clipping-bound tables, without runtime statistics collection, dynamic clipping updates, or post-scan group assignment. To address low-bit restoration degradation, we further introduce a Frequency-Preserving Refinement (FPR) objective for clipping-bound calibration. FPR aligns Fourier amplitude and phase between full-precision teacher and quantized student outputs to preserve high-frequency structures. Across PTQ protocols, bit-widths, backbones, and tasks, our method consistently outperforms prior Mamba and SR PTQ baselines, transfers to Transformer SR and Vision Mamba classification, composes with rotation-based quantization, and achieves 2.23x speedup on Jetson Orin Nano over FP16. Code is available here.

[358] VL-DocIR: A Benchmark for Vision-Based Long Document Information Retrieval cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Simon Ott, Yufan Chen, Ruiping Liu, Junwei Zheng, Jiale Wei

TL;DR: VL-DocIR 构建页面级长文档视觉检索基准，覆盖跨页和跨文档证据，并提供结构平衡指标以诊断单页检索与多页证据整合差距。

Details

Motivation: 现有视觉文档检索评估偏向短文档和单个相关页，难以反映真实查询需跨多页甚至多文档整合证据的情况。

Result: VL-DocIR 从 29,641 份 HTML 源文档渲染出 388,548 页图像，来源包括 Wikipedia、arXiv、PubMed 和 SEC 代理声明。基准包含 271,760 个查询、23 个领域、六种证据结构，覆盖单页、同文档多页和跨文档。证据标注锚定页面图像及 HTML 元素，查询经过清晰度、正确性、封闭性和避免显式布局线索等清洗。评测单/多向量检索器及文档上下文打分、查询拆分、重排、轮转集成。最强配置在结构平衡 Macro 评估达到 nDCGAll@10 69.3、RecallAll@10 80.6；跨文档检索仍比单页难得多，文档上下文分数尤其有助于同文档多页查询。

Insight: 不仅要找到相关页，还要完整检索回答所需证据结构；按结构平衡评估可防止单页样例掩盖跨文档困难。强模型结果为多组件配置，摘要未拆分各模块增益和检索成本。

Abstract: Vision-based document retrieval has improved rapidly, but current evaluation settings still emphasize short documents and single relevant pages. This leaves an important gap between leaderboard performance and realistic long-document retrieval, where the evidence needed to answer a query may span multiple pages or even multiple documents. We present VL-DocIR, a page-level benchmark for evidence-complete visual long-document retrieval. VL-DocIR is built from 29,641 HTML-born documents rendered into 388,548 page images from Wikipedia, arXiv, PubMed, and SEC proxy statements. It contains 271,760 queries across 23 domains and six evidence structures, covering single-page, within-document multi-page, and cross-document evidence configurations. Evidence annotations are grounded to rendered pages and HTML element identifiers, and queries are filtered with a cleaning pipeline targeting clarity, correctness, closedness, and the absence of explicit layout references. We evaluate leading single-vector and multi-vector visual retrievers together with diagnostic retrieval settings such as document-context scoring, query splitting, reranking, and round-robin ensembles. The strongest evaluated configuration reaches 69.3 nDCGAll@10 and 80.6 RecallAll@10 under structure-balanced Macro evaluation, but source- and evidence-structure breakdowns show that cross-document retrieval remains substantially harder than single-page retrieval, and that document-context scoring is especially helpful for within-document multi-page queries. VL-DocIR exposes these failure modes and provides a more demanding target for visual long-document retrieval. The new dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://yufanchen96.github.io/VL-DocIR.

[359] ChemExplain: A Multimodal Benchmark for Explanatory Chemical Reasoning cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Aotian Chen, Frazier N. Baker, Reza Averly, Shan Zhang, Tianao Chen

TL;DR: ChemExplain 用 1,180 道多模态化学题评估模型能否从分子/反应图中找到最能解释实验效应的结构特征，而不仅是预测结果或生成反应路径。

Details

Motivation: 现有化学基准多测结果预测或反应路径生成，较少检验模型能否解释观察到的化学效应为何发生及归因到图示结构的哪个特征。

Result: 基准问题取自 383 篇同行评审论文，每题包含分子/反应图、观察到的化学效应及四种分别关联不同可见结构特征的解释。正确的结构—机制关系来自源论文证据而非问题生成 LLM 自行编造；多智能体流程分三阶段质控，并由八位化学专家核验。最强评测模型准确率 78.6%；600 题专家复核子集的推理轨迹分析中，最强模型错误有 71.4% 被归为归因失败，所分析开源及化学专用模型也以此为最大错误类别。

Insight: 化学图像问答不仅需要识别结构和调用知识，还需把解释归因到直接相关的特征；该错误是当前模型的主要瓶颈。专家审核加强题目可信度，但78.6%成绩来自特定多选基准，不能代表开放式科学解释质量。

Abstract: Current chemistry benchmarks primarily evaluate outcome prediction or reaction pathway generation, but rarely test whether a model can explain why an observed chemical effect occurs. We introduce ChemExplain, a benchmark of 1,180 multiple-choice chemistry questions drawn from 383 peer-reviewed papers. Each question pairs a molecular or reaction image with an observed chemical effect and four candidate explanations, each associated with a different structural feature visible in the image. Answering requires the model to perceive the depicted structure, apply chemical knowledge, and identify which feature most directly explains the effect, a capability we term explanatory attribution. The correct feature-mechanism relation is derived from supporting evidence in the source paper rather than invented by the question-generation LLM. We construct the benchmark automatically with a multi-agent framework that applies progressive quality control at three stages and validate it with eight chemistry domain experts. The strongest evaluated model reaches 78.6% accuracy, leaving considerable room for improvement. On a 600-question expert-reviewed subset, reasoning-trace analysis classifies 71.4% of the strongest model’s errors as attribution failures. Attribution is also the largest error category for the open-source and chemistry-specific models included in our analysis.

[360] IsoVRBench: Video Reward Modeling Without Human Feedback cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Shuyue Stella Li, Jacqueline He, Jiahui Chen, Sreya Dutta Roy, Yulia Tsvetkov

TL;DR: IsoVRBench 通过一次只改变一个视频属性的受控干预构造偏好对，量化视频奖励模型分别识别提示一致性、视觉质量、动作时间顺序等属性的能力。

Details

Motivation: 常规视频偏好对常同时在提示匹配、视觉保真、运动和生成器身份等方面不同，因此总体准确率无法说明奖励模型实际能区分哪些属性。

Result: 基准包含 8,000 对、覆盖八类单属性干预的合成偏好对，无需人工标注。最强奖励模型能分辨生成器间的宽泛质量差异，却容易忽略时间顺序：帧重排任务仅 60.8%，人类为 100%；既有基准排名未预测此失败。用隔离属性数据训练后，IsoVRM 在 VBench-2.0 上比使用更大规模人工偏好数据训练的对应模型高 3.8 分；用其后训练的视频生成器 IsoWan，在人类偏好上胜过人工数据对照，和人工偏好数据结合还有叠加收益。

Insight: 单属性控制对有助于诊断奖励模型具体盲点，而不是只给一个聚合偏好分；自动合成数据也易随生成器演化扩充。帧顺序 60.8% 与人工 100% 的差距表明高总体分会掩盖时序失效；摘要未说明人工评估规模。

Abstract: Video reward models are trained and evaluated on human preferences between videos that often differ simultaneously on properties such as prompt alignment, visual fidelity, motion, and generator identity. As a result, aggregate accuracy does not reveal which video properties a reward model can reliably distinguish. We construct preference pairs by controlled interventions that change one property of a generated video while holding the rest fixed. The resulting pairs, by construction, provide preferences for how the videos differ along a specific dimension, without requiring any human annotation. We propose IsoVRBench, a video generation reward modeling benchmark of 8,000 such pairs across eight interventions, and show that state-of-the-art models separate broad quality differences between generators but miss important features such as temporal order. The best reward model reaches only 60.8% on reordered frames against 100% for humans, and rankings on existing benchmarks do not predict this failure. Using the synthetic isolated intervation pairs as training data leads to 1) IsoVRM, a reward model outperforming its counterpart trained with a larger human labeled preference dataset by 3.8 points on VBench-2.0, 2) IsoWan, the video generator post-trained with IsoVRM, outperforming its human-data counterpart in human preferences, and 3) gains that stack when combined with human data. Because intervention pairs are automatically generated rather than collected, the benchmark and training data can be easily extended as generators evolve.

[361] MedEvo: Medical Reasoning Evolution through Knowledge Navigation cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.LG | q-bio.QMPDF

Xiaoliang Wang, Zhuo Chen, Chuanyang Zheng, Quanbin Wang, Jiangwei Lao

TL;DR: MedEvo 让学生保留失败推理轨迹中的有效前缀，只修复首个关键错误，并根据独立反馈集中的医学能力缺口优先选择新训练问题。

Details

Motivation: 多模态医学推理常蒸馏教师完整推理，丢弃学生失败轨迹中可保留的有效推理；通用纠错方法也难覆盖图像读取、解剖上下文和鉴别诊断等医学特定错误。

Result: gold-blind 审核器定位每条失败 rollout 的首个关键错误并提供最小、不给答案的提示，学生保留正确前缀并重生成错误后缀；每轮再按医学标签统计留出反馈集的能力缺口，优先生成相关问题并修复。在仅监督微调设置下，Qwen3.5-9B 七基准平均准确率从 65.57% 提至 69.12%，MedXpertQA-MM 从 47.40% 提至 54.50%，超过教师蒸馏 SFT 的 66.93% 平均分。Qwen3.5-35B 从 67.91% 提至 73.04%，397B 从 71.83% 提至 74.95%。分析显示失败轨迹含可保留推理，修复成功不等于学到可迁移能力，独立反馈对持续改进关键。

Insight: 错误后缀修复而非整条轨迹替换可保留学生已有正确推理，并把训练数据选择与能力缺口相连。摘要区分修复成功与实际学习价值，提醒需独立反馈评估；结果是基准准确率，不能视为临床诊断验证。

Abstract: Medical multimodal reasoning models are typically trained on teacher-generated rationales, discarding the valid reasoning in students’ own failed trajectories, while general-domain correction methods offer little guidance for errors in image reading, anatomical context, or differential diagnosis. We propose MedEvo, which uses medical knowledge, namely a tag taxonomy and error-type diagnosis, to navigate both trajectory repair and data selection. For each failed rollout, a gold-blind auditor locates the first consequential error and provides a minimal, answer-free hint; the same student retains the valid prefix and regenerates the erroneous suffix. After each round, MedEvo identifies capability gaps across medical tags on a held-out feedback set and prioritizes related questions for new rollouts and repairs. With supervised fine-tuning (SFT) alone, MedEvo raises Qwen3.5-9B mean accuracy across seven benchmarks from 65.57% to 69.12% (47.40% to 54.50% on the multimodal track of MedXpertQA (MedXpertQA-MM)), surpassing teacher-distillation SFT (66.93%). It also raises Qwen3.5-35B and Qwen3.5-397B mean accuracy from 67.91% to 73.04% and from 71.83% to 74.95%, respectively. Our analyses show that failed trajectories contain reasoning worth preserving, that repair success does not imply learning value, and that independent feedback is key to sustained improvement.

[362] Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.ROPDF

Thinker Team, Peng Gao, Jichao Jiao, Chen Liao, Daqin Luo

TL;DR: Thinker-WM 用共享 Unified Dynamics Transformer 联合表示并生成 RGB、度量深度和机器人动作，使视频预测、动作生成和策略推断等能力共用动力学表示。

Details

Motivation: 现有世界模型常将视觉动态、几何结构和可执行动作放在不同接口或下游模块中，难以在同一动力学表示内共同演化。

Result: 模型使用模态专属编码器/解码器，但在共享中间表示中联合演化外观、几何和动作；同一参数化支持联合视频—动作生成、世界预测、策略推断、动作条件生成、视频到动作和逆动力学。作者用轻量运动探针显示冻结视觉表示含可恢复运动信息。训练数据约 2 万小时第一人称视频、1 万小时真实机器人数据和 1,000 小时模拟数据，其中约 4,000 小时机器人数据带对齐深度。作者报告在 embodied world-model 评测表现强，并在 EWMBench、WorldOlympiad、WorldArena 排名第一；控制实验支持动作条件、几何交互及多功能训练的收益。

Insight: 共享中间动力学表示旨在把视觉、几何和动作联系起来，避免每项能力各自建立接口。摘要未提供各榜单分数、模型规模和训练成本；“排名第一”限于所比较系统及评测版本。

Abstract: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.

cs.CR [Back]

[363] Differential Privacy Protected Preference Alignment on Survey Derived Data cs.CR | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Xiuyuan Qi, Yi Wang, Wenjie Wang

TL;DR: 该研究针对世界价值观调查问卷中敏感偏好数据，研究用标签级差分隐私保护语言模型偏好对齐，并比较随机响应、指数机制与 DP-SGD。

Details

Motivation: 偏好对齐数据可能包含政治信念、社会规范、宗教、性别态度和文化价值等敏感信息；问卷监督通常是序数标签而非成对偏好，现有隐私研究较少针对这类数据设计机制。

Result: 作者先展示已对齐模型的隐私脆弱性，将任务表述为评分预测并引入标签差分隐私，构建结合随机响应、指数机制和 DP-SGD 的隐私流程。实验报告简单的标签级机制优于梯度级方法，预处理时选择适当聚合函数也有较大影响。摘要未给隐私预算 ε、效用分数或攻击成功率。

Insight: 隐私保护应匹配问卷序数标签结构，直接扰动标签可能比仅依赖训练时梯度保护更有效；聚合方式也会影响结果。未报告隐私预算和效用数字，暂不能比较严格隐私保证下的对齐效果。

Abstract: Preference alignment enables language models to better reflect human values, but the preference data contains sensitive information, especially when derived from surveys about political beliefs, social norms, religion, gender attitudes, and cultural values. This paper studies privacy-preserving alignment on questionnaire-derived data from the World Values Survey, where supervision takes the form of ordinal labels rather than standard pairwise rankings. Existing efforts mainly focus on general privacy protections upon model training, while data-specific methods for survey data remain unexplored. We first show the vulnerability of aligned models, then formulate the task as rating prediction and introduce label differential privacy. Building on this formulation, we construct a differential private pipeline utilizing three privacy mechanisms: randomized response, exponential mechanism, and DP-SGD. Experiments show that simple label-level mechanisms outperform gradient-level methods, and proper aggregation function for preprocessing also make large contribution. The new fine-grained private comparison motivates explorations toward language model alignment with formal privacy guarantees.

[364] DPOison-VL: Clean Preference Poisoning in Vision-Language Direct Preference Optimization cs.CR | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Chengtao Jian, Kai Yang

TL;DR: DPOison-VL 通过少量训练图像上的不可见扰动，在提示、回答和偏好标签语义不变时操纵 VLM 的 DPO 对齐方向。

Details

Motivation: 现有偏好投毒常修改显式监督信号或使用可见触发器，容易被人工检查发现；多模态偏好图像中的隐蔽扰动风险研究不足。

Result: 作者将干净偏好投毒表述为双层优化，以梯度对齐代理引导图像扰动朝攻击者指定偏好，并提出 preference displacement score 在固定投毒预算下选择样本；还推导偏好反转的充分条件。在多类攻击任务、不同 VLM 架构和规模上，最多 2% 投毒数据可达到最高 98% ASR，并具有跨模型迁移性，同时大体保持干净准确率和通用效用。

Insight: 即使偏好文本和标签看似无害，图像侧不可见扰动也可能改变 DPO 学到的偏好，说明多模态偏好数据需接受图像完整性审计。最高 98% ASR 是特定攻击设置的最好结果，摘要未给不同攻击/防御的完整分布。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a widely adopted approach for aligning vision-language models (VLMs), yet the security of multimodal preference data remains largely unexplored. Existing preference poisoning attacks either corrupt explicit supervision signals or require visible triggers, making them detectable under human inspection. We introduce DPOison-VL, the first clean preference poisoning attack against VLM-DPO, which manipulates model alignment solely through imperceptible perturbations on a small fraction of training images, while leaving all prompts, responses, and preference annotations semantically intact. We formulate poison construction as a bilevel optimization and derive a gradient alignment surrogate that efficiently steers image perturbations toward the attacker-specified preference. We further introduce a preference displacement score for principled poison selection with provable first-order optimality under a fixed poison budget, and derive a sufficient condition for preference inversion. Extensive experiments across diverse attack tasks, different VLM architectures and scales, and baseline comparisons demonstrate that DPOison-VL achieves up to 98% ASR with only 2% poisoned data and exhibits cross-model transferability, while largely preserving clean accuracy and general utility. Our findings reveal a critical vulnerability in VLM-DPO, where imperceptible image perturbations in preference training data can silently redirect alignment.
