[365] Personalized LLM Recommendation with Semantic IDs: Autoregressive Beam Search vs. Multi-Token Prediction cs.IR | cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Sejoon Oh, Fernando Amat Gil, Evan Smothers, Dan Iter, Mark Thornburg

TL;DR: 该行业规模研究比较语义 ID 推荐中的单头自回归 beam search 与多 token 预测，发现前者多数产品指标更好、训练成本更低，后者仅推理吞吐领先。

Details

Motivation: 大规模个性化推荐正从 embedding 表检索转向生成短序列语义 ID，使单个指令模型可统一检索、内容理解和语言交互；关键问题是如何生成语义 ID。

Result: 研究在同时处理个性化检索、内容问答和指令遵循的流媒体目录系统中，对自回归单头解码和多 token prediction（MTP）作同规模直接比较，并为 MTP 增加联合 SID 分数排序损失。单头 beam search 在排序和内容 QA 等大多数关键指标上持续胜过 MTP，Qwen3-8B 规模训练美元成本约低 2.6 倍；MTP 仅在原始推理吞吐上占优。相较带辅助排序头的旧非 SID 基线，SID 系统冷启动排序提高 77%、内容 QA 准确率提高 22%、训练快 2.8 倍；语言指标下降归因于扩大的 SID 词表，作者用强化学习后训练处理该回退。

Insight: 解码速度高不等于产品端效果更好；在排序和内容理解需求下，beam search 的质量及训练成本更有优势。性能比较来自特定流媒体目录和多任务栈，摘要未给线上业务指标或 MTP 与 beam search 的具体吞吐差值。

Abstract: Large-scale personalization is shifting from embedding-table retrieval to LLM-based recommenders that generate the Semantic ID (SID) of the item to recommend, where each SID is a short sequence of discrete hierarchical content codes. A single instruction-tuned model can then unify retrieval, content understanding, and language, and recommend brand-new titles from their content alone using SID; then, how should the model generate the SID? Traditionally, models rely on a single language modeling head that generates tokens autoregressively, typically using constrained beam search. In contrast, an emerging body of work explores multi-token prediction (MTP), where dedicated heads predict all tokens in parallel, substantially reducing the decoding latency associated with beam search. We report an industry-scale, apples-to-apples comparison of these two generation paradigms: single-head autoregressive decoding vs. MTP. We introduce a new auxiliary ranking loss, defined over the joint SID score, to train the MTP objective. We evaluate the SID training objectives on both quality and training/inference cost, inside a multi-task LLM that jointly does personalized retrieval, content question-answering (QA), and instruction following over a large streaming-media catalog. Our experiments show single-head beam search consistently beats MTP on most product-critical metrics: ranking and content QA, and trains at roughly 2.6x lower dollar cost on Qwen3-8B scale; MTP wins only on raw inference throughput. Around this finding, we detail an efficient training and inference stack and report end-to-end gains over the previous non-SID baseline equipped with an auxiliary ranking head: +77% item cold-start ranking, +22% content-QA accuracy, +2.8x faster training, with language metric regression traced to SID vocabulary expansion. We address the language regression by reinforcement learning post training.

[366] RALI@iKAT 2026: Retrieval-aware User Profile Denoising via Personalized Conversational Dense Retrieval cs.IR | cs.CLPDF

Yuchen Hui, Fengran Mo, Jia Ao Sun, Yuxing Tian, Wenhao Xu

TL;DR: PCDR 将对话历史和用户画像联合映射到面向检索的稠密空间，以检索相关性标注训练用户画像去噪，避免先将画像短语拼进查询的稀疏重写流程。

Details

Motivation: 长期对话形成的用户画像会积累噪声。传统个性化查询重写依赖 LLM 选择画像短语并扩展原查询，容易把去噪简化为显式短语筛选，和下游文档相关性建模脱节。

Result: Personalized Conversational Dense Retrieval 继承对话稠密检索器的上下文去噪能力，联合投影对话与画像到专用检索嵌入空间，训练只需少量个性化相关性标注。在 iKAT 2026 任务中，PCDR 作为会话式 AI 助手的核心检索组件进行评估。摘要未报告排名、检索指标或与基线的对比结果。

Insight: 直接以检索相关性学习画像表示，可在潜在空间去噪，而不是依赖查询中逐词选择用户信息。当前摘要只说明它参加 iKAT 2026 任务、未给结果数值，无法判断其实际检索效果或少量标注的具体规模。

Abstract: Modern conversational information access systems continuously extract user information from conversations to build user profiles for personalized retrieval. As user profiles accumulate over time, they inevitably become noisy, making effective user profile denoising a fundamental challenge. Existing personalized conversational query reformulation methods rely on the black-box reasoning capability of LLMs to expand the original query with relevant user profile phrases, producing a verbose query for retrieval. Such rewrite-then-retrieve pipelines reduce user profile denoising to the explicit selection of profile phrases in the sparse token space, separating personalization from downstream relevance modeling. Consequently, they often fail to identify user information that is truly beneficial for retrieval. To enable retrieval-aware user profile denoising, we propose Personalized Conversational Dense Retrieval (PCDR), which learns to jointly project the conversation history and user profile into a latent embedding space dedicated to retrieval. By inheriting the context denoising capability from conversational dense retrievers, PCDR requires only a handful of personalized relevance annotations for training. We evaluate PCDR on the iKAT 2026 tasks, where it serves as the core retrieval component of a conversational AI agent assisting users with complex information needs.

cs.LG [Back]

[367] SemTree: Judge-Aware Semantic Decision Trees for Inspectable and Repairable Rule Decisions cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Jincheng Gao, Wei Ding, Shuo Sun

TL;DR: SemTree 将规则判断表示为带 Yes/No/Unknown 判据的语义决策树，由可替换语义裁判逐节点执行，使错误可定位、可单点修订并重新运行。

Details

Motivation: 内容审核、广告合规和资格判定往往涉及多条件、豁免及信息缺失；若只返回最终标签，难以知道哪项条件判断错，也无法针对性修复。

Result: 树结构按实际裁判的回答编译。审核员可修正单节点并重跑；修订节点成为裁判训练标签；工具型 LLM 编辑器可依据执行结果调整问题和子树。在 ShARC 全部 8,276 个测试样例上，托管裁判执行决策树准确率 67.70%，平均每例问 2.99 个问题，与直接要求同一裁判输出标签的 68.23% 接近。为另一裁判编译的旧树改由该裁判执行时准确率仅 47.87%；基于该裁判对 12 个初始问题的回答重新编译，得分 64.39%。节点修复使 BANKING77 准确率从 82.04% 升到 86.16%；中国电商审核加入豁免节点后误报从 24 降至 5；训练编辑器使开发集准确率从 64.47% 升至 73.35%。

Insight: 决策树的可执行路径提供可解释审计轨迹，也允许错误在节点级修补；树结构还依赖实际语义裁判，因此跨裁判复用会明显退化。例子覆盖问答、意图分类和审核规则，编辑与复核成本以及未见规则的表现仍需考察。

Abstract: Rule decisions such as content moderation, advertising compliance, and eligibility checks combine several conditions, exemptions, and missing-information cases, and an error can be fixed only once the failing condition is known. We introduce SemTree, a framework that represents a rule decision as a semantic decision tree: each node is a natural-language question with explicit Yes/No/Unknown criteria, a pluggable semantic judge answers it, and the branching structure is compiled on the answers that this judge actually gives. The executed path is the reasoning behind every decision, so errors are repaired where they occur: a reviewer corrects a single node and replays the rule, corrected nodes become training labels for the judge, and a tool-using LLM editor revises questions and subtrees while observing execution results. On all 8,276 ShARC test cases, a tree executed by a hosted judge reaches 67.70% accuracy with 2.99 questions per case, on par with asking the same judge for the final label (68.23%); an earlier tree compiled for a different judge scores 47.87% when executed by this judge, while a new tree compiled on this judge’s answers to a 12-question initial pool already scores 64.39%. Node-level repair raises BANKING77 accuracy from 82.04% to 86.16%, an explicit exemption node cuts the false positives of a Chinese e-commerce moderation clause from 24 to 5, and a trained editor raises the development accuracy of edited trees from 64.47% to 73.35%.

[368] GameSmith: Scaling Zero-Sum Self-Play with Synthesised Games cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Weixian Waylon Li, Jiaxin Zhang, Han Zhou, Chengzu Li, Ke Wang

TL;DR: GameSmith 用模板约束自动合成并验证零和博弈，再通过自博弈蒸馏与 CRAB 优势估计扩展可训练的博弈族，以提升语言模型推理。

Details

Motivation: 基于两人零和游戏的可验证奖励已显示可迁移到一般推理，但既有训练依赖少量手写游戏，游戏供给及针对这些游戏设计的优势估计器限制了扩展。

Result: LLM 在奖励、观测和隐藏信息代码固定的模板内合成游戏；通过配对随机种子回放及独立重新实现规格验证，再扩展为编码、规则和规模变体。三种 SPIRAL 模板得到 29 个游戏家族中的 26 个新游戏、336 个验证变体。Qwen3-32B 教师自博弈蒸馏后，用适用于各变体的 CRAB 进行自博弈强化学习；CRAB 按决策相对其局面预期回报的收缩估计分配信用。Qwen3-4B-Base 的 13 基准平均 pass@1 从 45.5 提至蒸馏后 62.5，再经自博弈达到 64.9；在相同预算下高于仅用三种 SPIRAL 游戏。模型间趋势一致，迁移收益随游戏家族数量增加。

Insight: 可验证的程序化游戏生成扩充了训练任务，同时双重验证降低游戏实现错误；对所有变体定义的优势估计也支持更大语料自博弈。推理提升和家族数的关系来自特定游戏模板及基准，摘要未报告验证成本或游戏多样性边界。

Abstract: Post-training large language models (LLMs) on two-player zero-sum games provides a verifiable reward, and the gains have been shown to transfer to general reasoning. Existing pipelines, however, rely on a handful of hand-written games and on advantage estimators tied to them, so both the supply of games and the advantage estimate on a large corpus limit scaling. We present GameSmith, which scales both. An LLM synthesises games inside templates whose reward, observation, and hidden-information code is fixed. Each game is verified by seed-paired replay and by an independent re-implementation of its specification, then expanded into encoding, rule, and size variants, giving 26 new games in 29 families and 336 verified variants from the three SPIRAL templates. The model is distilled from the self-play of a larger teacher (Qwen3-32B) on these games and then trained by self-play reinforcement learning with CRAB, an advantage estimator that credits each decision against a shrinkage estimate of the expected return of its position and is defined on every variant. On Qwen3-4B-Base, distillation raises the 13-benchmark mean pass@1 from 45.5 to 62.5, above the three SPIRAL games at the same budget, and self-play with CRAB reaches 64.9. The ordering holds across models, and transfer grows with the number of game families.

[369] Query-Adaptive Neuron Steering for LLMs cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Yanxi Pan, Jingwen Wu, Yan Ma, Xiang Chen, Xinyi Zeng

TL;DR: Q-NeuS 根据输入问题动态选择并调节 LLM 内部神经元，使用 Neu-GRPO 比较不同干预配置的相对表现来训练轻量门控器，基座模型保持冻结。

Details

Motivation: 提示工程和固定内部 steering 都难以适应每个查询不同的知识与推理需求；先导研究发现神经元激活模式随主题和层变化，放大主题相关神经元可能改善表现。

Result: Q-NeuS 建立紧凑的主题引导候选神经元空间，并用 Query-Adaptive Gate 为每个输入生成逐神经元调制系数。Neu-GRPO 以多种干预配置的相对表现训练门控器；基座 LLM 在训练和推理阶段均冻结，推理无需任务或主题标签。作者在多个 LLM 和基准上报告性能持续改善、跨模型规模适用和跨基准迁移。摘要未列模型、基准、具体收益或干预额外时延。

Insight: 由查询激活决定干预位置和强度，较固定 steering 更有机会适配不同主题；冻结基座可降低模型更新成本。结论在摘要中主要定性，候选神经元构造的稳定性、门控开销和跨提示鲁棒性尚不清楚。

Abstract: Effectively eliciting the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) at inference time remains an important challenge. Existing studies address this challenge through context engineering, which shapes user queries, or fixed steering, which directly intervenes in model computation. However, predefined contexts and fixed intervention strategies may not adequately accommodate the diverse knowledge and reasoning requirements of individual queries. This raises a natural question: Can internal steering in LLMs be made query-adaptive? In this work, we investigate whether query-induced internal activations can guide adaptive steering in LLMs. Our pilot studies reveal subject- and layer-dependent neuron activation patterns and show that amplifying subject-relevant neurons can improve model performance. Based on these findings, we propose Q-NeuS, a query-adaptive neuron steering framework that dynamically determines which neurons to modulate and by how much for each input. Specifically, Q-NeuS constructs a compact subject-guided candidate neuron space and employs a lightweight Query-Adaptive Gate to generate neuron-wise modulation coefficients. To learn effective intervention strategies, we introduce Neu-GRPO, which adapts group-relative optimization to train the Query-Adaptive Gate using the relative performance of multiple neuron intervention configurations. The base LLM remains frozen throughout training and inference, and no task or subject labels are required at inference time. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that Q-NeuS consistently improves model performance and exhibits broad applicability across model scales and strong cross-benchmark transferability.

[370] Reward-Aligned Distillation cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Yilan Chen, Zian Su, Manish Prajapat, Dingmin Wang, Rein Houthooft

TL;DR: RAD 通过可微分的临时优化步骤估计教师每个 token 蒸馏信号对学生后续奖励的影响，再动态加强、抑制或反转相应梯度贡献。

Details

Motivation: 可验证奖励强化学习成本高且样本利用率有限；在线策略蒸馏能提供密集 token 监督，但常规方法无差别蒸馏所有 token，基于不确定性或师生分歧的筛选也未必能识别真正提高奖励的监督。

Result: Reward-Aligned Distillation 是双层框架：对学生执行临时优化步骤，估计每个 token 监督对更新后奖励的预测作用，并从初始权重出发做投影上升更新 token 权重。在匹配训练回答预算下，六个竞赛数学基准平均准确率相较最强基线，Qwen3-1.7B 非思考版提高 6.5 个百分点，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 提高 2.5 个百分点；简化版 RAD-Simple 达到相近数学准确率。LiveCodeBench-v6 上，Qwen3-1.7B、OLMo3-7B-Instruct 的 pass@1 分别为 54.69%、58.67%，高于最强基线 8.7、6.4 个百分点。

Insight: 令蒸馏权重直接对齐学生更新后的任务奖励，可以选择性使用教师轨迹，而非把所有 token 都当成同等有益监督。双层元优化可能带来额外训练计算，摘要只匹配训练回答预算，并未说明完整算力或优化开销。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but remains computationally expensive and sample inefficient. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, yet standard OPD distills every token regardless of whether the teacher’s preference actually improves task reward. Existing token-selection methods rely on proxies such as uncertainty or teacher–student divergence, which need not identify reward-improving supervision. We introduce Reward-Aligned Distillation (RAD), a bilevel framework that weights distillation signals based on their predicted effect on the student’s post-update reward. RAD differentiates through a temporary optimizer step to score each token’s supervision, then updates the token weights by projected ascent from the initial token weights. The resulting weights can strengthen, suppress, or reverse individual distillation-gradient contributions. At a matched training-response budget, RAD improves mean accuracy on six competition-math benchmarks over the strongest baselines by 6.5 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and 2.5 points for Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. RAD-Simple, a simplified variant, achieves comparable math accuracy at the same training-response budget. On LiveCodeBench-v6, RAD reaches 54.69% and 58.67% pass@1 with Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and OLMo3-7B-Instruct, respectively, exceeding the strongest baselines by 8.7 and 6.4 points. These results support reward-guided weighting of teacher supervision across model families and tasks.

Abstract: We present HiPAD, a single fusion network submitted to all six sub-tracks of the MPDD-AVG 2026 depression-detection challenge, covering the Elder and Young cohorts and three modality sets (gait, audio-visual, and both), each combined with personality descriptions. The network encodes each available modality with a shared BiLSTM, zero-pads absent modalities, and applies cross-modal attention only when at least two of gait, audio and video are present. Personality, which dominates our results, is kept out of the attention and fused by concatenation. Because the architecture is identical in every sub-track, differences between them reflect the data rather than the model, and we use this to study three questions. Our main finding is that the personality description, roughly 150 tokens about who the subject is, carries more depression signal than audio, video, and gait combined: gait plus personality alone (TLS 0.647) beats every configuration that includes audio and video. First, a four-level ablation of the personality description (L0-L3) quantifies this: removing every personality-derived feature, including the Big Five scores that earlier MPDD ablations keep, lowers the Track-Level Score by 0.499 to 0.507 and leaves the model at chance. Second, domain-adapting the personality encoder with LoRA (7B) or QLoRA (72B) on PHQ-8/9 data raises binary Cohen’s $κ$ by 0.13 but lowers the overall score by distorting the PHQ-9 regression; a frozen RoBERTa-large encoder does better at this sample size. Third, at fixed architecture, handcrafted clinical features (eGeMAPS, OpenFace action units) outperform generic deep features (wav2vec2, DenseNet) on the audio-visual tracks. Abstract: A central desideratum in model editing is generalization to complex tasks, which prior work formalizes under a direct generalization paradigm: treating and evaluating LLM behavior as an input-output mapping and expecting a factual update to alter outputs on reasoning tasks. Yet despite substantial empirical effort, the field consensus remains that such generalization is highly challenging and elusive. However, when we deploy the latest models in an in-the-wild chatbot-user setting, we surprisingly find that even classical editing methods exhibit remarkably fluent generalization behavior. This motivates us to revisit the obstacles to generalization and the limitations of the prevailing paradigm. We find that direct generalization is fundamentally constrained both theoretically and practically: theoretically, it suffers from an identifiability issue; and practically, existing approaches attempting to circumvent this are further hindered by the ambiguity of their constructed biases and by vulnerability to being overridden by other factors such as optimization dynamics. We instead identify compositional generalization, empowered by the increasingly strong reasoning and composition abilities of modern LLMs, as a theoretically grounded and empirically validated alternative. We validate this phenomenon across multiple models and editing methods, showing that such generalization behavior is widespread. Overall, we argue that generalizable model editing could be more than direct generalization, and call for a paradigm shift toward more generalizable and practically deployable knowledge update techniques.

Insight: 该工作聚焦训练基础设施，设计目标是将异步执行、权重同步和教师扩展作为统一 agent-native 系统处理。实验覆盖四次完整运行但未披露具体训练任务增益、硬件利用率和相较同步框架的成本，因此效率优势目前在摘要中为定性结论。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a critical phase in the post-training pipeline of large language models (LLMs). As the frontier of LLM capabilities shifts from static reasoning to agentic tasks–characterized by external tool invocation, multi-turn interactions, and long-horizon decision-making–existing mainstream RL frameworks have grown increasingly unwieldy, raising the overhead of adoption, usage, and debugging. To address these challenges, we present LoongSage, an agent-native, fully asynchronous RL framework with a lightweight core of roughly 14K lines of code. Built upon Megatron for distributed training and SGLang for high-throughput inference, LoongSage centralizes orchestration within a single controller process and encapsulates all GPU-resident components as Ray actors. It introduces AgentFlow, a unified execution paradigm that orchestrates both white-box and black-box agents. For asynchronous execution, it integrates sliding-window strategies that bound trajectory staleness, and employs TransferMesh, a topology-aware synchronization mechanism that routes weights after each step over the fastest transport available to each receiver. Beyond agentic RL, LoongSage incorporates a memory-efficient Teacher Manager that decouples the scaling of teacher models from GPU memory constraints, natively supporting Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Extensive evaluations across four complete training runs, spanning complex reinforcement learning and multi-teacher distillation, demonstrate that task rewards improve steadily while the train-inference gap is kept under continuous control, and the fully asynchronous pipeline removes synchronous idle bubbles, sustaining hardware utilization.

Abstract: Language models have recently solved open Erdős problems and achieved gold-medal level performance on International Mathematical Olympiad problems. But their solutions, written in natural language, cannot yet be verified by proof assistants. An erroneous reasoning step can invalidate every step that comes after, so it is advantageous to detect errors early. Several methods have been proposed to detect erroneous reasoning quickly based on the features of the forward pass of the language model that performs reasoning. In this work, we study whether the directed Forman curvature of that model’s attention graph, a local quantity computed at an edge from the attention weights around it, carries information about a step’s correctness. Appending curvature values improves the overall mean performance of all four verifiers. ReProbe, the verifier that takes every token of a step as input, shows the largest improvement. Abstract: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for language-model reasoning. While \emph{value evolution along trajectory} characterizes relative token-level credit, yet standard critics often fail to track it under sparse terminal rewards. To model this evolution, we analyze the relation between successive prefix values and show that they admit a Bayesian decomposition with additive updates in log-odds space. We use this additive structure to construct Tracking-Value PPO (\method), a cumulative value parameterization that sums position-wise scalar outputs into value logits. These outputs are learned through terminal-outcome supervision on the reconstructed values. \method improves aggregate mathematical reasoning scores over PPO by 7.0 and 8.4 points on Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, respectively, while improving out-of-distribution generalization. Gains extend to Qwen3-4B, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen3.5-9B and to countdown, and scientific coding tasks. Abstract: Reliable agentic tool use requires training data that pair diverse multi-step workflows with executable evidence that the requested outcomes were achieved. Two complementary pipelines populate this substrate: Execution-Grounded Task Synthesis (EGTS) derives verified demonstrations from independently authored systems, and Executable Environment Synthesis (EES) synthesizes auditable environments, state-grounded tasks, and executable verifiers across single and coordinated domains. These pipelines yield 30,395 verified trajectories spanning 2,260 invoked tool names. We first train on these demonstrations with supervised fine-tuning, then reuse EES states and verifiers to compare alternative actions and construct outcome-grounded preferences for Direct Preference Optimization. Davinci-Tool improves Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct from 52.4 to 88.2 on $τ^2$-bench, from 30.4 to 62.8 on BFCL v4 multi-turn, and from 16.9 to 56.2 on MCP-Atlas, outperforming Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct on all three benchmarks with only 1/16 of its total parameters. Motivation: 智能体失败可能来自知识缺失，也可能来自决策时未能使用已有信息；若不区分“知道什么”和“如何选择行动”，就难以解释失败及设计干预。

Abstract: Language model (LM) agents can fail for different reasons, requiring different explanations and interventions. We estimate task-relevant beliefs using report-based and representation-based probes, and action values using inverse reinforcement learning. We find that task-relevant state and value information is often represented more reliably than it is reflected in behaviour. Tracking action preferences throughout reasoning further shows that decisions sharpen around a commitment point and reported belief uncertainty decreases near commitment, although individual belief changes do not consistently explain shifts in action preference. Finally, forced actions follow reasoning prefixes from other decisions when transplanted, whereas the tested reasoning-window activation edits provide limited control over the action. Together, these results suggest that some failures arise not from missing task-relevant information, but from how available information is translated into action. Our measurements distinguish information availability from belief-action consistency without by themselves identifying the cause of each failure. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/belief-action-gap-F745/

Stage 1 combines selective distillation from a frozen teacher with GRPO; a plateau detector then removes the teacher, and Stage 2 continues with GRPO alone. Calibrated on one model-domain pair and reused unchanged in three others, the plateau detector fires between steps 122 and 171. RELAY scores highest in-domain among the compared methods in all four settings, ahead of GRPO on RaR-Medicine by 4.62 points with Qwen3-1.7B and 6.02 with Qwen3-4B. On Qwen3-1.7B/Medicine, removing the teacher from a shared checkpoint outperforms keeping, weakening or refreshing it. Distilling selected rollouts covering about half the response tokens also outperforms distilling all rollouts at a matched average coefficient.

[379] DeltaTTG: Training Multi-Turn Agents with a Token-to-Go Progress Meter cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Xuyan Ye, Xiyan Fu, Shengda Fan, Jiawei Cui, Yankai Lin

TL;DR: DeltaTTG 用共享进度计预测每个步骤到任务完成还需生成的 token 数，并据此重分配终局奖励优势，训练多轮智能体时不改动原始奖励。

Details

Motivation: 可验证奖励的多轮智能体 RL 通常只有稀疏终局奖励，难判断单步贡献；组内步骤比较依赖准确状态匹配和多样结果，直接评分又需外部评估器、人工标注或任务定制启发式。

Result: 进度计从多策略记录轨迹获得低成本监督，目标 Token-to-Go 是到任务完成仍需生成的 token 数，作为剩余完成工作量代理。actor 训练时冻结进度计，根据其估计变化将基于结果的优势在步骤间重新分配，但不改奖励，保留轨迹优势符号和 token 平均尺度。在 ALFWorld、PaperSearchQA、BFCLv3 上，Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的平均分分别比 GRPO 高 5.7、7.2 点，整体超过所比较 RL 基线；actor 训练 GPU 小时接近 GRPO。作者还报告样本效率、域外表现改善，进度计可跨 actor 规模区分步骤质量并指导测试时动作选择。

Insight: 用可观测的剩余生成 token 数做代理进度信号，可在不改原奖励的情况下给长轨迹步骤更细信用分配。TTG 与真实工作量并非必然一致；摘要未提供进度预测误差、不同任务的 token 长度偏差及额外推理成本。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for multi-turn agents relies on sparse terminal rewards that say little about individual steps. Within-group step comparisons depend on reliable state matching and sufficiently diverse sampled outcomes, while direct step scoring may require costly external evaluators, human annotations, or task-specific heuristics. We introduce DeltaTTG to learn a reusable progress signal through a shared progress meter, using low-cost supervision from diverse policies’ recorded trajectories without task-specific progress rules. Its supervision target, Token-to-Go (TTG), the number of tokens remaining to be generated until task completion, serves as an observable proxy for remaining completion effort. During actor training, changes in the frozen meter’s estimates redistribute outcome-derived advantages across steps without altering the reward, preserving each trajectory’s advantage sign and token-average scale. On ALFWorld, PaperSearchQA, and BFCLv3, DeltaTTG improves the average score over GRPO by 5.7 and 7.2 points with Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, respectively, outperforms all compared RL baselines on average, and keeps actor-training GPU-hours close to GRPO. Further experiments show improved sample efficiency and out-of-domain performance, and support the meter’s ability to distinguish step quality and guide test-time action selection across actor sizes. The code is available at https://github.com/Xuyan923r/DeltaTTG.

[380] Checking the Checkers: A Synthesis of Verifier Noise and Robustness in RLVR cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Savyasachi Gupta, Aniruddha Srinivas Joshi

TL;DR: 该综述汇总 58 项研究中的 RLVR 验证器错误、训练影响与缓解方法，指出错误类型及策略能否利用错误，比单看验证器错误率更关键。

Details

Motivation: 可验证奖励强化学习依赖检查器判断回答正确，但规则检查器可能因格式错误拒绝正确答案，单元测试可能接受错误代码，LLM 裁判也可能被空或对抗回答诱导。

Result: 综述比较四类问题：验证器会犯什么错、如何影响训练、何种缓解对哪些错有效，以及发现是否适用于自生成、量规/裁判或无验证器奖励。证据显示，随机错误主要减慢学习，但在固定预算或 KL 正则下也会降低最终准确率；策略可学会触发的假阳性则可能导致平台或崩溃，即便初始错误率低。错误方向与被检查内容和构建者有关，不由验证器家族单独决定；策略变强时错误分布也会改变，现有缓解多只对一种错误测试。作者整理比较表、调和文献冲突并提出报告协议。

Insight: 验证器错误率本身不足以预测训练影响，关键在于错误是否可被策略系统性利用及错误结构。综述的结论受纳入研究的任务和验证器设计影响；其建议是更充分报告错误机制与训练动态，而非认为某种验证器天然可靠。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a principal recipe for improving the reasoning of large language models (LLMs). It rests on the assumption that the checker scoring each response is itself correct. In practice, rule-based checkers reject correct answers in unexpected formats, unit tests accept incorrect programs, and LLM judges can be led to approve empty or adversarial responses. This work surveys 58 studies that measure, analyze, or mitigate such verifier errors. We ask what errors verifiers make, how they affect training, which mitigations work against which errors, and how the findings extend to self-generated, rubric- and judge-based, and verifier-free rewards. The evidence suggests that the structure of an error matters more than its rate. Random errors mostly slow learning, though under a fixed budget or KL regularization they also lower final accuracy. False positives that the policy can learn to trigger can cause plateaus or collapse, sometimes even with a low initial error rate. Whether a verifier wrongly rejects or accepts depends on what it checks and who built it, not on its family. Its errors shift as the policy improves, and most mitigations have been tested against only one kind of error. We compile the findings into comparison tables, reconcile apparent conflicts in the literature, and propose a reporting protocol to make future results comparable.

[381] HaloBlock: Faster and Better Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Zhaohui Zheng, Chenhang He, Jinrui Zhang, Ming-Ming Cheng, Lei Zhang

TL;DR: HaloBlock 根据双向累积熵估计扩散语言模型每块解码难度，再自适应分配块边界两侧的 halo 上下文，以缓解块间信息断裂并提升质量与收敛速度。

Details

Motivation: 扩散语言模型支持双向注意和任意顺序解码，但块内解码难度主要集中在块右侧 token，且块式生成会产生边界上下文不连续。

Result: HaloBlock 用双向累积熵估计区块难度，并据此为两侧动态分配 halo 区域，平滑跨块上下文传播、降低难 token 解码难度。作者在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct、Dream-7B-Instruct、LLaDA-1.5 上的数学推理和代码生成基准中，报告准确率一致提升且推理效率更高。摘要未列出具体准确率、速度或 halo 大小。

Insight: 不同区块需要的上下文范围和计算难度不一致，固定边界处理可能导致信息断裂；不确定性指导的 halo 分配让资源集中于困难 token。摘要未说明额外上下文计算开销及自适应区域对生成长度的影响。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have attracted increasing research attention due to their bidirectional attention and arbitrary order decoding. However, there are two issues in dLLMs inference: the decoding difficulty is dominated by the tokens on the right side of the block, and the block-wise decoding inherently suffers from boundary contextual discontinuity. To tackle these limitations, we propose HaloBlock, a difficulty-aware adaptive halo mechanism for dLLM inference. We first leverage bidirectional cumulative entropy to characterize block decoding difficulty. Then, based on the bidirectional decoding difficulty, we adaptively allocate bidirectional halo regions on both sides of each block to mitigate boundary contextual discontinuity. The difficulty-aware design of HaloBlock smooths cross-block context propagation and lowers decoding difficulty for hard tokens, yielding better generation quality and faster convergence. Evaluated on LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Dream-7B-Instruct and LLaDA-1.5 across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, HaloBlock demonstrates consistent accuracy improvements and higher inference efficiency. Source codes are publicly available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HaloBlock.

[382] Match the Canvas, Not Just the Answer: Predictability-Aware SFT for Diffusion Language Models cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Miao Li, Hanyang Jiang, Hengyu Fu, Baihe Huang, Yating Liu

TL;DR: PACS 根据扩散语言模型自身可预测性选择训练时可见上下文长度，并在参考 token 即将按置信度揭示前监督，以缓解随机遮盖与推理解码的不匹配。

Details

Motivation: 扩散语言模型按可预测性而非固定从左到右顺序生成，因此 SFT 需要决定哪些参考 token 已可见、给多少生成空间；独立于推理过程的随机遮盖可能误导监督。

Result: 作者分析发现随机遮盖可能隐藏模型预测错误或惩罚解码本会解决的不确定性；注意力可见输入长度也会改变模型偏好的回答表达，即使解法相同。PACS 用模型自身可预测性为每个样本选定可见长度，并在参考 token 由置信度引导揭示前监督。在推理和代码生成基准上，PACS 平均准确率高于所比较 SFT 方法，单项基准相较 vanilla SFT 最高提高 12.84 个百分点。摘要未列基准、模型和各项具体结果。

Insight: 对齐训练时的可见上下文与推理时 token 揭示顺序，比随机遮盖更符合扩散语言模型的生成机制。最高单项提升不能代表所有任务增益；摘要未报告训练代价和不同解码顺序下的稳定性。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable flexible parallel generation by resolving tokens according to the model’s evolving predictability rather than a fixed left-to-right order. This flexibility, however, introduces training choices absent from standard autoregressive teacher forcing: which reference tokens are visible when a target is supervised and how much generation space is allocated. Standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) typically makes these choices through random masking, independently of inference. Our analysis shows how this training-inference mismatch can misdirect supervision. Random masking can conceal prediction errors or penalize uncertainty that decoding would otherwise resolve, while the attention-visible input length can change which response formulations the model favors, even when the underlying solution is unchanged. Motivated by these findings, we propose Predictability-Aware Canvas Selection and Supervision (PACS), an SFT method. PACS uses the model’s own predictability to select each example’s attention-visible input length and supervises reference tokens immediately before their confidence-guided revelation. Across reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, PACS consistently achieves the highest mean accuracy among the compared SFT methods, with gains of up to 12.84 percentage points over vanilla SFT on individual benchmarks. Code will be released upon publication.

[383] inLoRA-MINT: Internal Representations for Auditing Training Data in Domain-adapted LLMs cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Gonzalo Mancera, Julian Fierrez, Aythami Morales, Ruben Tolosana, Daniel DeAlcala

TL;DR: inLoRA-MINT 利用 LoRA 微调模型的中间激活及参数相关信号进行成员推断，判断特定样本是否参与训练，不必依赖完整模型参数访问。

Details

Motivation: 成员推断测试可用于审计训练数据是否泄漏隐私；既有 LoRA-MINT 仅在严格黑盒下依赖困惑度，新方法探索内部表示是否能提供更强审计信号。

Result: 方法将激活和参数依赖信号输入 MINT 分类器，以区分训练样本与非训练样本。作者在四个 LLM（Qwen、Phi-4、DeepSeek-V3、LLaMA 3.2-3B）上测试三个覆盖医疗、数学和学术推理的数据集。报告的检测分数在不同架构和领域间为 95%–98%，并对模型配置和数据分布变化具有鲁棒性。摘要未说明分数具体指标、攻击假设或隐私成员推断的误报率。

Insight: 比单一困惑度更丰富的内部表示可能让数据来源审计不依赖完整参数访问；结果跨模型与任务域较一致。95%–98% 的分数需结合阈值、训练/测试相似度和误报设置解读，摘要未提供这些细节，不能等同于正式隐私泄漏风险量化。

Abstract: This work investigates the application of the Membership Inference Test (MINT) to large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA, aiming to determine whether specific samples were used during training and address concerns about data privacy, leakage, and transparency. Building on our previous LoRA-MINT framework, which relies exclusively on perplexity under a strict black-box setting, we propose an approach based on intermediate model representations, including activations and parameter-dependent signals. These representations enable a MINT classifier to distinguish training from non-training samples without requiring full access to model parameters. We evaluated the method on four LLMs (Qwen, Phi-4, DeepSeek-V3, and LLaMA 3.2-3B) fine-tuned on three datasets covering medical, mathematical, and academic reasoning tasks. Results show consistent performance across architectures and domains, achieving scores between 95% and 98%, with robustness to variations in model configurations and data distributions. The proposed approach enables efficient auditing of sensitive training data and supports data provenance and compliance with emerging privacy and AI governance regulations. Although our experiments focus on LoRA-based fine-tuning, the methodology can be extended to other LLM adaptation techniques and, more broadly, to other AI models.

[384] LoOPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Looped Teachers cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Wei Fan, Qingyue Yang, Chao-Hong Tan, Qian Chen, Wen Wang

TL;DR: LoOPSD 搜索同一语言模型的层执行顺序与重复层，构造更强的循环教师，再用其对学生自身前缀的预测交替蒸馏，利用额外推理计算生成自监督信号。

Details

Motivation: on-policy 自蒸馏需要比学生更有用的教师预测，既有方法常通过额外上下文或指令强化教师；研究探索能否仅改变同一模型的层执行方式获得更强教师。

Result: LoOPSD 保持权重不变，搜索应重复执行哪些层，使用循环教师在学生采样前缀上的预测指导学习；每轮蒸馏后根据更新学生重新构造教师并继续搜索。在数学和逻辑推理任务上，作者报告多个模型均改善。GSM8K、400 token 思考预算下，Qwen3-1.7B 准确率从 42.30% 升至 79.61%，后续蒸馏轮次还能在首轮基础上继续提升。摘要未提供其他任务数值和搜索开销。

Insight: 模型自身不同层执行路径可产生额外计算和更强自教师信号，不需外部大模型或改动权重结构。GSM8K 提升很大，但摘要未说明是否与相同额外推理预算的其他方法对照，也未报告层序搜索成本。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation improves a model using guidance from the model itself, but it still requires a teacher that provides more useful predictions than the student. Existing approaches obtain such guidance by giving the teacher additional context or instructions. We ask whether it can instead come from changing how the same model uses its own layers. To address this, we introduce LoOPSD, which searches over a model’s layer execution order to construct a stronger teacher and distills its advantage into the student. Specifically, we keep the model weights unchanged while searching for layers to repeat, and use the resulting teacher’s predictions on student-generated prefixes to guide learning. We then alternate search and distillation, rebuilding the teacher from the updated student in each round so that the student progressively absorbs the gains from alternative layer execution. Experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning tasks show improvements across models. On GSM8K with a 400-token thinking budget, LoOPSD raises Qwen3-1.7B accuracy from 42.30% to 79.61%; subsequent distillation rounds yield further gains beyond the first round. Together, these findings show that by searching layer execution to construct teachers, we can turn a model’s additional computation into improved student capabilities, opening a new avenue for self-distillation to derive supervision from the model’s own computation.

[385] Teacher-Guided Tool Learning for Small Language Models via Bidirectional KL Constraints cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Haoxuan Gao, Qin-Wen Luo, Xiang Chen, Yu Tian, Zequn Sun

TL;DR: SeTPO 结合低奖励轨迹上的反向 KL 教师 token 反馈与持续正向 KL 示范监督，帮助小语言模型学习工具使用并缓解师生行为分布不匹配。

Details

Motivation: 小模型仅靠强化学习难以探索有效工具行为；直接模仿教师又可能因师生分布差异传播教师偏好错误。

Result: SeTPO 将教师反向 KL 推导的逐 token 反馈加入低奖励轨迹的策略优势，同时通过辅助正向 KL 在训练过程中持续保留教师示范行为。作者在 BFCL v4 和 API Bank 上比较监督微调、强化学习及蒸馏基线，并报告该方法在三种学生规模上整体表现优越。理想化双向 KL 目标的理论分析表明，最优策略期望奖励不低于教师，同时保留一定比例的教师概率质量。摘要未给学生规模、具体成绩或概率保留比例。

Insight: 用不同方向的 KL 项分别鼓励探索改进和保留可用示范，是应对小模型工具探索不足与纯模仿偏差的折中。理论保证依赖理想化目标；摘要未量化教师错误传播是否实证减少及额外训练成本。

Abstract: External tools can extend the capabilities of small language models (SLMs), enabling their deployment in resource constrained environments. However, their limited capabilities make it difficult for SLMs to discover effective tool use behaviors through reinforcement learning alone, while direct teacher supervision suffers from teacher student behavioral distribution mismatch and may propagate erroneous preferences. To address these challenges, we propose Selective Teacher guided Policy Optimization (SeTPO), which coordinates student exploration with selective teacher guidance and persistent demonstration supervision. Specifically, SeTPO incorporates reverse KL derived token level teacher feedback into policy advantages on low reward trajectories, while auxiliary forward KL supervision preserves teacher demonstrated behaviors throughout training. Under an idealized bidirectional KL objective, we theoretically establish that the optimal policy achieves expected reward no lower than the teacher’s while retaining a guaranteed fraction of the teacher’s probability mass. Extensive experiments on BFCL v4 and API Bank demonstrate that SeTPO achieves superior overall performance over supervised fine tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation baselines across all three student scales.

[386] Bayesian Test-Time Inference of Task-Aligned Similarity from Weak Interactive Feedback cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Weida Liang, Kenji Kawaguchi

TL;DR: BASIS 用贝叶斯后验从弱交互反馈中推断当前决策应采用哪种相似性标准，并联合更新候选目标与标准选择，而非固定相似度或静态混合权重。

Details

Motivation: 检索、排序和回答修订都依赖相似性判断，但词面、语义、结构和风格相似性可能导向不同候选，任务对“相关”的定义还可能随实例改变。

Result: 训练免除的 BASIS 在给定任务专用标准库中维护候选目标与标准的联合后验，可根据标量分数、成对偏好或验证器输出更新，并按期望信息增益选择探测。在有限噪声模型中分析目标—标准可识别条件，并说明标准切换时固定标准或固定混合会失败。概念恢复、推理示例选择和回答修订任务中，6 次探测后 Success@1 从调优静态混合的 56.0% 提至 68.1%；推理准确率 72.3%→73.1%，修订胜率 61.4%→63.8%。它还超过同算力 best-of-N 在推理（72.1%）和修订（61.2%）的结果。收益在标准不匹配和候选池较大时最大。方法只在给定标准库中选择，不会发现新标准。

Insight: 自适应确定“按什么标准相似”可比固定融合处理实例间标准切换，主动探测也能更快收敛；候选目标和标准联合推断比仅调权重进一步有益。其能力受预先提供的标准库限制，无法自动发现新的相关性维度。

Abstract: Language model systems repeatedly make test-time decisions by comparing similarity: they retrieve exemplars, rank candidates, and revise responses. Yet similarity is not unique: lexical, semantic, structural, and stylistic resemblance can point to different candidates, and the task-aligned notion can change across instances. We introduce BASIS (Bayesian Axis Selection via Interactive Signals), a training-free Bayesian method that uses weak test-time feedback to infer which criterion in a supplied, task-specific library governs the current decision. It maintains a joint posterior over candidate targets and criteria, updates it from scalar scores, pairwise preferences, or verifier outputs, and selects probes by expected information gain. In a finite noisy model, we characterize when the target-criterion pair is recoverable and show why fixed-criterion and fixed-mixture rules can fail under criterion shift. Across concept recovery, reasoning exemplar selection, and response refinement, BASIS improves six-probe concept-recovery Success@1 from 56.0% to 68.1%, reasoning accuracy from 72.3% to 73.1%, and refinement win rate from 61.4% to 63.8% over tuned static mixtures. It also exceeds compute-matched best-of-N selection on reasoning (72.1%) and refinement (61.2%). Gains are largest under criterion mismatch and with larger candidate pools, and matched controls indicate that adaptive criterion weighting explains much of the benefit, with joint target-criterion inference adding further value. BASIS selects only among supplied criteria and does not discover new ones.

[387] Does self-distillation improve reasoning? cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Jason Ken Adhinarta, Raina Wu, Ashutosh Sharma, Avinash Balakrishnan, Rameswar Panda

TL;DR: 该研究重新评估 SDPO 与 OPSD 等自蒸馏方法，发现其能力提升未能稳定泛化到未见问题，收益多可由过拟合或已有推理行为迁移解释。

Details

Motivation: 自蒸馏可利用正确答案或环境反馈等特权信息，有研究报告其样本效率和泛化优于强化学习；但这些收益是否超出域内评测、是否确由特权信息带来仍不明确。

Result: 作者在代码、科学、工具使用和数学推理上重测 Self-Distillation Policy Optimization、On-Policy Self-Distillation。结果显示已报告增益并不稳定迁移到未见问题，更多可由过拟合或已有推理行为转移解释，而非有效利用特权信息。自蒸馏梯度与直接最大化期望奖励的策略梯度对齐较弱，质疑其是否提供有效策略改进方向。实验覆盖 Qwen3 1.7B–14B 和 OLMo-3-7B。摘要未给各任务具体数值。

Insight: 自蒸馏提升域内表现并不自动证明特权监督被有效利用；应单独测试未见问题并比较梯度方向。作者认为有效利用特权信息仍是开放问题，结论针对所评方法和模型，不能概括所有自蒸馏变体。

Abstract: Self-distillation is an emerging approach that trains a model to imitate its own predictions when conditioned on privileged information, such as correct answers or environmental feedback. Recent methods have reported better sample efficiency and generalization than reinforcement learning (RL), but it remains unclear whether these gains extend beyond in-distribution evaluations and whether they stem from privileged distillation. In this paper, we revisit two representative methods, Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), across code, science, tool use, and math reasoning tasks. We find that their reported gains do not consistently generalize to unseen problems and are largely explained by overfitting or transferring existing reasoning behavior, rather than effectively using privileged information. Moreover, self-distillation gradients show weak alignment with policy gradients that directly optimize expected reward, questioning whether they provide an effective direction for policy improvement. Our experiments across Qwen3 models (1.7B-14B) and OLMo-3-7B suggest that effectively leveraging privileged information to improve reasoning remains an open challenge. Our code is available at https://github.com/sleepypandu/does-sd-improve-reasoning

Insight: 激活解释能“指向”来源状态，不代表能在细微近似说法中可靠判真；训练时需让解释具备排除能力。实验用同模型重构器作代理监控且只测一个检查点，作者明确称这是较容易的 transcript 真值情形，内部过程主张仍未验证。

Abstract: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) are proposed as oversight tools for language models: an Activation Verbaliser (AV) writes an English explanation of an activation vector, and an Activation Reconstructor (AR) maps the explanation back to a vector. Their value for oversight depends on a human monitor being able to tell a true account of an activation from a false one, given the Av’s explanation. We formalise NLA training and NLA oversight deployment as two different referential games from Emergent Communication: training is a generative referential game, while oversight is a discriminative, multi-modal, partially-observable referential game played over a many-to-many relation between the monitored language model’s activations and the accounts that are true of them. The gap between the two games predicts that AV’s explanations will identify which activation they describe without discriminating its true account from closely matched false ones, since training never asks explanations to rule anything out. Using the NLA’s own AR as a maximally-sympathetic surrogate monitor model, we experimentally confirm this theoretical insight on one released checkpoint: true accounts beat accounts of other activations in all 320 comparisons, but beat fluent rivals differing in a single claim only 60.2% of the time (std.err. 6.7%, chance at 50%, $n = 35$). A meaning-preserving rewrite by an uninvolved model costs only 2.1% of the distance to another activation’s account, so the failure is not due to the NLA pair having developed private conventions in the AV’s explanations. Our rival accounts test only transcript-level truths, which the monitored language model’s conversation settles, so these results bound the easiest case and leave claims about the monitored model’s own processing untested. We state conjectures that would make both results consequences of the framework.

Wenlin Zhong, Hao Wang, Kun Yuan, Fan Yang, Jinluan Yang

TL;DR: SkillScaffold 用已验证训练轨迹产生候选技能并以结果感知似然比较估计其效用，不需候选专属环境 rollout；仅在预计有帮助时向当前策略注入技能。

Details

Motivation: 文本技能可把历史经验转成可复用指导，但现有 skill-RL 常假定注入必然有益，或用间接反馈和大量 rollout 评估技能；技能收益还随候选与策略对当前查询的能力而变。

Result: 框架根据 outcome-verified 轨迹生成候选技能，再进行低成本效用估计，并选择注入哪些技能；若没有候选预计有帮助，则保持无技能执行。Generator 与 Executor 联合训练，使技能生成适配不断演化的执行策略；技能支架也促使推理时无外部技能的内化。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld、τ²-Bench 上，作者报告相较强 agentic-RL 和 skill-RL 基线，在短程与长程任务均有提升；消融和分析支持效用选择及允许拒绝注入的重要性。摘要未提供具体数值。

Insight: 将技能注入作为可选择的策略决策，允许对无益技能弃权，避免“有技能就一定好”的假设；基于已验证轨迹的似然估计则省去逐候选环境 rollout。摘要未报告效用估计校准、任务级收益和系统额外开销。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from multi-turn interactions with verifiable outcomes. Textual skills can improve exploration by distilling prior interactions into reusable guidance. However, existing skill-based RL approaches often either assume skill injection is beneficial or rely on indirect feedback or rollout-intensive evaluation to assess its utility. Our pilot studies show that rollout-based utility estimation for skill credit assignment is costly and unstable under limited sampling, while skill benefits vary across candidates and depend on the current policy’s competence on each query. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillScaffold, a policy-adaptive training scaffold that combines low-cost skill-utility estimation with selective skill injection. By reusing outcome-verified training trajectories, SkillScaffold generates candidate skills and estimates their utility through outcome-aware likelihood comparisons, without candidate-specific environment rollouts. The resulting utility guides whether and which skill to inject, retaining skill-free execution when no candidate is estimated to help. Joint training enables the Generator to produce skills tailored to the evolving Executor. Scaffolded RL encourages skill internalization for skill-free inference. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld, and $τ^2$-Bench demonstrate gains over strong agentic-RL and skill-based RL baselines across both short- and long-horizon tasks. Ablations and further analyses support the importance of utility-based selection and abstention. Our code is available at https://github.com/Vaidurya00/SkillScaffold.

[390] Barycentric Anchored Weight Search for Robust Model Merging cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Antoni Buades, Jose-Luis Lisani

TL;DR: Barycentric Anchored Search 使用预训练权重与两个微调检查点构造重心候选，并在锚定权重空间做小规模免梯度搜索，以提升分布外鲁棒性且不增加推理成本。

Details

Result: 方法沿候选重心权重与预训练初始化之间的方向进行少量无导数搜索。候选用一个或多个 OOD 数据集的小型验证子集选择，再在其留出部分、其他 OOD 基准和 ImageNet 验证集评估鲁棒性—准确率权衡。CLIP ViT-B/32 实验中，作者报告在 ImageNet-A、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-Sketch 等留出 OOD 集上表现显著改善，同时保持 ImageNet 准确率具有竞争力；对未用于候选选择的 OOD 集也能迁移，并超过原微调检查点、朴素 Soup 和 Model Stock。摘要未给具体分数。

Abstract: We propose Barycentric Anchored Search, a post-hoc weight-space procedure for improving fine-tuned vision models under distribution shift without additional gradient training or increased inference cost. Given a pre-trained initialization and two checkpoints fine-tuned on a source dataset, the method constructs barycentric candidate weights and performs a small derivative-free search along directions connecting each candidate to the pre-trained model. Candidate weights are selected using a small validation subset of one or more out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets; the selected model is then evaluated on the held-out portions of those datasets, on additional OOD benchmarks, and on the ImageNet validation set to quantify the robustness-accuracy trade-off. The method is inspired by simplex-based derivative-free optimization, including Nelder-Mead and Torczon multidirectional search, but is specialized to the geometry of neural network weight merging. Unlike Model Soup, which typically benefits from many fine-tuned checkpoints, and unlike Model Stock, which applies a fixed geometric merge, our approach uses only two fine-tuned checkpoints and iteratively adapts the merge using validation feedback from OOD data. Experiments with CLIP ViT-B/32 show that the proposed search substantially improves performance on held-out OOD data, including ImageNet-A, ImageNet-R, and ImageNet-Sketch, while keeping ImageNet accuracy competitive. The resulting weights also improve transfer to OOD datasets not used during candidate selection, outperforming the original fine-tuned checkpoints, naive model soups, and Model Stock in our evaluations. These results suggest that lightweight optimization in anchored weight space provides a practical alternative to fixed weight-averaging rules, geometric merging, or single-model selection.

Yang Ba, Michelle V. Mancenido, Rong Pan

TL;DR: PLDiv 用持久景观刻画数据点邻域随连接尺度变化的拓扑结构，以单个指标衡量语义多样性并检测语义坍缩。

Details

Motivation: 不断扩大的训练集可能只是增加语义重复样本而未扩展覆盖面；词汇变化、熵或成对相似度等现有多样性指标难以反映底层分布的整体几何结构。

Result: PLDiv 从数据的几何表示构建持久景观，追踪邻近样本随连接尺度增加逐步形成的结构，并汇总成无需任务监督的标量多样性度量。作者在文本生成多样性、图像嵌入、指令数据和推理轨迹语义坍缩等任务上评估，报告与已测基线竞争，并在语义坍缩检测中与多样性标签高度对齐。摘要未给相关系数、数据集或基线数值。

Insight: 拓扑结构可补充词面差异与局部相似度，帮助识别样本集合是否覆盖多个语义群体；指标不依赖任务标签，适用于数据监控和生成模型评估。摘要未量化尺度选择、嵌入模型偏差或与具体基线差距。

Abstract: Modern data pipelines increasingly combine human-created and human-curated data with AI-generated data for model training and evaluation. As datasets grow, they often add semantically redundant samples rather than expanding semantic coverage, which deteriorates the quality of the whole dataset. Existing diversity metrics primarily summarize lexical variation, entropy, or pairwise similarity, but provide limited characterization of the shape of the underlying data distribution. In this paper, we propose PLDiv, a diversity metric derived from persistence landscapes that quantifies the structural organization of a dataset from its geometric representation. PLDiv summarizes how data neighborhoods evolve as nearby samples progressively connect, producing an interpretable scalar measure of structural diversity without requiring task-specific supervision. Whether measuring intrinsic diversity in text generations or image embeddings, or detecting semantic collapse in instruction datasets and reasoning trajectories, PLDiv performs competitively against evaluated baselines and aligns strongly with diversity labels during semantic collapse. Consequently, it effectively supports applications in synthetic data monitoring, dataset construction, data augmentation, and generative model evaluation.

Rita Cordeiro Mendes, Maria Manuel Pereira, Carlos Santiago, Catarina Barata

TL;DR: 该研究系统比较纵向癌症医疗数据中多模态 Transformer 的 token 粒度、缺失模态处理和时间编码策略，指出多模态收益会被缺失数据显著影响。

Motivation: 医疗数据常有整个模态缺失或模态内部字段缺失；纵向序列虽适合 Transformer，但 token 如何组织、缺失如何处理、时间信息如何编码都会影响预测。

Abstract: Multimodal learning offers the potential to improve predictions by integrating complementary information from heterogeneous data sources. However, multimodal datasets are frequently incomplete, raising important questions about how models should handle missing information. Although recent approaches increasingly rely on Transformer-based architectures for multimodal fusion, incomplete multimodal data introduces challenges such as missing modalities and intra-modal missingness, which motivate key architectural design choices, such as tokenization granularity. In addition, many datasets are longitudinal, with observations collected across multiple time points. The sequential nature of the Transformer architectures provides a natural framework for modeling such data, but introduces additional considerations, such as how temporal information should be represented. In this study, we systematically investigate these design choices using three different cancer datasets. We compare modality-level and feature-level tokenization and evaluate attention masking and imputation as strategies for handling missing information, both naturally occurring in the datasets and synthetically induced. We further investigate approaches for incorporating temporal information in our training process and how to model it. Experiments are conducted with unimodal and multimodal configurations, as well as different levels of missingness for binary survival classification and multiple time encoding strategies for discrete-time survival prediction. Our results show that while multimodal outperforms unimodal results, missing data heavily impacts predictions and thus effective design choices such as tokenization granularity, and intra-missing handling is essential for reliable prediction.

[393] CIViC: Evidence Gates for Audio-Conditioned Visual Prediction on Proxy Tasks cs.LG | cs.CV | cs.SD | eess.ASPDF

Mengzhe Geng, Max W. Y. Lam, Yuewen Cao, Shoukang Hu, Jing Xu

TL;DR: CIViC 提出四道检查门，将模型解释与干预、留出任务比较和终点控制连接起来，评估音频条件是否真正影响视觉预测及其影响是否有益。

Motivation: 移除音频导致视觉预测改变，并不能说明任务使用了预期音频信息；需要区分输入敏感性、任务相关收益和终点行为控制。

Result: 协议在演员隔离的人脸栅格任务、合成音频特征混合和视频隔离的 SpeakerVid 代理任务上演示。静态人脸任务中跨演员替换音频满足预注册检测规则但效应较小；单独时间终点上，四个匹配种子中恒定音频拟合优于音频训练拟合。合成混合任务中加入条件的拟合在 1,000 步时 RMSE 更高（0.1807 对 0.1707），差距随训练缩小。SpeakerVid 代理任务中，五个低层音频摘要置零、保留身份/对话/条件输入的模型，在四种留出条件和五个配对种子上全帧灰度 RMSE 更低，而对齐音频在片段漂移误差上更低。结果表明不同代理任务中输出激活、留出误差与终点控制支持不同解释。

Insight: 音频输入对输出有影响，不等于模型利用了目标音频信息或得到更好任务预测；不同终点和干预会导向不同结论。实验为代理任务，研究强调多门控诊断，不能据此推断真实说话视频生成或音视频因果耦合能力。

Abstract: Removing audio can shift a visual predictor’s output without showing whether the task uses the intended audio information. We introduce Conditional Input and Visual Interpretation Checks (CIViC), a four-gate protocol that links an interpretation to an intervention, held-out task comparison, or endpoint control. We demonstrate CIViC on actor-disjoint face-raster tests, a synthetic audio-feature mixture, and source-video-disjoint SpeakerVid proxy tasks. In the static face-raster test, cross-actor audio replacement meets the registered detection rule with a small effect; on a separate temporal endpoint, constant-audio fits score better than audio-trained fits in four matched seeds. In the synthetic mixture, the condition-augmented fit has higher 1,000-step RMSE than the audio-only fit (0.1807 vs. 0.1707), with the gap shrinking during training. In the SpeakerVid proxy, the five-feature-zero fit (five low-level audio summaries zeroed; identity, dialogue, and condition inputs retained) has lower whole-frame grayscale RMSE than aligned audio across four held-out conditions and five paired seeds, while aligned audio has lower segment-drift error. The results show that output activation, held-out error, and endpoint controls support different interpretations across these proxy tasks.

[394] SYNPRED: A Synergistic Approach to Multimodal Learning for Clinical Prediction cs.LG | cs.CVPDF

Ivana Janíčková, Yen Y. Tan, Thomas H. Helbich, Philipp Seeböck, Julieta Di Marco

TL;DR: SYNPRED 用多模态 VAE 将任务相关的单模态与跨模态信息同实例特异、任务无关变化分离，以便在模态缺失时仍利用互补预测信号。

Motivation: 对比学习主要利用模态间共享信息，可能忽略对临床任务有用但模态特异的互补线索；实际应用中某些模态在测试时也可能缺失。

Abstract: Multimodal medical data captures complementary aspects of disease. It provides a comprehensive basis for diagnosis and the identification of biological associations linked to progression or treatment response. Established contrastive learning approaches exploit shared information across modalities, but fall short in exploiting complementary, modality-specific signals relevant for a task. Here, we propose a synergistic multimodal variational autoencoder (VAE) framework that separates task-relevant unimodal and multimodal information from instance-specific variation task-irrelevant, allowing complementary signals across modalities to be leveraged for prediction. The method yields benefits even if modalities are missing at test time. We evaluate the method on a treatment response prediction task using medical imaging and RNA data. Empirical comparison with alignment-based and multimodal VAE state-of-the-art approaches demonstrates improved multimodal prediction performance, and consistent benefits for prediction from a single modality after multimodal training. The full code can be found here: https://github.com/cirmuw/SYNPRED.

[395] A Controlled Evaluation of Curvature Inspired Scalar Feature Scaling for Domain Generalization cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Sunny Gupta, Amit Sethi

TL;DR: 该研究以严格限定的正标量特征缩放实现一个曲率启发训练包，并通过 384 次受控实验检验其是否改善域泛化；结果未发现其优于 ERM 的调整后证据。

Details

Motivation: “曲率学习”可指不同计算机制，需先明确实现再评估其对域泛化的影响，避免把欧氏特征缩放误称为双曲表示或曲率优化。

Result: 作者审计的 HyperDG 实际是在训练时以学习到的正标量缩放欧氏编码器特征，推理时使用未缩放欧氏特征和普通线性分类器；不含 Lorentz/Poincaré 表示、测地线预测或 SAM 内循环。在 PACS、VLCS、Office Home、TerraIncognita 的六种条件下共完成 384 次运行，检查点只按三个源域验证集选择。完整实现相较 DomainBed ERM 的等数据集宏平均点估计低 1.61 个百分点，95% 聚类 CI 为 [-3.17,-0.04]；四个数据集点估计均偏向 ERM，但精确符号翻转检验 p=.125、Holm 校正 p=.250，不支持校正后差异。更干净的领域特定缩放对比为 -0.13 点（95% CI [-0.53,0.27]），在预先设定 ±1 点实际意义界内达到等效性检验；该结论仅限源域选择的套件宏平均。

Abstract: Domain-specific curvature is an appealing idea for domain generalization (DG), but curvature learning can denote substantially different computations. This paper evaluates one deliberately narrow implementation: the code calls it HyperDG, but it rescales Euclidean encoder features during training by learned positive scalars and uses an ordinary linear classifier on unscaled Euclidean features at inference. It does not implement a Lorentz or Poincaré representation, geodesic prediction, or a Sharpness-Aware Minimization inner loop. We audit the executed objective and evaluate six conditions on PACS, VLCS, Office Home, and TerraIncognita. The completed design contains 384 runs: six conditions, four held-out targets, and four run seeds per dataset. Checkpoints are selected using only the three source-validation environments. Inference first averages paired seed differences within each held-out target; targets, rather than 16 seed-by-target observations, are the per-dataset clusters. The full implementation’s equal-dataset macro point estimate is 1.61 percentage points below native DomainBed ERM (95% clustered CI [-3.17, -0.04]). All four dataset point estimates favor ERM, but an exact four-dataset sign-flip test gives p = .125 and Holm-adjusted p = .250; we therefore claim no adjusted evidence of a difference. The cleaner domain-specificity contrast, separate learned source scales without their variance penalty versus one shared learned source scale, is -0.13 pp (95% CI [-0.53, 0.27]). Its 90% CI lies within a revision-stage $\pm 1$ pp smallest effect of practical interest (TOST p = .003), supporting equivalence only for the source-selected suite macro, not every dataset, target, or final-step endpoint. The study thus supplies a bounded negative result for this scalar training package; it does not test or refute genuine hyperbolic representation learning.

cs.NI [Back]

[396] Semantic Edge-Cloud Communication for Real-Time Urban Traffic Digital Twins cs.NI | cs.CV | cs.DC | eess.SPPDF

Murat Arda Onsu, Arman Dogru, Poonam Lohan, Burak Kantarci, Aisha Syed

TL;DR: 该框架用边缘智能从交通视频提取与任务相关的语义信息并传给云端，重建实时交通数字孪生，以减少直接传输原始视频的通信负担。

Details

Motivation: 城市数字孪生需要摄像头持续同步高保真道路状态，用于监测、碰撞预测和交通流管理；原始视频流带来显著带宽和延迟压力。

Result: 提出语义通信边缘—云框架，由边缘侧提取任务相关交通语义而不是上传整段原始视频，以重建数字孪生所需的关键动态。实验报告传输量节省超过 99%，平均轨迹重建误差为 0.12 米。摘要未说明基准道路、相机数量、比较的原始带宽或延迟测量值。

Insight: 若传输只保留数字孪生重建所需语义，通信成本可大幅下降，同时保持轨迹精度。99% 节省与 0.12 米误差需结合具体场景和数据编码协议理解，摘要未给高峰负载、漏检事件或云端时延。

Abstract: Urban traffic systems are becoming increasingly complex, demanding real-time traffic perception, proactive collision prediction, and intelligent management to improve safety and reduce congestion. Although AI-driven traffic management has shown strong promise, its success relies on diverse, high-quality data spanning critical scenarios such as collisions, near-collisions, and traffic rule violations. Digital twins offer a powerful solution by enabling synchronized virtual replicas of physical traffic environments for real-time monitoring, collision prediction, traffic-flow optimization, and diverse realistic scenario generation. However, continuously synchronizing a high-fidelity urban traffic digital twin through edge surveillance cameras requires substantial edge-cloud communication, and transmitting raw video streams leads to severe bandwidth and latency constraints. To overcome this challenge, this paper proposes a semantic communication-based edge-cloud framework for real-time urban traffic digital twin applications. By leveraging edge intelligence to extract and transmit only task-relevant semantic traffic information instead of full video feeds, the proposed framework significantly reduces communication overhead while preserving the essential dynamics needed for accurate real-time digital twin reconstruction. Experimental results demonstrate more than 99% transmission savings and an average trajectory reconstruction error of only 0.12 m, confirming the proposed framework as an effective, scalable, and low-latency solution for AI-enabled urban traffic digital twin applications.

cs.RO [Back]

[397] SEAR: Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Xinyi Wang, Bangzheng Li, Hanyu Wang, Lin Zhang, Andrea Yaoyun Cui

TL;DR: SEAR 研究机器人智能体通过写控制代码、在线控制或自动研究微调 VLA 来自我进化，并用基准区分真实经验迁移与重复尝试、熟悉任务或额外预算带来的表面提升。

Details

Motivation: 前沿语言模型智能体可编写机器人代码、测试并把有效技能和记忆用于后续任务，但需要验证它们是否真正学习，以及知识能否迁移到新任务、模拟器和实体机器人。

Result: 框架含 code-as-policy、agent-as-policy 和 auto-research 三种模式；基准控制重复尝试、熟悉任务、特权模拟状态、更多预算及运气。对 7 个前沿 LLM、330 个模拟任务、5 个实体任务及累计四年以上智能体运行时间的研究发现：学习曲线同时依赖总时长和任务难度/模型能力，困难任务更受益于长运行，简单任务多次短尝试即可；控制代码和共享程序可跨任务/模拟器迁移，任务特定方案不行；实体机器人上 agent 设计练习与新的人类设计场景存在性能差距。不同模型偏好的进化模式不同；文本模型可追平相近多模态模型，感知有助于错误评估，但推理和工具使用可能更关键。

Insight: 该工作强调把学习与重复试验、预算和任务熟悉度分开评估，也揭示模拟器内转移不保证真实场景迁移。实体机器人仅 5 个任务，且摘要未提供具体成功率，文本与多模态模型的比较需限于所测模型和场景。

Abstract: Frontier language-model agents can now improve robots on their own: they write control code, test it, and keep what works as skills and memories for the next task. We introduce SEAR (Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics), a framework and benchmark built around two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? And does what it learns still help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot? The framework runs an agent in three modes: it writes code that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), acts live in the control loop (agent-as-policy), or works as a researcher that fine-tunes a vision-language-action model (auto-research). The benchmark adds controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, and luck. Across seven frontier language models, 330 simulated and five physical tasks, and over four years of agent runtime, we highlight three findings. First, the learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well. Second, control code and shared routines transfer across tasks and simulators, while task-specific solutions do not. On a real robot, we observe a performance gap between agent-designed practice and novel human-designed scenes. Third, different models evolve more effectively in different ways. Some do best acting live, others writing code first. And a text-only model keeps pace with a comparable multimodal one: perception helps with error assessment, but agentic reasoning and tool use can matter more. We release the benchmark and codebase to support future research.

[398] SenseWeather: Multimodal Sensing for Robust Robotic Perception under Extreme Conditions cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Fucai Ke, Sukai Huang, Junyi Hao, Kal Backman, Naim Rastgoo

TL;DR: SenseWeather 评测极端天气下的机器人多模态感知，并用深度与红外传感融合重建任务兼容的 RGB 观测，使冻结下游模型无需改动也能从辅助传感器受益。

Details

Motivation: 雨、雪、尘、雾和黑暗会严重退化主 RGB 输入，但机器人已配备深度和红外等传感器；现有 RGB 中心感知栈与设备实际多模态观测不匹配。

Result: 基准提供对齐 RGB、深度、红外、干净参考图和高层任务标注。Fusion-to-RGB 有两种参数高效实现：扩散 Transformer 的 token 空间融合，以及 inpainting U-Net 的残差潜变量条件。冻结的开放词汇 grounding 和 VLM 下游比较中，RGB+D+IR 融合优于对应 RGB-only 恢复器的所有配对设置，十组检测器比较的 AP50 均提升。感知提升不总与传统图像保真指标一致，天气越严重也不一定导致下游退化单调加重。摘要未提供 AP50 的具体数值。

Insight: 辅助传感器的价值应以任务级感知表现衡量，而不只看重建图像像素质量；天气严重程度和下游性能也非简单单调关系。结论来自受控基准和冻结模型，真实部署中的传感器配准误差与动态环境影响仍需测试。

Abstract: Robotic perception must remain reliable when extreme environmental conditions severely degrade the primary RGB observation. Although robotic platforms commonly carry complementary sensors such as depth and infrared, much of the modern perception stack remains RGB-centric, creating a mismatch between multimodal onboard sensing and pretrained downstream models. We study whether complementary sensing can be used upstream to recover a task-compatible RGB observation that preserves existing perception capabilities without modifying or retraining the downstream stack. To this end, we introduce SenseWeather, a controlled multimodal benchmark for robotic perception under severe rain, snow, dust, fog, and darkness, with registered RGB, depth, and infrared observations, clean references, and grounded high-level perception tasks. We further develop Fusion-to-RGB, with two parameter-efficient sensor-fusion realizations based on token-space fusion for a diffusion transformer and residual latent conditioning for an inpainting UNet. Across frozen open-vocabulary grounding and vision-language models, RGB+D+IR fusion improves all paired downstream comparisons over the corresponding RGB-only restorers, including AP50 gains across all ten detector comparisons. Importantly, these perception gains do not consistently follow conventional image-fidelity metrics, and increasing weather severity does not induce monotonic downstream degradation. These results show that complementary sensing can preserve reusable robotic perception under extreme conditions, while highlighting task-level perception robustness as an objective distinct from visual restoration quality.

[399] RAIN: Robotic Task Generalization with Region-Aware Interaction Networks cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Seunghun Lee, Kyuhwan Shim, Yeogyeong Song, Seung Hwan Kim, Sihaeng Lee

TL;DR: RAIN 将机器人任务分解为由动作类型和目标区域掩码指定的子任务，以跨视角目标条件特征、轨迹规划和完成判定支持技能跨物体与场景复用。

Details

Motivation: VLA 模型从大规模图文预训练受益，但可能记忆训练轨迹，难以把互动技能迁移到新的任务和场景组合。

Result: Target-adaptive Cross-View Encoder 根据目标掩码调节多视角特征并进行跨视图信息交换；PlanDiT 预测面向目标的轨迹和动作，Transition Head 判断子任务完成以触发自动切换。Reference-based Retargeting Strategy 利用已有轨迹为不同目标区域合成平滑接近动作，无需新增数据。在新建 LIBERO-Analogy 和真实桌面任务上，作者报告 RAIN 比所比较 VLA 基线具有更稳健的泛化。摘要未列具体成功率或提升幅度。

Insight: 目标区域掩码让子任务技能从具体物体轨迹中解耦，参考轨迹重定向也减少新增演示需求。结果包含模拟新基准和真实桌面任务，但摘要未量化各场景成绩、训练示范数量或未见组合的成功率。

Abstract: Existing vision-language-action (VLA) models benefit from large-scale vision-language pretraining, but tend to memorize training trajectories, limiting their ability to adapt learned interactions to new task and scene configurations. To address this problem, we propose \textbf{Region-Aware Interaction Networks (RAIN)}, which formulates a task as a sequence of goal-conditioned subtasks, each specified by an action type and a target-region mask. This formulation allows learned skills to be reused across different objects and scene layouts and composed into task sequences not seen during training. Its Target-adaptive Cross-View Encoder (TCE) conditions multi-view features on target masks and exchanges information across views, while PlanDiT predicts target-directed trajectories and actions. A Transition Head estimates subtask completion to enable automatic transitions. We also introduce a \textbf{Reference-based Retargeting Strategy (RRS)}, which uses recorded trajectories to synthesize smooth approaches to reference interactions with alternative target regions, without collecting additional data. Experiments on \textbf{LIBERO-Analogy}, our new benchmark for robotic task generalization, and real-world tabletop tasks demonstrate that RAIN generalizes more robustly than existing VLA baselines.

[400] ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.CVPDF

Bingxin Xu, Wenrui Bao, Xinxin Liu, Jiawei Zhou, Yuzhang Shang

TL;DR: ChunkAct 将记忆中已知的常规原子动作编译成无需 LLM 逐步监督的动作块，仅在决策或执行失败时将控制权交回规划器。

Details

Motivation: 智能体机器人每执行一个原子动作都要让 LLM 根据完整交互历史重新推理，episode 成本随动作数增长；作者观察到子目标确定后，很多动作序列已由记忆中的常规程序预先规定。

Result: ChunkAct 在线通过一次调用启动一组串联原子动作，动作块自主执行并仅在失败时返还控制；离线将记忆编译为动作块，使测试执行阶段无需持续读取记忆，规划器只处理需推理的决策。LLM 计算因此随决策数而非原子动作数增长。在 LIBERO-Pro 上，任务成功率比当时 agentic robotics 最佳结果高 5.0 分，同时 LLM 调用减少 2.9 倍、输入 token 减少 4.4 倍、输出 token 减少 2.3 倍。

Insight: 将常规子目标执行编译成可恢复动作片段，可减少重复调用 LLM；失败触发返还控制保留了异常处理通道。摘要未给出不同失败类型下的恢复率、动作块覆盖范围及低层控制安全性。

Abstract: Agentic robotics places a large language model (LLM) agent in the robot control loop, where it composes perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools under the guidance of a memory and thereby generalizes to new tasks without retraining. This generality comes at a steep price in efficiency. Every primitive requires a round of LLM reasoning over the full interaction history, so the cost of an episode grows with the number of primitives. We find this reasoning largely redundant: once a sub-goal is chosen, its primitives follow a routine already prescribed by memory. We present ChunkAct, which introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. Online, a single call launches a chunk of chained primitives, which executes autonomously and returns control only upon failure. Offline, ChunkAct compiles the memory into these chunks, so execution is memory-free at test time and the planner is reserved for decisions that require reasoning. LLM computation therefore scales with the number of decisions rather than the number of primitives. On LIBERO-Pro, ChunkAct improves task success by 5.0 points over the state of the art in agentic robotics while requiring 2.9x fewer LLM calls, 4.4x fewer input tokens, and 2.3x fewer output tokens.

[401] Disentangling Task-Relevant Latent Dynamics for Reward Modeling cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Dayou Li, Jionghao Wang, Peihao Wang, Jiuzhou Lei, Hao Wang

TL;DR: DiTaR 从多帧视频潜变量学习连续的任务相关表示，再用历史和语言条件的 rectified-flow 模型描述任务动态，并以动态兼容性变化作为稠密奖励。

Details

Motivation: 从视频学习机器人奖励可减少手工稠密奖励工程，但通用视觉空间会混淆任务相关状态变化和无关视觉差异，使奖励可能响应背景干扰而非任务执行。

Result: DiTaR 以非对称两阶段过程抑制任务无关视觉变化，学习任务相关连续潜表示；在此空间训练历史及语言条件的 rectified-flow 动力学模型，并根据时间变化的动态兼容性构造方向性稠密奖励。在 MetaWorld-v3 和 ManiSkill 上，作者报告策略学习优于视频奖励基线；将奖励重新标注用于真实世界离线 RL 时也能迁移。奖励分析显示其给分更可靠。摘要未提供具体成功率或迁移数值。

Insight: 通过先解耦任务相关状态，再预测条件动力学，奖励可关注行为是否朝目标演化，而非单纯视觉相似。真实迁移使用离线 RL 奖励重标注，摘要未说明真实机器人规模、任务结果或与人工奖励的比较。

Abstract: Reward design remains a major bottleneck for reinforcement learning in robotic manipulation. Handcrafted dense rewards can compensate for the limited guidance provided by sparse rewards, but require substantial task-specific reward engineering. Learning rewards from videos provides a scalable, data-driven alternative to manual reward design. However, existing video-based rewards are often computed in entangled visual spaces where task-relevant state changes are confounded with extraneous visual variation. As a result, the learned reward may respond to visual distractors instead of actual task execution. To address this limitation, we propose DiTaR (Disentangling Task-Relevant Latent Dynamics for Reward Modeling), a framework for learning dense rewards from heterogeneous videos. DiTaR learns a continuous task-relevant representation from multi-frame video latents through an asymmetric two-stage procedure that suppresses task-irrelevant visual variation. In the task-relevant latent space, we train a history- and language-conditioned rectified-flow model to capture task dynamics and derive a directional dense reward from temporal changes in dynamics compatibility. Together, these components enable reward modeling directly over task-relevant dynamics rather than generic visual variation. DiTaR substantially improves policy learning on MetaWorld-v3 and ManiSkill over video-based reward baselines, and transfers to real-world offline RL through reward relabeling. Reward analyses further show that DiTaR provides more reliable rewards.

[402] Axiom-0: Hierarchical Self-Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Policies cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Renbin Shu, Jing Yang, Xiangyuan You, Guolin Qiu, Yufei Xia

TL;DR: Axiom-0 通过中间表示一致性精炼和动作生成前的条件递归更新，改善 VLA 在陌生任务组合上的操作成功率。

Details

Motivation: VLA 结合预训练多模态理解与控制能力，但在不熟悉的任务组合上仍受表示质量及其传递到动作生成方式的限制。

Result: IVRR 在训练时用学习到的特征投影一致性监督强化选定中间表示；VAIR 在动作生成前递归更新条件。VLM 监督层、VAIR 和动作生成器联合优化。在 RoboCasa365 上，Axiom-0 总体成功率为 62.32%，高于已发表最高榜单分数 Paimon-0 的 58.1%（高 4.22 个百分点），也比 Xiaomi-Robotics-1 参考系统高 4.92 点。在作者评测的 profiling 设置下，平均动作块生成延迟仅比 Xiaomi-Robotics-1 高 1.7%。

Insight: 同时改善 VLM 内部表示及表示到动作模块之间的条件接口，针对理解—控制落差而非仅扩大动作模型。62.32% 是 RoboCasa365 评测结果，延迟差仅在指定 profiling 设置测量，摘要未给真实机器人验证。

Abstract: Reliable manipulation requires policies that generalize across tasks, layouts, and object interactions. Vision-language-action (VLA) models combine pretrained multimodal understanding with learned control, but their performance remains limited on unfamiliar task compositions. We present Axiom-0, a VLA policy that addresses both the quality of its representations and their use in action generation through hierarchical self-refinement. Intra-VLM Representation Refinement (IVRR) strengthens selected intermediate features through consistency supervision with learned feature projections during training. VLM-Action Interface Refinement (VAIR) recursively updates the resulting conditioning before action generation. Joint optimization of the supervised VLM layers, VAIR, and the action generator connects the two components. On RoboCasa365, Axiom-0 achieves 62.32% overall success in our evaluation, exceeding the highest published leaderboard score (Paimon-0, 58.1%) by 4.22 percentage points and the Xiaomi-Robotics-1 reference by 4.92 points. Under the evaluated profiling setup, mean action-chunk generation latency increases by 1.7% over Xiaomi-Robotics-1. These results demonstrate improved task completion with modest inference overhead.

[403] ClothCode: Generative Modeling for Garment State Estimation and Dynamics Prediction cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Yingdong Ru, Lipeng Zhuang, Shiyu Fan, Zhuo He, Florent P. Audonnet

TL;DR: ClothCode 用材质对齐的残差向量量化 token 表示衣物状态，并以掩码生成 Transformer 并行预测状态和动作条件下的动力学变化。

Details

Motivation: 柔性衣物状态估计与动作后预测对机器人操作重要，需要共享表示连接当前构型和未来动态，同时保持推理效率。

Result: 框架在统一离散构型空间中建模衣物状态及动作条件动态。三个衣物模板上，相较最强基线，状态估计平均位移误差降低 26.6%，动力学预测降低 37.0%。动力学预测每窗口仅需 16.7 ms，对比扩散模型 556.2 ms。在相同模型预测控制器中，真实折叠和铺平成功率从 56.7% 提高到 78.9%。

Insight: 共享离散服装表示可同时支持状态估计和条件未来预测，速度优势使其能融入实时控制。真实实验覆盖折叠与铺平，但摘要未报告硬件、衣物模板变化和长时多步预测误差。

Abstract: We introduce ClothCode, a unified generative framework for garment state estimation and action-conditioned dynamics prediction in a shared discrete configuration space. A material-aligned tokenizer encodes garment configuration as residual vector-quantized patch tokens, while task-specific Masked Generative Transformers predict these tokens through parallel confidence-guided refinement. Across three garment templates, ClothCode reduces mean displacement error by 26.6% for state estimation and 37.0% for dynamics prediction relative to the strongest baselines. Dynamics prediction requires only 16.7 ms per window, compared with 556.2 ms for diffusion. Integrated into the same model-predictive controller, ClothCode improves real-world folding and flattening success from 56.7% to 78.9%. Further results and videos are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ClothCode-DE32

[404] Multi-modal Representation Fusion for Long-term Microsurgical Anastomosis Trajectory Anticipation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Yuxuan Liu, Yating Luo, Yunfei Luan, Xinyao Zhou, Yuyang Zhuge

TL;DR: 该方法将手术器械语义识别和连续运动估计作为互补线索，与历史轨迹共同融合，用于显微吻合操作的长时 2D/3D 轨迹预测。

Details

Motivation: 显微吻合要求在狭小空间精准操纵器械；轨迹预测对场景理解、术中规划和机器人控制重要，但既有方法多只利用视频特征和历史轨迹，忽略器械—组织交互的语义及运动信息。

Result: 框架包含多模态表示提取器和跨模态融合网络，将手术对象语义识别、连续运动估计作为互补视觉引导。粗到细渐进融合结合 LSTM 逐步捕获时序依赖。作者在自建机器人平台及覆盖仿体和离体手术场景的数据集上训练评测，定量和定性结果均称优于既有方法，并对不同手术场景表现出更好的鲁棒性。摘要未报告数据规模、预测时域、误差指标或提升幅度。

Insight: 同时建模对象语义和连续运动可为器械—组织互动提供空间与时间线索，优于只依赖历史视觉/轨迹的设计。摘要结论限于自建平台及仿体、离体场景，未提供真实临床手术验证或具体精度。

Abstract: Microsurgical anastomosis is one of the most challenging and sophisticated procedures for surgical robotics, requiring accurate manipulation of surgical instruments within a limited space to achieve precise operations. Accurate surgical trajectory anticipation is essential for surgical scene understanding, intraoperative planning, robotic manipulation, and reliable behaviour analysis. However, existing approaches mainly focus on features extracted from surgical videos and historical trajectories, while overlooking rich semantic and motion information that can provide more discriminative multi-modal representations for complex surgical instrument-tissue interactions. In this work, we propose a cross-modal feature fusion framework for long-term 2D and 3D microsurgical anastomosis trajectory anticipation. The proposed framework consists of a multi-modal representation extractor and a cross-modal feature fusion network. Semantic recognition of surgical objects and consecutive motion estimation are incorporated as multi-modal visual cues, providing complementary spatial and temporal guidance for instrument-tissue interaction characterization. A coarse-to-fine progressive fusion strategy with a long-short-term memory mechanism is introduced to capture temporal dependencies step by step. The training and evaluation are conducted on our established robotic platform and a comprehensive dataset containing both phantom and ex-vivo surgical scenarios is constructed. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms existing methods and exhibits improved robustness across different surgical scenes, highlighting its potential for both intelligent robot-assisted and autonomous surgical systems.
