Chen Zhao, Zipeng Ye, Haitao Shen, Guanlin Li, Yuchen Xie

TL;DR: ADS 在训练期按 flow 支持度对当前 VLA 策略采样出的轨迹加权，以扩展可供验证器选择的动作候选多样性，且不增加部署时成本。

Details

Motivation: 测试时多次采样可让验证器从多种可执行动作中选择，但 VLA 微调可能使 flow-matching 解码器集中到主导演示动作，重复采样高度相似，候选预算增大也未必带来更多选择。

Result: Action Dynamic Sampling 每步从当前策略在新基础噪声下积分 K 条额外轨迹，用 Hutchinson trace estimator 计算各轨迹的 flow 支持度，并通过停止梯度的有限集合 KL 项调整局部动作分布。训练成本增加，部署成本不变。在模拟与四项真实机器人任务上，ADS 提高候选分散度而不产生高斯扰动的成功率惩罚；RoboCasa oracle best-of-8 成功率从 57.6% 提至 63.0%，固定验证器在模拟中提高 2.4–4.9 点，真实操作 TokenPB 最高提高 13.0 点。

Insight: 提升 test-time scaling 效果的关键可能在训练时形成不冗余的候选分布，而非单纯增加采样次数。oracle best-of-N 与固定验证器结果不同，后者更接近可部署选择效果；摘要未列每项实体任务成功率和新增训练成本。

Abstract: Test-time sampling promises to turn one action prediction into a set of distinct executable candidates that a verifier can choose among. Downstream fine-tuning works against that promise. A vision-language-action model trained to solve one task distribution concentrates its flow-matching decoder around the dominant demonstrated action, so repeated samples differ only marginally and the verifier receives many copies of one decision. We call this proposal contraction and identify it as a key constraint on test-time scaling: repeated samples can remain highly redundant as the candidate budget grows. Action Dynamic Sampling (ADS) alleviates the constraint on the proposal side, during training. At each training step, ADS integrates $K$ additional trajectories from the current policy under fresh base noise, scores each by the flow support along its path with a Hutchinson trace estimator, and corrects the policy’s local action distribution toward this weighted set through a detached finite-set KL term. Training cost rises; deployment cost is unchanged. Across simulation and four physical-robot tasks, ADS raises proposal spread without the success penalty that Gaussian perturbation incurs, lifts oracle best-of-8 success on RoboCasa from 57.6% to 63.0%, improves fixed verifiers by 2.4 to 4.9 points in simulation, and raises TokenPB by up to 13.0 points on real-world manipulation.

Hao Wu, Tianyu Shao, Shengju Qian, Yizhou Zhao, Fan Zhang

TL;DR: ReCAP 在冻结的机器人视频世界模型中保留初始场景锚点和近期完整视觉—动作块，淘汰更旧生成历史，以缓解长 rollout 的上下文记忆冲突。

Details

Motivation: 自回归世界模型即使保留全部生成历史也不一定预测更好；持久场景信息、近期动作状态和陈旧帧可能争夺注意，导致长时生成退化。

Insight: 完整历史可能引入陈旧信息而损害预测，保留场景锚点及近期完整状态提供了简单推理期日程。性能变化与上下文截断、位置效应也可能相关，作者未声称已单独证明记忆角色冲突假说。

Abstract: Autoregressive robot video world models based on discrete visual tokens remain unreliable over long rollout horizons. Retaining the entire generated history does not necessarily improve prediction quality. We investigate a possible memory-role conflict in Full Context decoding: persistent scene information, recent visual-action states, and stale generated history compete for attention despite their different predictive roles. This perspective motivates ReCAP (Receding Context with Anchor Preservation), a training-free context-scheduling method for long-horizon robot video world models. ReCAP keeps the pretrained tokenizer, world model, and visual decoder frozen. It preserves the initial scene anchor and a contiguous window of recent complete visual-action blocks while evicting older generated history. The schedule preserves within-block structure and temporal order, requires no additional modules or parameter updates, and bounds active-context growth independently of rollout length. We evaluate ReCAP on RT-1, BridgeV2, LIBERO-90, and CALVIN using frozen autoregressive world models. Across evaluated environments and horizons, ReCAP improves visual fidelity, action-conditioned consistency, and robot structure preservation relative to Full Context. On BridgeV2, it reduces LPIPS by 63.3%. In the system benchmark at H=64, it reduces the logical KV footprint by 73.3% and p50 latency by 6.51%. Attention analyses show increased attention to retained recent states, while history interventions associate larger amounts of stale context with higher prediction error. These observations are consistent with the memory-role-conflict hypothesis, although they do not isolate it from context-length and position-handling effects. Our results support inference-time context scheduling as a practical approach to improving long-horizon robot video prediction and computational efficiency without retraining.

[407] Recovering Low-Bit Failures in Vision-Language-Action Policies via Quantization-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Seongmin Park, Jaewon Lee, Yujun Heo, Yoonsik Kim, Seheon Choi

TL;DR: QCRL 针对低比特 VLA 的失败，在离线强化学习中结合进度优势估计和量化条件化参考动作选择，利用全精度 rollout 超越单纯动作蒸馏。

Details

Motivation: 量化可降低 VLA 部署成本，但 PTQ 和 QAT 在长程任务、视觉/语义分布偏移下仍与全精度存在差距，且仅模仿目标不直接利用 rollout 成功或部分完成信号。

Result: QCRL 用全精度 rollout 提供超出动作级蒸馏的参考经验，以随进度缩放的终局惩罚区分部分完成，并根据量化条件从参考行为中选择有利策略。评估包含 π0.5 和 GR00T N1.5 的权重 INT4 W4A16，以及 π0.5 的权重/激活 NVFP4 W4A4。仅用分布内数据时，π0.5 的 INT4 W4A16 在三个视觉偏移条件上的平均分达到全精度的 99.3%，模型内存节省 42.9%；NVFP4 W4A4 达到同一全精度基线的 100.7%，以 NVFP4/FP8 部署相较 Jetson Thor 上 FP16 加速 1.73 倍。

Insight: 进度信号让部分成功也能影响低比特策略优化，而条件化参考行为提供量化策略可学习的较好轨迹。报告性能为全精度均分比例，硬件收益比较基于 Jetson Thor FP16；摘要未给各任务成绩和失败案例。

Abstract: Quantization lowers deployment costs of vision-language-action (VLA) policies but can compromise task completion. Across five VLA models and 4,050 real-world trials, we systematically reveal that quantization-aware training (QAT) generally improves on post-training quantization (PTQ) but leaves substantial gaps to full precision (FP) on long-horizon tasks and under visual and semantic shifts, while its imitation-based objective does not explicitly use rollout success or partial completion. To exploit these outcome signals, we introduce Quantization-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning (QCRL), an offline RL method coupling progress-based advantage estimation with quantization-aware source conditioning. FP rollouts supply reference experience beyond action-level distillation, progress-scaled terminal penalty distinguishes partial completion, and quantization-aware conditioning selects advantageous reference behavior within the quantized policy. We evaluate weight-only INT4 W4A16 on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 and joint weight-activation NVFP4 W4A4 on $π_{0.5}$. Using only in-distribution data, QCRL reaches 99.3% of FP’s mean score across three visual-shift conditions for $π_{0.5}$ with INT4 W4A16, alongside 42.9% model-memory savings. With NVFP4 W4A4, it reaches 100.7% of the same FP baseline, alongside a $1.73\times$ speedup using NVFP4/FP8 deployment. Hardware gains are relative to FP16 on Jetson Thor.

[408] BridgeWAM: Bridging Video and Action Experts via Latent Bridge Queries cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Jiaxin Fang, Ruitong Liu, Zeyu Lai, Xingyu Wang, Mingyuan Jia

TL;DR: BridgeWAM 用 32 个潜桥接查询聚合视觉、语言和本体感觉先验，在视频专家与轻量动作专家之间选择性传递任务相关信息。

Details

Motivation: 密集逐层 MoT 注意力会把无关视觉特征带入动作预测，并强制视频/动作专家深度匹配，造成信息利用不选择及冗余计算。

Result: Bridge-of-Experts 的 BridgeWAM 将信息压缩至 32 个 Latent Bridge Queries；联合视频—动作监督使动作梯度调整视频专家表示，动作专家再以交叉注意力选择性读取相关信息。模型总计 5.06B，视频专家 30 层、动作专家 2 层。LIBERO 成功率为 98.25%，LIBERO-Plus 汇总成功率 72.24%。相较 Fast-WAM，模拟 profiling 单样本 FLOPs 降低 28.72%，真实机器人延迟为 77.1 ms、速度快 2.47 倍；定性实验显示扰动下注意力偏向目标物体和任务目的地。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) commonly couple video and action experts through dense, layer-wise Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) attention, exposing action prediction to irrelevant visual features while enforcing matched expert depths. This coupling hinders selective visual-feature use and introduces redundant computation. We introduce Bridge-of-Experts (BoE), instantiated as BridgeWAM, which aggregates visual, language, and proprioceptive priors through 32 Latent Bridge Queries (LBQs) into a shared, limited latent space. Joint video-action supervision lets action gradients guide the Video Expert toward representations better suited for action prediction, while the Action Expert learns to selectively retrieve task-relevant information through cross-attention. Decoupling expert depths and reusing LBQs during action denoising yield a 5.06B model with a 30-layer Video Expert and a two-layer Action Expert, achieving 98.25% success on LIBERO and 72.24% pooled success on LIBERO-Plus, demonstrating effective task execution and strong generalization with an ultralight action head. Ablations support joint representation adaptation and unified LBQ conditioning. Relative to Fast-WAM, BridgeWAM reduces single-sample inference FLOPs by 28.72% in simulation profiling and real-robot latency to 77.1 ms (a 2.47-fold speedup). Qualitative experimental results further indicate preferential attention to target objects and task destinations across perturbations.

[409] Hand2Robot: Object-Centric 4D Hand Reconstruction from Human Demonstrations for Robotics cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Zetao Du, Weiqing Wang, Hanbing Zhang, Yimiao Zhou, Ye Shi

TL;DR: Hand2Robot 从人类演示视频重建物体与手部 4D 交互，再通过手—物优化和运动重定向生成机器人动作监督。

Details

Motivation: 人类演示能提供任务相关操作，但手部运动不能直接成为目标机器人的动作标签；单独重建手运动也无法保证物理一致的手—物互动。

Result: Hand2Robot 提取交互片段、重建物体几何并生成机器人动作监督。物体跟踪结合观测置信度和时间运动约束，从逐帧候选中选择全局一致位姿；手部细化以物体几何和运动为参照，结合分阶段 2D 对齐及物体局部接触约束优化手轨迹和手指关节。在 DexYCB、HO3D-v3 上作者报告物体位姿精度和手—物交互质量提升；三项真实机器人灵巧操作任务显示重建并重定向的人类演示可有效补充有限机器人数据。摘要未列量化提升。

Insight: 动作监督需同时重建物体轨迹、手部运动和接触关系，再映射到机器人动作空间；只重定向手轨迹可能违背物理接触。摘要结果覆盖真实机器人任务，但未说明动作重定向成功率、额外人工校正需求或基线成绩。

Abstract: Human demonstrations can capture task-relevant manipulation without using the target robot, but the recorded hand motions cannot directly serve as robot action supervision. Hand reconstruction and motion retargeting provide a direct route to such supervision, yet recovering hand motion alone does not ensure physically consistent hand-object interactions. To address this issue, we introduce Hand2Robot, an object-centric 4D hand reconstruction framework for robot policy post-training. Given videos of humans performing the target task, Hand2Robot extracts interaction clips, reconstructs object geometry, and generates robot action supervision through hand-object interaction optimization and motion retargeting. For object tracking, we combine observation confidence with temporal motion constraints to select a globally consistent object pose trajectory from per-frame pose candidates. For hand refinement, we use object geometry and motion as a reference and combine staged 2D alignment with object-local contact constraints to refine hand trajectories and finger joint configurations. Experiments on DexYCB and HO3D-v3 show improved object pose accuracy and hand-object interaction quality. Experiments on three real-robot dexterous manipulation tasks further show that reconstructed and retargeted human demonstrations can effectively supplement limited robot data for target-task policy post-training.

[410] Language2Drive: Do Vision-Language-Action Models Really Follow the Instructions in Autonomous Driving? cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Zihan You, Zehua Fan, Wenqi Lyu, Aoqi Wang, Ni Wang

TL;DR: Language2Drive 用初始场景相同、只改变指令的配对反事实评测，检查自动驾驶 VLA 是否真的按乘客语言选择可行行为。

Details

Motivation: 闭环驾驶基准通常看路线完成、安全和规则遵守，但车辆即便安全到达，也可能忽略乘客具体指令；孤立指令成功无法区分指令跟随与模型始终执行偏好的固定行为。

Result: 基准的 paired counterfactual unit 固定初始场景、只改变指令，并涵盖四种指令范围；评测结合闭环 CARLA、重建真实场景和开环驾驶基准，发布专用 CARLA 模拟器。对代表性驾驶 VLA 的评估发现，在成功 rollout 中，93.2% 没有在替代可行指令下对应成功的反事实轨迹；主要失败为单侧完成，即同一模型反复执行一种偏好行为，却无法在同场景按反事实指令执行另一行为。

Insight: 驾驶能力、单条轨迹成功和语言控制能力是不同指标；配对反事实测试揭示传统单次成功率会高估指令遵循。93.2% 是成功 rollout 未具备另一指令成功配对的比例，摘要未提供不同指令类型的具体率。

Abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models increasingly use natural-language instructions to condition autonomous driving behavior. Yet existing closed-loop benchmarks primarily measure route completion, safety, and rule compliance, leaving a fundamental question unresolved: does language actually determine which feasible behavior the vehicle executes? A trajectory may be safe and successful while still violating or even ignoring the passenger’s instruction. To address this, we introduce \ltd, a benchmark designed to directly test this capability. Its key evaluation unit, the paired counterfactual unit (PCU), holds the initial driving scene fixed while changing only the instruction. This design enables us to distinguish isolated instruction success from counterfactual paired success across four instruction-following scopes. To test whether this distinction persists across evaluation regimes, we instantiate Language2Drive in complementary closed-loop CARLA simulation, reconstructed real-world scenes, and open-loop driving benchmarks, including our released CARLA-Language2Drive simulator with purpose-built maps. Evaluating representative driving VLAs across these settings reveals a striking mismatch between strong driving competence and weak language control: 93.2% of successful rollouts do not have a successful counterpart under the alternative feasible instruction. This failure is dominated by one-sided completion, where a model repeatedly executes one preferred behavior but fails when the same scene requires the counterfactual alternative. These results expose two fundamental limitations of current evaluation: isolated success and driving scores, which are widely used by conventional driving benchmarks, can substantially overstate language-following capability, while current driving VLAs themselves lack reliable instruction following under matched counterfactual tests.

[411] UniLAP: A Unified Latent Action Policy for Cross-Embodiment Manipulation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Lei Yao, Qiao Feng, Mutian Tong, Qihao Yun, Lap-Pui Chau

TL;DR: UniLAP 用 flow matching 建模连续潜在动作，并从无动作视频蒸馏潜动作教师；推理时直接生成可执行动作，不依赖未来帧规划。

Details

Motivation: 离散潜动作存在粒度瓶颈；连续潜动作方法虽能细化行为，却常作为世界模型代理，仍需额外规划阶段转成执行动作。

Result: 统一连续潜在动作策略以 flow-adaptive 目标蒸馏 LAM 教师，继承动作表示同时保留多种可行动作分布。作者用无标签运动目标隔离相关运动学线索，减少潜表示受无关外观动态影响，并构建与具身无关的潜在流形以适配新平台。1.1B 参数模型用多源视频预训练，在手姿预测、单臂及人形机器人操作和真实部署任务上，报告超过潜动作和 VLA 基线。摘要未给具体指标或平台适配成本。

Insight: 连续潜空间保持细粒度多模态行为，同时省去基于未来帧的额外规划；无标签运动目标有助于跨外观迁移。摘要未报告跨平台的具体成功率、动作延迟或动作潜变量可解释性。

Abstract: Latent Action Models (LAMs) can capture manipulation priors from action-free videos, but discrete latents usually impose a granularity bottleneck, limiting their ability to represent fine-grained action. Recent continuous alternatives mitigate this, but they are typically used as proxies for world modeling and require a further planning step to produce executable actions. We thus introduce UniLAP, a unified continuous latent-action policy that models the latent space via flow matching and bypasses reliance on future frames during inference. By distilling a LAM teacher with a flow-adaptive objective, UniLAP inherits the teacher’s action representation while retaining the multimodal distribution of feasible behaviors. To decouple latent representations from task-irrelevant appearance, we extract a label-free motion target to isolate relevant kinematic cues from spurious visual dynamics. With the established embodiment-agnostic latent manifold, UniLAP can be easily adapted to novel platforms. Pretrained on multi-source videos at a compact 1.1B parameter scale, UniLAP outperforms state-of-the-art latent-action and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) baselines across hand pose forecasting, single-arm and humanoid manipulation, and real-world deployment.

[412] From Pixels to Executable Physics: Behavior-Grounded World Models for Embodied Action Consequence Prediction cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Ruo Chen, Jiahua Pang, Yingjie Niu, Hongyi Lin, Jun Tian

TL;DR: DR-WM 从 RGB 场景重建几何，并利用真实动作响应校准的地形接触先验模拟候选动作后果，以提升四足机器人户外规划。

Details

Motivation: 户外地形和接触条件变化会使相同控制指令产生不同运动结果；视觉世界模型虽然可生成逼真未来，但常未能建模机器人动力学和地形交互，导致动作后果预测过度乐观。

Result: DR-WM 将无量纲密集地形接触先验与几何结合，并由真实动作响应数据校准；可以模拟空间变化摩擦等接触性质。给定机器人状态和候选动作序列，模型先模拟未来运动，利用相机轨迹与渲染几何指导视频世界模型，再以生成观察更新地形重建，实现无新增真实图像的迭代 rollout。在 90 个挑战情景中，结合 DR-WM 的 8B VLM 在六项评测中的五项超过未增强的 32B VLM；物理指标上也优于仅几何和统一物理参数基线。摘要未列各物理指标数值。

Insight: 从视觉场景恢复接触属性并做物理 rollout，可补足仅视觉生成模型缺乏可执行动力学的问题。8B 增强模型在五项指标超过 32B 未增强模型，但结果仍依赖校准数据和模拟物理准确性；摘要未报告真实机器人部署。

Abstract: In outdoor environments, varying terrain and contact conditions can cause identical action commands to produce different motion outcomes for quadruped robots. Predicting these outcomes is essential for reliable navigation and informed path selection. Existing video world models can generate visually plausible futures, yet often struggle to capture robot dynamics and terrain interactions, leading to overly optimistic predictions of action outcomes. We present DR-WM, a physically consistent world model that incorporates robot-terrain contact dynamics to predict the consequences of quadruped actions. Starting from an initial RGB image, our method reconstructs scene geometry and integrates dense, dimensionless priors over terrain contact properties, calibrated using real-world action-response data. The resulting terrain model supports the simulation of physics with spatially varying contact properties such as friction. Given the initial state of the robot and candidate action sequences, we simulate its future motion and use the resulting camera trajectories and rendered geometry to guide the training of a video world model. The generated future observations are then used to update the terrain reconstruction, enabling iterative model rollouts without additional real-world images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DR-WM substantially outperforms geometry-only baselines and baselines with uniform physical parameters on key physical metrics characterizing action outcomes, while achieving the best performance among the evaluated baselines. These physically grounded predictions support more informed action selection: across 90 challenging scenarios, an 8B vision-language model augmented with DR-WM outperforms an unassisted 32B vision-language model on five of six evaluation metrics.

[413] Code2Worlds-2: Physically Plausible Agent Harness for Embodied World Simulation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Haoyu Zhang, Siming Li, Zeyu Zhang, Yi Zhang, Tat-Seng Chua

TL;DR: Code2Worlds-2 将自然语言生成的 4D 视觉场景编译成 MuJoCo 可执行场景，并用编译—模拟—诊断—修改循环优化真实物理参数。

Details

Motivation: 代码模型能生成动态 4D 场景，但生成物可能只是视觉效果，缺少碰撞几何、质量、摩擦、惯性和关节等可供物理引擎运行的语义，动作也可能是预先脚本化而非物理执行结果。

Result: 系统保留原双流生成流程并添加 SimReady Scene Compiler：凸分解生成碰撞网格，VLM 估计物理属性，推断支撑图，设置接触、摩擦和动力学约束，重力沉降后导出 MuJoCo MJCF。Simulator-in-the-Loop 4D Refiner 自动循环编译、模拟、批评和修改物理设定；模拟器检查穿透深度、碰撞、稳定性、接触力、关节限制和机器人可达性。作者提出五种任务模板的状态式 SimCode4D 基准；实验覆盖自然、室内、工业、城市和服务场景，报告生成场景具物理合理性、模拟器兼容性和机器人交互能力。摘要未给具体指标。

Insight: 把生成目标从“看起来动态”推进到可装载、可步进的可执行物理世界，并以模拟器反馈修订参数而非只改代码。摘要未量化物理一致性、机器人成功率或与原版比较，状态基准及模拟环境范围也需结合正文理解。

Abstract: Recent coding large language models (LLMs) can synthesize dynamic 4D worlds from natural language, but the resulting content remains a visual artifact. It lacks physical semantics such as the collision geometry, mass, friction, inertia, and joint structure, required to enable it to simulate the physical world, and its dynamics are scripted to look plausible rather than designed to execute. What is needed is an executable world: one that a physics engine can load and step, resolving contact physically. We present Code2Worlds-2, an extension of Code2Worlds that turns 4D world generation into an embodied world simulation. We keep the original dual-stream generation pipeline intact and append two modules. First, a SimReady Scene Compiler that turns a generated visual scene into a simulator-compatible representation: it assigns collision meshes via convex decomposition, estimates physical attributes with a vision-language model, infers a lightweight support graph, instantiates the engine’s contact, friction, and dynamics constraints, and applies a gravity settling pass, before exporting the scene as MuJoCo MJCF. Second, a Simulator-in-the-Loop 4D Refiner that implements an automated agent harness-a compile, simulate, critique and refine loop-that converts visual dynamics into executable rigid and articulated dynamics and evolves the physical settings rather than only the code, replacing the purely visual motion critic with a simulator critic that inspects penetration depth, collision pairs, stability, contact forces, joint limits, and robot reachability. We further propose SimCode4D, a state-based benchmark with five task templates for evaluating embodied simulation. Experiments on SimCode4D and across natural, indoor, industrial, urban, and service scenes show that Code2Worlds-2 produces physically plausible, simulator-compatible, and robot-interactable scenes.

Details

Motivation: 长时操作任务由基础技能及其转换组成，机器人演示两者采集成本高；人类视频规模更大，但需转换成机器人观测—动作，并保持手物接触结构。

Insight: 接触约束和逐指遮挡排序使人类演示转换不只复制手部轨迹，也尽量保留物理互动；技能进度预测支持闭环串联。四种任务的序列成功率略低于单技能，摘要未说明技能数量扩展或不同机器人平台迁移。

Abstract: A long-horizon manipulation task consists of primitive skills and the transitions connecting them. Learning skills that can be executed in sequence requires supervision for both, which is costly to collect on a robot. Human videos offer a scalable source of demonstrations, but transferring them to robots requires extracting robot-compatible observations and actions together with their skill structure. We present DexStitch, a framework that cuts long-horizon human videos into skills and transitions, converts them into aligned robot observation-action-skill data, and stitches the learned skills into a requested sequence. A skill classifier first segments the videos into manipulation skills and transitions. DexStitch then converts the human demonstrations into robot observations and actions while retaining their corresponding skill labels. During conversion, per-finger human-object contacts guide dexterous hand retargeting and robotic inpainting, preserving contact geometry and finger-object occlusion ordering. To stitch the learned skills into a sequence, a shared skill-conditioned policy is pretrained on the resulting synthetic data and finetuned on a mixture of synthetic data and a small set of single-skill teleoperation episodes. Conditioning on the current and next skills guides each transition toward the following skill, while predicted skill progression enables closed-loop switching. On a held-out session, the classifier agrees with manual annotations on 92.4% of frames. Across four household skills, DexStitch achieves 80.0% single-skill success and 77.5% sequence success.

Bo-Ruei Huang, Daniel Seita, Erdem Bıyık

TL;DR: WACL 从人类裸手演示学习全臂接触轨迹，并用运动学优化器将语义关键点、接触轨迹和末端安全约束落到具体机器人连杆与关节。

Details

Motivation: 机器人操作常以末端执行器为中心，而人类会用整个手臂接触物体以提高效率和鲁棒性；机器人需决定哪段手臂何处接触、如何形成非抓取互动，同时满足末端任务或安全限制。

Insight: 将任务表示与机器人运动学解算分开，使同一接触示范可适配不同末端要求；只用少量非遥操作演示也能学习。实验证据为一台 7-DoF 机械臂四项任务，摘要未说明周期时间、人体安全或更广机器人形态迁移。

Abstract: Robot manipulation has traditionally relied on end-effector-centric interactions. In contrast, humans routinely exploit whole-arm contacts to improve efficiency, robustness, and adaptability, especially when the hands are occupied or when precise grasping is unnecessary. Enabling similar capabilities in robots remains challenging: the robot must select where on its arm to make contact, generate effective non-prehensile interactions, and satisfy task-specific pose or safety constraints on the end-effector. We propose Whole-Arm Contact Learning (WACL), a hierarchical framework that describes each whole-arm contact task with three robot-agnostic representations and hands them to a quasi-static surface-contact optimizer: semantic keypoints that summarize the scene, a reference contact trajectory that specifies where and how the arm presses on the object, and safety-aware path constraints that a vision-language model generates from the task description to protect the end-effector’s task. The robot’s kinematic chain enters only in this optimizer, which grounds these representations onto the arm by jointly searching over which link makes contact, where on that link, and the joint configuration that realizes it. This decomposition lets WACL learn the contact trajectory from 10 bare-hand human demonstrations per task collected without teleoperation, while new end-effector constraints change only the optimizer’s input rather than any trained component. Real-world experiments on a 7-DoF arm across four whole-arm tasks show that WACL sustains contact under end-effector constraints where a strong link-pose baseline fails (78% vs. 33% success) and generalizes to new constraints without retraining. Website: https://wacl-robot.github.io

[416] Data-Free Continual Learning for World Action Model with Rectified Generative Replay cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Kaipeng Fang, Hangxu Liu, Chaojian Shi, Yunsong Zhou, Hongzi Zhu

TL;DR: R²-WAM 通过智能体评估器截断完成后的无效 rollout，并过滤动作与视觉不一致的自生成轨迹，实现无需旧训练数据的世界动作模型持续学习。

Details

Motivation: 视频生成预训练的世界动作模型可快速适配新机器人任务，但顺序微调会遗忘旧任务；传统经验回放需要保存过去数据，而机器人策略常仅以权重形式部署。

Result: 作者发现 WAM 能自回归重生成既学任务的完整轨迹，但原始回放不如真实数据，原因包括模型无法识别任务完成而继续生成无目的动作，以及开环动作逐渐偏离生成观察。Rectified Generative Replay 用智能体评估器在任务完成时截断轨迹，并筛除动作—观察物理不一致的 rollout。在四个 LIBERO 套件和五项真实任务上，相较顺序微调，遗忘减少超过 90%，且不访问旧任务数据时接近经验回放。分析发现遗忘集中在逆动力学：旧任务视觉仍合理，但生成动作失败。

Insight: 自生成数据可支持无数据访问的持续学习，但必须修正完成截断和动作—观察一致性，否则会回放错误经验。摘要称接近 ER 而非完全等同；真实任务及各套件具体成功率未提供。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) built on pretrained video generation models adapt quickly to new robotic tasks, but they forget previously learned tasks under sequential fine-tuning. Experience replay (ER) mitigates such forgetting by rehearsing data of previous tasks, yet this data is often unavailable in robotics, where a policy is deployed as weights only and its training data is not shared along with it. In this work, we ask whether a WAM can achieve data-free continual learning by regenerating its own past. Our key observation is that a WAM can indeed autoregressively regenerate complete rollouts of previously learned tasks and replay them to mitigate forgetting. However, replaying such raw rollouts still lags far behind replaying real data, which we attribute to two issues. First, the WAM is unable to recognize task completion and keeps generating purposeless motion after the task is done. Second, under open-loop generation, the generated actions gradually drift away from the generated observations. To address both issues, we present rectified generative replay (R$^2$-WAM), which truncates generated rollouts at task completion with an agentic evaluator and filters out rollouts whose actions are physically inconsistent with the observations. On the four LIBERO suites and five real-world tasks, R$^2$-WAM reduces forgetting by over 90% relative to sequential fine-tuning and nearly matches ER without accessing any data from previous tasks. Our analysis further reveals that forgetting in WAMs concentrates in inverse dynamics modeling: a forgotten WAM still produces visually plausible observations of previous tasks while its generated actions fail.

Rohit Mohan

Details

Motivation: 机器人需基于局部、噪声或退化观测理解环境；只建模可见区域、固定语义类别并假定传感器可靠的系统，会在遮挡、新物体和传感器退化时失效。

Abstract: Reliable robot autonomy requires reasoning about the world from partial and noisy observations. However, many perception systems model only visible scene regions, rely on fixed semantic categories, and assume reliable sensor measurements. These assumptions break under occlusion, novel object encounters, and sensor degradation. In this paper, I present a research vision for incompleteness-aware scene understanding. I organize this vision around three fundamental challenges: incomplete evidence, incomplete knowledge, and incomplete sensor reliability. I discuss my research contributions toward addressing these challenges through amodal perception, semantic occupancy forecasting, open-world scene understanding, label-efficient learning, and uncertainty-guided multi-modal fusion. Building on these contributions, I outline future research directions toward belief-centric 4D scene representations. These representations aim to jointly model geometry, semantics, motion, and uncertainty. I also discuss active sensing and safe adaptation strategies that allow robots to reduce uncertainty through interaction. The goal is to develop calibrated and actionable scene representations that support reliable autonomy in dynamic, open-world environments.

Yunsong Zhou, Xuekun Jiang, Haiqi Shen, Hangxu Liu, Chaojian Shi

Abstract: Learning humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations rests on observing how locomotion, posture, and object interaction evolve together as tasks unfold. Scaling collection across diverse environments, in turn, favors lightweight, portable capture systems. Yet, existing datasets provide only partial views of this coordination. Thus, we introduce EgoExplorer, a 100-hour vision-motion-touch observatory of human loco-manipulation built with a wearable system. With an emphasis on professional activities, its continuous recordings align egocentric video with reconstructed whole-body motion, fine-grained finger articulation, and tactile observations, accompanied by step-level descriptions. To achieve this coverage with sparse body sensing, we develop the Calibrate-Complete-Constrain pipeline. Concretely, reusable calibration fixes participant geometry and sensor attachments before motion inference to disentangle mounting offsets from articulation. A temporal prior then completes unobserved joint motion, while layered constraints promote measurement agreement, temporal continuity, and geometric consistency, properties that motion plausibility alone does not guarantee. Against tracker-fitted references, the method reduces body-point error by 71.9% relative to the strongest baseline; matched evaluations also show gains in hand stability and contact estimation. Preliminary studies explore multimodal generation and conditioning alongside humanoid retargeting with whole-body control in simulation.

[419] LoopWAM: Closed-Loop Generalist Policy Improvement from Deployment Rollouts cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Wenxuan Guo, Yingping Liang, Zhaoguo Wang, Ziyuan Li, Angyuan Ma

Abstract: Scaling expert demonstrations alone does not enable generalist robot policies to improve from deployment. Real-world rollouts contain successes, suboptimal behavior, and failures: imitating every recorded action can reinforce poor behavior, while filtering out failures discards evidence of physical interactions and their consequences. We introduce \textbf{LoopWAM}, a closed-loop world-action model that learns directly from this full quality spectrum, using rollouts from both itself and other deployed policies. Source-dependent noise sampling unifies behavior learning and action-conditioned world modeling, while quality steering and quality-weighted supervision retain full video supervision across qualities and regulate action imitation. Video and action tokens interact throughout parallel denoising, allowing learned consequences to inform action generation directly. On RoboChallenge Table30-V2, three deployment-and-training rounds raise success from 23.67% to 43.33%, a 19.7-percentage-point gain, with a final score of 56.80. LoopWAM also achieves 94.5% average success on RoboTwin~2.0 and 49.5% overall success on RoboCasa365 without additional embodied pretraining, obtaining the best overall results among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. On challenging shirt folding task, two rounds of deployment-driven improvement after single-task post-training raise success from 13.20% to 55.56%. These results demonstrate closed-loop improvement from mixed-quality experience under both multi-task learning and single-task post-training. \href{https://loop-wam.github.io/}{\textcolor{orange}{Project Page}}

[420] Fish Audio Drama 3 Technical Report cs.SD | cs.CLPDF

Dawei Han, Shidong Li, Shijia Liao, Jiahua Liu, Songting Liu

TL;DR: Fish Audio Drama 3 是 350 亿参数、每 token 激活 30 亿参数的开源混合专家语音模型，支持多轮修改、多人场景配音、语音补写和流式生成。

Motivation: 高表现力语音合成不仅要朗读文本，还需遵循自然语言导演指令、克隆声音、按反馈修改、控制多角色，并支持长音频及流式场景。

Abstract: We introduce Fish Audio Drama 3, an open-source speech generation model that turns text into directed performances, built on a 35B-parameter mixture-of-experts backbone that activates 3B parameters per token. It clones voices from multiple references, follows natural-language direction, revises a take when the next turn gives a note, voices multi-character scenes, edits existing speech by infilling, and synthesizes long-form and streaming audio. Multi-turn revision, scene dubbing, editing by infilling, and streaming text input are new in Drama 3, all in one model. Drama 3 pairs the hybrid linear-attention backbone with a new codebook multi-token-prediction audio decoder that predicts the acoustic codebooks of each frame in dedicated layers that attend over the entire sequence. The model is trained with a three-stage pre-training recipe, instruction fine-tuning, and large-batch reinforcement learning whose only reward is a single learned model of human preference. Its inference engine decodes a single stream at 271 frames per second on one H200, against 177 for Fish Audio S2, although Drama 3 has more than seven times as many parameters. The model weights are available on GitHub (https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/drama-3), and inference is available through SGLang-Omni (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-omni). We highly encourage readers to visit https://fish.audio to direct their own performances.

[421] AutoEnvScaling: Automating the Data Flywheel with Terminal Agents cs.SE | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Simon Yu, Baolin Peng, Bo Liu, Zhengyan Shi, Zhaoyang Wang

TL;DR: AutoEnvScaling 让提议智能体根据求解器 rollout 自动生成新的可验证终端任务环境，再用新 rollout 驱动下一轮环境生成，形成环境与求解能力共同演化的数据飞轮。

Motivation: 终端智能体强化学习需要多样、可验证的环境，但环境主要由研究者手工设计，任务供给受人工速度限制。

Result: 相较仅凭提示生成，AutoEnvScaling 将有效环境比例最高提高 25 倍，并将每个有效环境成本最高降低 75%。用 GPT-5.6-sol 环境训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 后，Terminal-Bench 2.1 比匹配的 Tmax 基线高 4.3 分。进一步让 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 同时担任提议者和求解器，Terminal-Bench 2.1 提高 12.2 分，Terminal-Bench 4.0 从 1.6 升至 3.2。流程还生成软件工程、电脑使用、专业工作及 GPU kernel 编程等智能体环境。

Insight: 把环境生成变成可执行终端任务，可扩展训练题来源并让出题和求解相互反馈；同一模型兼任两种角色的实验提供递归自改进方向的初步证据。摘要未提供有效环境率绝对值、生成质量人工评估及不同角色是否存在评测污染。

Abstract: Terminal agents solve tasks in software engineering and scientific research by executing commands in a terminal. Training them via reinforcement learning (RL) requires diverse and verifiable environments, but these environments are still mostly designed by human researchers, so their supply grows only as fast as researchers can work. We introduce AutoEnvScaling, which treats environment design as a terminal task and uses agents to automate the data flywheel. A proposer agent builds new RL environments from the rollouts of the solver being trained, and the solver’s new rollouts guide the next round. By turning environment generation into a terminal task, AutoEnvScaling increases the valid-environment rate by up to 25 times compared to prompt-only generation, at up to 75% lower cost per valid environment. We show that training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoEnvScaling environments from GPT-5.6-sol improves its Terminal-Bench 2.1 score by 4.3 points over the matched Tmax baseline. The broader goal of AutoEnvScaling is to enable recursive self-improvement (RSI): by making both environment generation and solving terminal tasks, it lets one model co-evolve in both roles. We show that Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, acting in both roles, gains 12.2 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and raises its Terminal-Bench 4.0 score from 1.6 to 3.2. The pipeline also generalizes across agentic domains, generating environments for software engineering, computer use, professional work, and GPU kernel programming. Overall, these results show a path toward agents building their own training environments, reducing human reliance and taking a core step toward RSI.

[422] SPROUT: Scaling Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Software Engineering cs.SE | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Mengyang Liu, Weiming Wang, Haixin Nan, Yu Wu, Peize Li

TL;DR: SPROUT 用文件系统和智能体上下文快照保存长程编码任务中间状态，并通过验证器引导回溯和分支复用失败尝试的早期进展，以提高强化学习 rollout 效率。

Details

Motivation: 长程软件工程任务中一个小错误就可能使完整 rollout 失败，重新从初始状态开始浪费计算；仅重置上下文也不能恢复依赖安装等执行环境状态。

Result: SPROUT 每个 assistant 回合后同时检查点保存文件系统和智能体上下文，由验证器引导策略决定从哪个中间步骤恢复及如何继续。在多种 LLM 的长程编码任务上，pass@k 最高提升 23.6%，token 用量仅为基线的 32%–52%。在 Qwen3.8-27B 强化学习训练中，SPROUT 在三个长程编码基准上比标准 GRPO 高 13.9 分，且每训练步耗时降低 39.5%。

Insight: 保存工作区和上下文的完整快照，使失败尝试可回到有效检查点分叉，而不重复完成全部前置工作。摘要的最高 pass@k 增益和训练比较针对特定任务/模型，检查点存储、回滚正确性及并行分支开销未量化。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has driven substantial progress in coding agents by relying on verified successful trajectories as learning signals. However, such trajectories are scarce in long-horizon software engineering tasks, where a minor error can invalidate the entire rollout. Repeatedly restarting from the initial state is commonly used yet inefficient, and resetting only the context with working directory misses state changes such as installed dependencies. Therefore, branching from intermediate steps to preserve earlier progress requires restoring both the agent context and execution environments. In this paper, we present SPROUT (SnaPshot-based RollOUT), an agentic RL rollout framework that scales long-horizon coding tasks by resuming and branching from intermediate states. Specifically, SPROUT was built on top of a lightweight infrastructure that checkpoints both the filesystem and the agent context after each assistant turn. A verifier-guided backtracking policy then selects where to resume a failed attempt and how to proceed. Extensive experiments on long-horizon coding tasks show that SPROUT achieves up to 23.6% improvement over pass@k across various LLMs, while using $32$–$52%$ of their tokens. For RL training of Qwen3.8-27B, SPROUT stably outperforms standard GRPO by $13.9$ points on three long-horizon coding benchmarks while cutting the time per training step by $39.5%$. SPROUT thus makes RL on long-horizon coding tasks both more effective and cheaper to scale.

[423] PreciseCoder: Faithful and Generalizable Debugging Beyond Unit-Test Rewards cs.SE | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Yunkai Zhan, Miaosen Chai, Shangshang Wang, Jike Zhong, Yuqing Yang

TL;DR: PreciseCoder 为单元测试奖励增加语义验证的局部编辑信号，抑制调试时过度修改和对正确代码臆造 bug，同时保持通过率。

Details

Motivation: 代码 RL 常用单元测试作为唯一奖励，只判断最终程序是否通过；作者发现该信号虽能提高通过率，也会让模型改动更多，并在原本正确的代码中臆造错误。

Result: PreciseCoder 奖励语义核验过的精确局部编辑。4B、9B、27B 模型平均编辑行数由 7–15 降至 3，且通过率与仅单元测试训练相当。只用单行 bug 训练后可迁移到仓库级修复，解决更多问题且补丁更小。9B PreciseCoder 推理轨迹还可帮助更强模型 GPT-5.6 Sol、Qwen3.8-Max 在无需额外训练时将编辑精度提高 4.6–12.4 分。思维轨迹分析显示该奖励鼓励逐行推理、指出 bug 行并形成一致的错误假设。

Insight: 奖励精确且语义核验的修改，可以在通过率相近时减少无谓代码改动；轨迹还可作为更强模型的提示信号。摘要未给训练数据规模、通过率绝对值及仓库级任务的具体比较基线。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) from unit tests is the common recipe for post-training code models, but a unit test only asks whether the final program passes. We analyze what this unit-test-only reward teaches a model during debugging and find that, while it raises pass rates, it also teaches the model to edit more and to hallucinate bugs in code that is already correct. We introduce PreciseCoder, a training algorithm that augments the unit-test reward with a signal for semantically verified, localized edits, which correlates with smaller edits and higher pass rates. On 4B, 9B, and 27B models, PreciseCoder reduces the average number of edit lines from 7-15to 3 at a pass rate on par with unit-test-only training. Trained only on single-line bugs, PreciseCoder can generalize to repository-level program repair, where it resolves more issues with smaller patches. Its precision also transfers from weaker to stronger models: given the reasoning trace of a 9B PreciseCoder model, frontier models such as GPT-5.6 Sol and Qwen3.8-Max gain 4.6-12.4 points in edit precision with no additional training. Linguistic analysis of the thinking traces shows that our reward encourages the model to reason about individual lines, name the buggy ones, and form consistent bug hypotheses.

[424] RUBATO: Decoupled Clocks Allow Full-Duplex Models to Think as Fast as They Can eess.AS | cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.SDPDF

Yi-Jen Shih, Puyuan Peng, Haohe Liu, David Harwath, Abdelrahman Mohamed

TL;DR: RUBATO 用独立时钟的多流位置编码解耦全双工语音模型的聆听、说话和内部思考速率，使模型可在推理时按硬件速度调整解码。

Details

Motivation: 全双工语音模型加入内部思考流后，常用固定解码速率保证实时处理，但这假设特定硬件时延；思考本身是异步的，固定速率可能限制答题速度或降低准确率。

Result: RUBATO 为不同流分配独立时钟，并以两种极端解码速率训练，目标是在中间速率零样本插值。五个口语推理任务上表现稳健。Spoken GSM8K 中，基线在插值速度下准确率降至 1.7%，RUBATO-Full 则在各速率维持 48.7%–51.1%，更快硬件上 time-to-answer 缩短 6.5 倍，同时首次响应时间不变。BIG-Bench Audio 上优势也保持，在用户于模型说话和推理时插话的复杂全双工场景，RUBATO-Full 准确率为 40.0%–45.1%，基线完全失败。

Insight: 独立时钟使思考、聆听和发声不必共享静态节奏，可利用硬件吞吐提高最终答案速度而不延迟首次响应。准确率和速度是作者报告的特定任务/设置，摘要未给出硬件型号、速率范围或实时流式延迟分布。

Abstract: Recent Speech Full-Duplex (FDX) models are capable of engaging in naturalistic conversation by listening and speaking at the same time. Building on this foundation, recent architectures introduce internal thinking streams to enhance their intelligence. To guarantee these streams process successfully in real time, existing methods enforce a fixed decoding rate, which assumes a hardware profile capable of a specific latency. We argue this static approach is severely suboptimal. Because internal thinking is intrinsically asynchronous, an ideal FDX model should sustain real-time conversational flow while allowing each stream to decode at its own hardware-adaptive rate. Thinking streams must process as fast as the hardware allows to deliver accurate answers faster. To solve this, we propose RUBATO, a novel multistream positional encoding that assigns independent clocks to entirely decouple the streams. This structural isolation empowers the model to zero-shot interpolate across any inference decoding speed. It drastically simplifies dataset construction by requiring training on only two extreme decoding speeds while smoothly adapting to any intermediate rate during deployment. RUBATO demonstrates consistent robustness across five spoken reasoning tasks. On Spoken GSM8K, a baseline model collapses to 1.7% accuracy at interpolated speeds. Conversely, RUBATO-Full sustains 48.7% to 51.1% accuracy across all rates, leveraging faster hardware to achieve a 6.5x shorter time-to-answer with a constant time-to-first-response. This advantage holds on BIG-Bench Audio and amplifies significantly during complex full-duplex interruptions. Specifically, when a user interjects while the model is actively speaking and reasoning, RUBATO-Full achieves 40.0% to 45.1% accuracy, whereas the baseline fails completely.

[425] Exploring the Latent Structure of AMD Severity Using Retinal Foundation Models eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Niccolò Fineschi, Jovana Panic, Atsushi Watanabe, Hideaki Hayashi, Kazuya Nishimura

TL;DR: 该研究分析 RET-CLIP 中年龄相关黄斑变性严重度的潜在表示，发现疾病更像连续谱，且中期病变比健康与晚期阶段更难区分。

Details

Motivation: 视网膜基础模型在多种眼科任务上表现较强，但疾病信息如何组织在其嵌入空间中，以及这种结构如何影响下游预测，仍知之甚少。

Result: 作者用 AREDS 双眼眼底图像，分析 RET-CLIP 相对非眼科编码器的严重程度表示、三个临床粒度分类任务及有影响的潜在维度。RET-CLIP 将 AMD 表征为连续谱而非离散类别，健康和晚期病变分离较清楚、中间阶段较难。下游平衡准确率从二元 AMD 的 0.844、Late-AMD 的 0.814，降至六分类分级的 0.446。重要潜在维度与玻璃膜疣、色素变化及晚期视网膜病灶等表型统计相关。

Insight: 任务标签越细粒度，严重度连续谱中的中间状态越难判别；嵌入结构影响临床任务难度，也提供可解释分析线索。摘要未报告队列规模、外部验证或不同编码器在全部任务上的数值比较。

Abstract: Retinal foundation models have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of ophthalmic tasks, yet relatively little is known about how disease-related information is represented within their learned embeddings and whether this distribution influences downstream prediction performance. In this work, we use Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) as a case study to investigate how disease severity is represented within the embedding space of RET-CLIP, a retinal vision-language foundation model, using bilateral fundus images from the AREDS dataset, benchmarked against non-retinal encoders. We first characterize the distribution of AMD severity within the learned representation space and then evaluate how this structure influences classification performance across three clinically relevant task formulations of increasing granularity. Finally, we analyze the most influential latent dimensions combining feature attribution, statistical phenotype association, and qualitative image analyses. Our results show that RET-CLIP represents AMD severity as a continuous spectrum rather than a set of discrete categories, with healthy and advanced disease stages exhibiting clearer separation than intermediate ones. This organization was reflected in downstream performance, which decreased from a balanced accuracy of 0.844 and 0.814 for binary AMD and Late-AMD detection respectively to 0.446 for six-class grading. Furthermore, the most influential latent dimensions were statistically associated to distinct retinal phenotypes, including drusen accumulation, pigmentary alterations, and advanced retinal lesions. These findings suggest that the structure of retinal foundation-model representations influences the difficulty of clinically relevant prediction tasks and demonstrate the potential of representation-level analysis for understanding disease organization and improving interpretability.

[426] Deficit-Driven Stratified Acquisition for Building STRATA-S12: An Open SAR-Optical Corpus for Self-Supervised Learning eess.IV | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Christian Sanchez-Leon, Dongming Chen, Dongqi Wang

TL;DR: DDSA 将 SAR—光学卫星配准语料构建视为分层覆盖采集问题，按类别、季节和区域缺口动态排序，并以人工在环修补失败配对。

Details

Motivation: 自监督地球观测配准语料往往机会式采集，没有分层配额控制；不均匀云覆盖会导致某些地理区域数据缺失。

Result: DDSA 构建 Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 配对时校正半球因素，按类别×季节×区域共 192 个层分层，执行严格时间配对和多阶段质检，并在采集中闭环修补缺口。前几个百分点预算就填充全部 192 层，而丰度优先顺序在后期前让大部分层仍为空。缺陷修复率取决于成因持续性：几何 nodata 等失败可修复率 41.4%，云失败为 18.8%。修复环贡献发布配对的 39.5%，质量无可测下降，人工复核通过率 89.8%。总计 2,928,370 次采集尝试释放 740,746 对。数据集 STRATA-S12 提供 STAC/PDS4 对齐元数据；预注册线性探针支持其用于自监督预训练。

Insight: 缺口驱动采集使预算早期覆盖所有地理/季节层，云问题更难修复是因为季节性持久，而非缺陷标签本身。发布配对约占尝试数四分之一，说明高质量门控有采集成本；跨语料和跨方法系统比较留待后续。

Abstract: Building a co-registered SAR-optical corpus for self-supervised Earth Observation is above all an acquisition problem, yet the main multi-modal datasets are collected opportunistically, with no per-stratum quota control and no mechanism against the geographic dropout that non-uniform cloud cover leaves behind. We present Deficit-Driven Stratified Acquisition (DDSA), an algorithm that treats building a co-registered Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 corpus as a constrained maximum-coverage problem over a hemisphere-corrected (class x season x region) stratification, enforces strict temporal pairing and a multi-stage quality gate, and closes the loop during acquisition with a human-in-the-loop deficit-repair stage. Measured on its own product, the algorithm yields three results a single-pass acquisition cannot report. Deficit-driven ordering makes a partial run a covering one: it holds every one of the 192 strata populated from the first few percent of the budget, where an abundance-first order leaves most strata empty until the end. Whether a failed attempt can be recovered depends on the temporal persistence of its cause, not the kind of defect: geometric failures such as nodata are among the most repairable (eta = 41.4%) while cloud is among the least (eta = 18.8%), because a cloudy location is cloudy on most dates of its season. The repair loop supplies 39.5% of the released pairs at no measurable quality cost, with 89.8% surviving manual review. The quality guarantee has a price: 2,928,370 acquisition attempts produced 740,746 released pairs. We release the corpus, STRATA-S12, with STAC/PDS4-aligned FAIR sidecars, and a pre-registered linear-probe check confirms it is fit for self-supervised pre-training. A metadata-level coverage comparison against SSL4EO-S12 and SEN12MS situates the corpus over a shared frame; systematic cross-corpus and cross-method comparison is left to follow-up work.
